abilities.general_description: The six fundamental abilities define a character's raw potential: Strength (STR), Dexterity (DEX), Constitution (CON), Intelligence (INT), Wisdom (WIS), and Charisma (CHA). These scores, and primarily their modifiers, underpin most other character statistics and are critical inputs for nearly all game mechanics.

abilities.description_summary: Strength measures your character's muscle and physical power. This ability is especially important for soldiers because it helps them prevail in physical combat.
typical_uses_summary: Damage rolls for melee and thrown weapons. (Exceptions: Grenades don't have their damage modified by Strength.)
Climb, Jump, and Swim checks (the skills with Strength as the key ability).
Strength checks (for breaking down doors and the like).
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier is added to relevant d20 rolls and damage. Recalculate derived stats if STR score changes.

abilities.description_summary: Dexterity measures hand-eye coordination, agility, reflexes, and balance. This ability is the most important ability for scoundrels, but it's also high on the list for characters who want to be good shots with ranged weapons (such as blaster pistols) or who want to handle the controls of a starship or speeder fairly well.
typical_uses_summary: Ranged attack rolls, such as with blasters.
Reflex Defense, provided the character can react to the attack.
Acrobatics, Pilot, Ride, and Stealth checks (the skills where Dexterity is the key ability).
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier is added to relevant d20 rolls and Reflex Defense. Recalculate derived stats if DEX score changes.

abilities.description_summary: Constitution represents your character's health and stamina. Constitution adds to a hero's hit points, so it's important for everyone, but most important for soldiers and Jedi.
typical_uses_summary: Each die roll for gaining additional hit points (though a penalty can never drop a hit point roll below 1; a character always gains at least 1 hit point each time he or she goes up a level).
Fortitude Defense, for resisting poison, radiation, and similar threats.
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier is added to HP per level and Fortitude Defense. Recalculate derived stats if CON score changes. Droids typically do not have a Constitution score.

abilities.description_summary: Intelligence determines how well your character learns and reasons. Intelligence is important for scouts, nobles, and any character who wants to have a wide assortment of skills.
typical_uses_summary: The number of languages your character knows at the start of the game.
The number of trained skills you have.
Knowledge, Mechanics, and Use Computer checks (the skills with Intelligence as the key ability).
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier also affects number of known languages and trained skills dynamically if INT changes.

abilities.description_summary: Wisdom describes a character's willpower, common sense, perception, and intuition. Compared to Intelligence, Wisdom is more related to being in tune with and aware of one's surroundings, while Intelligence represents one's ability to analyze information. Wisdom is the most important ability for scouts, but it's also important to characters wishing to be in-tune with their environment or characters who like to gamble. If you want your character to have keen senses, put a high score in Wisdom.
typical_uses_summary: Will Defense, generally for resisting certain Force attacks.
Perception, Survival, and Treat Injury checks (the skills with Wisdom as the key ability).
The number of Force powers you learn when you take the Force Training feat.
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier also affects number of known Force powers dynamically if WIS changes (for characters with Force Training feat).

abilities.description_summary: Charisma measures a character's force of personality, persuasiveness, personal magnetism, ability to lead, and physical attractiveness. It represents actual strength of personality and force of presence, not merely how others perceive you in a social setting. Charisma is most important for nobles and Jedi.
typical_uses_summary: Deception, Gather Information, Persuasion, and Use the Force checks (skills with Charisma as the key ability).
abilities.notes_for_ai_gm: Modifier is added to relevant skill checks. Recalculate derived stats if CHA score changes.

character_creation_notes.score_generation_methods_summary: Core Rulebook details multiple methods: Dice rolling (e.g., 4d6 drop lowest with reroll conditions), Planned Generation (point-buy), and Standard Score Package. See ability_system_rules.json for specifics.

ability_score_increases_on_level_up.description: At Character Levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20, a heroic character increases two different ability scores by +1 each.
ability_score_increases_on_level_up.restriction: Cannot apply both increases to a single ability score at the same level.

classes_data.description: Compilation of Heroic, Nonheroic, and Beast Classes for Star Wars Saga Edition, primarily based on the Core Rulebook.

classes_list.name: Jedi
classes_list.description_general: Jedi combine physical training with mastery of the Force. They concentrate on battle prowess, defense, and lightsaber training. Additionally, they are ambassadors of the Jedi order, protecting the Republic from all dangers. [CRB p.39]
classes_list.role_summary: Guardians of peace and justice, masters of the Force and lightsaber combat.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Wisdom and Charisma are most important. Strength and Dexterity are also useful. [CRB p.40]
classes_list.talents_progression_summary: Selects a talent at 1st level and every odd-numbered Jedi level thereafter (3rd, 5th, 7th, etc.).
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gains a bonus feat at 2nd level and every even-numbered Jedi level thereafter (2nd, 4th, 6th, etc.).
classes_list.bonus_feat_selection_notes: Must be selected from: Acrobatic Strike, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Double Attack, Dual Weapon Mastery I, Dual Weapon Mastery II, Dual Weapon Mastery III, Great Cleave, Improved Charge, Improved Disarm, Martial Arts I, Martial Arts II, Martial Arts III, Melee Defense, Mobility, Quick Draw, Power Attack, Powerful Charge, Rapid Strike, Running Attack, Skill Focus, Skill Training, Strong in the Force, Triple Attack, Triple Crit, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (lightsabers). [CRB p.42]

talent_trees.description_brief: Skilled negotiators and talented ambassadors.
More combat-oriented, honing skills to become deadly combatants.
True enemies of the dark side, hunting down evil and stopping darkness.
Improve prowess with a lightsaber.

classes_list.errata_applied_notes: Class skills list updated to include Jump and Mechanics per CRB Errata (reflected in Table 4-2 from user image and p.38 errata for Jedi class skills). Resilience Talent (CRB p.40) action changed to full-round action from standard action per errata. [cite: 2011]

classes_list.name: Noble
classes_list.description_general: Members of the noble class use their intelligence and natural charisma to make their way in the galaxy. From true royalty to elected officials, military commanders to crime lords, traders, merchants, ambassadors, holovid stars, and influential corporate magnates. [CRB p.43]
classes_list.role_summary: Shrewd bargainer, negotiator, leader, and inspirer.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Charisma is undoubtedly a noble's most important ability score. Wisdom and Intelligence form the basis of other important skills. [CRB p.43]
classes_list.talents_progression_summary: Selects a talent at 1st level and every odd-numbered Noble level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gains a bonus feat at 2nd level and every even-numbered Noble level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feat_selection_notes: Must be selected from: Armor Proficiency (light), Cybernetic Surgery, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Linguist, Melee Defense, Skill Focus, Skill Training, Surgical Expertise, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons), Weapon Proficiency (rifles). [CRB p.45]

talent_trees.description_brief: Exert influence over opponents.
Inspire followers and urge them to greatness.
Take charge and lead companions and followers.
Benefit from a privileged upbringing.

classes_list.errata_applied_notes: Wealth Talent (CRB p.44) refers to 'class level' not 'noble level' per errata. [cite: 2012]

classes_list.name: Scoundrel
classes_list.description_general: Scoundrels are rogues who either live outside the law or fight against it. They use intelligence, dexterity, and charisma. They live by their wits, lying, cheating, stealing, and fighting when needed. [CRB p.46]
classes_list.role_summary: Tricky, skillful rogue succeeding by stealth and wit.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Dexterity and Intelligence are most important. Charisma for talking out of trouble, Wisdom for spotting trouble. [CRB p.46]
classes_list.talents_progression_summary: Selects a talent at 1st level and every odd-numbered Scoundrel level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gains a bonus feat at 2nd level and every even-numbered Scoundrel level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feat_selection_notes: Must be selected from: Deadeye, Dodge, Melee Defense, Mobility, Precise Shot, Quick Draw, Rapid Shot, Running Attack, Skill Focus, Skill Training, Vehicular Combat, Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons). [CRB p.48]

talent_trees.description_brief: Gamble with destiny, trusting fate or the Force.
Cause trouble and instigate chaos for enemies.
Hack into enemy computer systems with grace.
Prowl space lanes seeking wealth, fame, or adventure; good with vehicles.

classes_list.errata_applied_notes: Hyperdriven Talent (CRB p.47) refers to 'class level', not 'scoundrel class level' per errata. [cite: 2012]

classes_list.name: Scout
classes_list.description_general: Scouts are natural explorers and adventurers, curious and trained for out-of-the-way locations. They are independent, understanding terrain and stars, recognizing danger, and finding necessities for survival. [CRB p.49]
classes_list.role_summary: Cunning, skilled explorer for wilderness and backwater worlds.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom are key. Strength is also useful for athletic skills. [CRB p.50]
starting_feats: Shake It Off (requires CON 13 and trained in Endurance)
classes_list.talents_progression_summary: Selects a talent at 1st level and every odd-numbered Scout level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gains a bonus feat at 2nd level and every even-numbered Scout level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feat_selection_notes: Must be selected from: Armor Proficiency (light, medium, or heavy), Careful Shot, Deadeye, Dodge, Far Shot, Linguist, Mobility, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Running Attack, Skill Focus, Skill Training, Sniper, Vehicular Combat, Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons). [CRB p.51]

talent_trees.description_brief: Exceptionally good at noticing things and avoiding perilous situations.
Learn quickly how to blend in with the environment.
Especially skilled at 'getting by' on backwater worlds.
Trained to react to danger swiftly, navigate difficult terrain, and reduce damage.

classes_list.name: Soldier
classes_list.description_general: Soldiers combine discipline with martial skills to become the best pure warriors in the galaxy. They can be stalwart defenders, cruel marauders, or brave adventurers, fighting for various motivations. [CRB p.51]
classes_list.role_summary: Warrior with exceptional combat capability and unequaled skill with weapons.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Dexterity is most important for ranged combat. Constitution and Strength are also key. Intelligence and Wisdom are useful for skills. [CRB p.52]
classes_list.talents_progression_summary: Selects a talent at 1st level and every odd-numbered Soldier level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gains a bonus feat at 2nd level and every even-numbered Soldier level thereafter.
classes_list.bonus_feat_selection_notes: Must be selected from: Armor Proficiency (heavy), Bantha Rush, Careful Shot, Charging Fire, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Coordinated Attack, Crush, Deadeye, Double Attack, Dual Weapon Mastery I/II/III, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Far Shot, Great Cleave, Improved Charge, Improved Disarm, Martial Arts I/II/III, Melee Defense, Mighty Swing, Pin, Point Blank Shot, Power Attack, Precise Shot, Quick Draw, Rapid Shot, Rapid Strike, Running Attack, Shake It Off, Skill Focus, Skill Training, Sniper, Throw, Toughness, Trip, Triple Attack, Triple Crit, Vehicular Combat, Weapon Focus, Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons/heavy weapons). [CRB p.54]

talent_trees.description_brief: Maximize benefits of wearing armor while reducing drawbacks.
Prefers 'up close and personal' melee combat.
Uses advanced combat tactics to take down enemies, shield comrades, and endure challenges.
Highly trained at using specific weapons.

classes_list.errata_applied_notes: Defense Bonuses at 1st level corrected to +1 Reflex, +2 Fortitude per CRB Errata. [cite: 2011] Stunning Strike Talent (CRB p.52) refers to 'damage roll' not 'attack roll' per errata. [cite: 2011]

classes_list.name: Nonheroic
classes_list.description_general: Nonheroic characters include professional workers, petty criminals, police officers, common thugs, and baseline Imperial stormtroopers or Rebel troopers. They lack the inclination or training to be heroes but are capable in their own fields. [CRB p.278]
classes_list.role_summary: Represents ordinary individuals or rank-and-file members of organizations.
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Varies by role; no specific emphasis unless specialized.

hit_points.starting_hp_1st_level_formula: (Maximized d4, i.e., 4) + Constitution modifier (if starting at 1st level as Nonheroic)

classes_list.starting_feats_description: Gains three starting feats at 1st level, chosen from: Armor Proficiency (light), Armor Proficiency (medium), Skill Focus (chosen from class skills), Skill Training (chosen from class skills), Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons), Weapon Proficiency (heavy weapons), Weapon Proficiency (pistols), Weapon Proficiency (rifles), Weapon Proficiency (simple weapons). Skill Focus/Training can be selected multiple times for different skills. [CRB p.278]
classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gain feats by character level as per Table 3-1 (CRB p.37).
classes_list.ability_score_increase_note: Increase one ability score by +1 at 4th character level and every four character levels thereafter.
special_rules: Do not add their nonheroic class level to their defense scores (Reflex, Fortitude, Will).
Can multiclass into a heroic class following normal multiclassing rules.
classes_list.errata_applied_notes: Class skills list on CRB p.278 errata adds Ride skill. [cite: 2011]

classes_list.name: Beast
classes_list.description_general: Animals and other nonsentient life forms have levels in the beast class (a nonheroic class). They are usually encountered as threats or mounts. Intelligence is 1 or 2. [CRB p.275]
classes_list.key_abilities_text: Intelligence is 1 or 2. Other five abilities rolled normally. Wisdom is important for cunning beasts.

hit_points.starting_hp_1st_level_formula: (Maximized d8, i.e., 8) + Constitution modifier (if starting at 1st level as Beast)

classes_list.bonus_feats_progression_summary: Gain feats normally by character level as per Table 3-1 (CRB p.37).
classes_list.ability_score_increase_note: Increase one ability score by +1 at 4th character level and every four character levels thereafter.
special_rules: Do not add their beast class level to their defense scores.
Beasts with INT 1 or 2 cannot multiclass. If INT becomes 3+ via ability increase, can multiclass into heroic classes.
Possess Natural Armor (amount varies, never higher than beast class level).

Possess Natural Weapons (bite, claw, gore, slam, sting; damage by size, see CRB p.275-276). Applies STR to melee attack/damage, DEX to ranged. Multiple natural weapons can be used in full attack with no penalty.
Bonus on damage rolls with natural weapons = 1/2 beast class level (rounded down).
Proficient with own natural weapons only.
May have specific Species Traits based on adaptation (Airborne, Aquatic, Arctic, Desert, Subterranean - see CRB p.276).

feats_data.description: Compilation of Feats for Star Wars SAGA Edition.

feats_list.name: A Few Maneuvers
feats_list.benefit_summary: Ref Def +2 in Colossal or smaller vehicle, if projectile misses by 5

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When piloting a vehicle of Colossal size or smaller, you grant a +2 dodge bonus to your vehicle's Reflex Defense. Furthermore, if you are the target of a missile or torpedo attack and the attack roll misses by 5 or more, the projectile self-destructs harmlessly.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: DEX 13, Dodge, Vehicular Combat, Trained in Pilot

feats_list.name: Accelerated Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter, full attack as stan

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when using only weapons with which you are proficient, you can take a full attack action as a standard action. [[NOTE: This feat does not allow the use of full-round attacks (such as Whirlwind Attack) as standard actions. Full attack actions are usually feats that provide extra attacks, such as Dual Weapon Mastery, Double Attack, and Triple Attack.]]

feats_list.name: Acrobatic Ally
feats_list.benefit_summary: hoist or toss ally 2sq on DC20 Acrobatics as stan, free for ally, your turn ends
feats_list.full_text_description: You can hoist or toss an ally of your size or smaller up to 2 squares. You and your ally must act on the same initiative number and start in adjacent squares. If you succeed on a DC 20 Acrobatics check as a standard action, your ally ends up in a square of your choosing up to 2 squares above or away from you. This counts as a free action for your ally and ends your turn. Your ally can then continue his or her turn. If you fail your check, both you and your ally immediately become prone in your square. Your turn is ended, but your ally can take his or her turn normally. Special: This feat can provoke attacks of opportunity against either character.

feats_list.name: Acrobatic Dodge
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc as reac if melee atk misses you can move into adjacent w/out AoO
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a reaction, if a melee attack misses you, you can immediately move into an adjacent square without provoking an attack of opportunity. Special: You must be aware of the attacker to benefit from this feat. You can use this feat a second time during the encounter by spending a Force Point.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: DEX 13, Dodge, Mobility, Skill Focus (Acrobatics), trained in Acrobatics

feats_list.name: Acrobatic Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: If you succeed in tumbling past a foe to avoid an AoO, gain +2 competence bonus on next attack against that foe this turn. (Errata applied)
feats_list.benefit_text_long: If you succeed in tumbling to avoid an attack of opportunity (see the Acrobatics skill, page 62), you gain a +5 bonus on the next attack that you make against that foe as long as the attack occurs before the end of your current turn. [Text from CRB p.83, cite: 553-554]
feats_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.290: Bonus reduced from +5 to +2 competence bonus. [cite: 2001]
feats_list.full_text_description: If you succeed in tumbling to avoid an attack of opportunity (see the Acrobatics skill, page 62), you gain a +2 competence bonus on the next attack that you make against that foe as long as the attack occurs before the end of your current turn.

feats_list.name: Adaptable Talent
feats_list.benefit_summary: Choose talent from your classes, and swap that talent 1/day w/6 hrs rest

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Choose one talent that you meet the prerequisites for, from a class you possess. Once per day, after at least 6 hours of rest, you can choose to swap out one of your current talents for the talent you chose for this feat. The talent you swap out cannot be the prerequisite for any other talent you have. You can swap back to your original talent after at least 6 hours of rest.

feats_list.name: Advantageous Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: if opponent has not yet acted, add full heroic level to damage

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a successful attack against an enemy who has not yet acted in combat, you add your full heroic level to damage rolls. Normal: Typically you add only one-half your heroic level to damage rolls.

feats_list.name: Advantageous Cover
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you have cover, take no damage from area attacks

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you have cover, you take no damage from area attacks, even if the attack roll exceeds your Reflex Defense. Normal: You take no damage from area attacks when you have cover only if the attack roll misses.

feats_list.name: Aiming Accuracy
feats_list.benefit_summary: if aim as full-round gain +5 atk against target if remains in LOS
feats_list.full_text_description: If you aim at a target as a full-round action (instead of two swift actions), you gain a +5 bonus to your next attack made in the following round against that target. The target must remain in your line of sight.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, proficient with weapon.

feats_list.name: Ample Foraging
feats_list.benefit_summary: Basic Survival of Survival, each gets +2 Fort Def until start next day

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you make a Survival check for the Basic Survival application of the skill, each creature that consumes the food you find gains a +2 morale bonus to his or her Fortitude Defense until the start of the next day.

feats_list.name: Angled Throw
feats_list.benefit_summary: if Atk exceeds Ref Def 15, ignore cover and improved cover

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When throwing a grenade or grenade-like weapon, you can attempt to bounce it off a wall or other surface close to your target. If your attack roll exceeds a Reflex Defense of 15, you ignore cover and improved cover (but not total cover) with your attack.

feats_list.name: Anointed Hunter
feats_list.benefit_summary: if end move 2 sq from start +1 Atk with thrown weapons
feats_list.full_text_description: If you end your move at least 2 squares from where you started, you gain a +1 competence bonus on attacks made with thrown weapons until the end of your turn.

feats_list.name: Aquatic Specialists (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Swim & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), swim half spd as move
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Swim checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you swim, you swim at half speed as a move action (or you swim at your speed as a full-round action).

feats_list.name: Armor Proficiency (heavy)
feats_list.benefit_summary: No attack or armor check penalties when wearing heavy, medium, or light armor. Gain armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you wear heavy armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). [Text from CRB p.83, cite: 554-555]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you wear heavy armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). Normal: A character who wears heavy armor with which she is not proficient takes a -10 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.normal_text: A character who wears heavy armor with which she is not proficient takes a -10 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.

feats_list.name: Armor Proficiency (light)
feats_list.benefit_summary: No attack or armor check penalties when wearing light armor. Gain armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you wear light armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). [Text from CRB p.83]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you wear light armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). Normal: A character who wears heavy armor with which she is not proficient takes a -2 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.normal_text: A character who wears heavy armor [sic - CRB text error, should be light armor] with which she is not proficient takes a -2 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.notes_for_processing: CRB text for 'Normal' section incorrectly states 'heavy armor'; it should refer to 'light armor' for this feat.

feats_list.name: Armor Proficiency (medium)
feats_list.benefit_summary: No attack or armor check penalties when wearing light or medium armor. Gain armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you wear medium armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). [Text from CRB p.83]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you wear medium armor, you take no armor check penalty on attack rolls or skill checks. Additionally, you benefit from all of the armor's special equipment bonuses (if any). Normal: A character who wears medium armor with which she is not proficient takes a -5 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.
feats_list.normal_text: A character who wears medium armor with which she is not proficient takes a -5 armor check penalty on attack rolls as well as skill checks made using the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Endurance, Initiative, Jump, Stealth, and Swim. Additionally, the character gains none of the armor's special equipment bonuses.

feats_list.name: Artillery Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: affect +2 sq with burst or splash at further than PB range

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make an attack with a burst or splash weapon against a target at greater than point blank range, you can affect two additional adjacent squares to the normal burst or splash area.

feats_list.name: Ascension Specialists (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Climb & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), climb half spd as move
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Climb checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you climb, you climb at half speed as a move action (or at your normal speed as a full-round action).

feats_list.name: Assault
feats_list.benefit_summary: spend FP to make 2 Atk as stan action not full

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you are wielding two weapons or a weapon with which you can use the Double Attack feat, you may spend a Force Point to make two attacks as a standard action. The normal penalties due to attacking with two weapons or using Double Attack still apply, and you cannot make more than two attacks regardless of how many extra attacks you can make during a full attack action. Normal: You can only make multiple attacks with the full attack action (a full-round action).

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Double Attack or Dual Weapon Mastery I
prerequisites_structured.name: Double Attack or Dual Weapon Mastery I

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Double Attack or Dual Weapon Mastery I, BAB +6

feats_list.name: Assured Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: reroll lowest damage die if roll multiple dice, must take reroll
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you deal damage to a target with an attack and you roll multiple damage dice, you can reroll the lowest damage die but must keep its second result, even if it is worse.

feats_list.name: Attack Combo (Fire & Strike)
feats_list.benefit_summary: if hit single target with 2 consecutive atks in same turn, additional atks +1 die dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you hit a single target with two consecutive ranged, melee, and/or unarmed attacks during the same turn, any additional ranged, melee, or unarmed attacks you make until the end of your next turn (including attacks of opportunity and attacks made as reactions) deal +1 die of damage on a hit. This extra damage stacks with extra damage granted by other feats or talents.

feats_list.name: Attack Combo (Melee)
feats_list.benefit_summary: if hit single target with 2 consecutive melee or unarmed atks in same turn, additional atks +1 die dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you hit a single target with two consecutive melee and/or unarmed attacks during the same turn, any additional melee or unarmed attacks you make until the end of your next turn (including attacks of opportunity and attacks made as reactions) deal +1 die of damage on a hit. This extra damage stacks with extra damage granted by other feats or talents.

feats_list.name: Attack Combo (Ranged)
feats_list.benefit_summary: if hit single target with 2 consecutive ranged atks in same turn, additional atks +1 die dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you hit a single target with two consecutive ranged attacks during the same turn, any additional ranged attacks you make until the end of your next turn (including attacks of opportunity and attacks made as reactions) deal +1 die of damage on a hit. This extra damage stacks with extra damage granted by other feats or talents.

feats_list.name: Autofire Assault
feats_list.benefit_summary: autofire penalty -2 if autofired to same target last round, +1 die dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you target the same area with an autofire attack that you made an autofire attack against on your last turn, the penalty on the autofire attack is reduced to -2 (-1 if using a braced autofire-only weapon or the Controlled Burst talent) and you deal +1 die of damage on a hit. Normal: A -5 penalty applies to autofire attack rolls, and there are no bonuses for consecutive rounds of fire in the same squares. Special: This feat cannot be used with the Autofire Sweep feat or the Burst Fire feat.

feats_list.name: Autofire Sweep
feats_list.benefit_summary: autofire as 6sq cone

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When making an autofire attack, you can attack all targets in a 6-square cone. The origin square of the cone can be any square in your line of sight and within point-blank range. Normal: A -5 penalty applies to autofire attack rolls. Autofire attacks that miss deal half damage. Special: This feat cannot be used with the Autofire Assault feat or the Burst Fire feat. It can be used with the Improved Suppression Fire talent (see LE page 31). [[Fluff states "You can sweep an area with your autofire weapon, spraying fire in a 180-degree arc in front of you."]]

feats_list.name: Bad Feeling
feats_list.benefit_summary: extra move action in surprise round even if not surprised
feats_list.full_text_description: You can always take a move action during a surprise round, even if you are surprised. If you are not surprised, you can take this move action in addition to any other actions you are normally allowed to take in the surprise round.

feats_list.name: Bantha Herder
feats_list.benefit_summary: if dam a Large or smaller creature with a ranged atk compare to Will Def & can move target(s) 1 sq in any direction as free
feats_list.full_text_description: When you damage a Large or smaller creature with a ranged attack, compare the result of your attack roll to the target's Will Defense. If your result equals or exceeds the target's Will Defense, you can move the target 1 square in any direction as a free action. If your ranged attack deals damage to multiple eligible creatures, you can use this benefit against all of them. You can't move a target that's being grabbed or grappled, and you can't move a target into a solid object or into another creature's fighting space. [Dev: Bantha Herder and Forceful Blast are meant to be mutually exclusive]

feats_list.name: Bantha Rush
feats_list.benefit_summary: After successful melee attack vs opponent up to one size larger, can move that opponent 1 square as free action.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: After making a successful melee attack against an opponent up to one size category larger than you, you can choose to move that opponent 1 square in any direction as a free action. You can’t bantha rush an opponent that's being grabbed or grappled, and you can't bantha rush your opponent into a solid object or another creature's fighting space. [Text from CRB p.83, cite: 558-559]
feats_list.full_text_description: After making a successful melee attack against an opponent up to one size category larger than you, you can choose to move that opponent 1 square in any direction as a free action. You can't bantha rush an opponent that's being grabbed or grappled, and you can't bantha rush your opponent into a solid object or another creature's fighting space. Unleashed: When you use the Bantha Rush feat, you can spend a Destiny Point to automatically increase the distance you move your target by 5 squares and knock your target prone.
feats_list.special_text: Unleashed: When you use the Bantha Rush feat, you can spend a Destiny Point to automatically increase the distance you move your target by 5 squares and knock your target prone. (This 'Unleashed' text is often associated with this feat, e.g. Force Unleashed Campaign Guide, though not in the CRB p.83 description itself).

feats_list.name: Battering Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: can knock target prone if you move target with Bantha Rush
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you successfully move a creature with the Bantha Rush feat, you also knock that target prone.

feats_list.name: Binary Mind
feats_list.benefit_summary: enemy must roll mind-affecting effects twice & keep lower

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an enemy tries to use a mind-affecting effect against you, the enemy must roll twice and keep the lower result.

feats_list.name: Biotech Specialist
feats_list.benefit_summary: modify a biotech item to give a special trait

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description:
You can modify a Yuuzhan Vong biotech-based device, suit of armor, weapon, or vehicle so that it gains a specific trait. Specific traits are listed in the chart on page 35. You can perform only one modification at a time. Unless noted otherwise, you cannot grant more than one benefit to a single device, suit of armor, weapon, or vehicle, and you cannot apply the same benefit more than once. Before beginning the modification, you must pay one-tenth the cost of the device, suit of armor, weapon, or vehicle you wish to modify or 1,000 credits, whichever is more. Completing the modification requires one day per 1,000 credits of the modification cost. At the end of this time, make a DC 20 Mechanics check; you can't take 10 or take 20 on this check. If the check succeeds, the modification is completed successfully, and the object gains the desired trait. If the check fails, you lose all credits spent making the modification, and the object doesn't gain the desired trait. However, you may start over if you wish. Due to the specialized nature of biotechnology, only other characters with the Biotech Specialist feat can assist you, reducing proportionately the time needed to complete the modification. At the end of the modification process, they can make a Mechanics check to aid your check. The market value of a modified item is equal to the base cost of the item + double the cost of the modifications made to it (not including credits wasted on failed modification attempts). 
BIOTECH ARMOR TRAIT: 
Agile Armor: The armor's maximum Dexterity bonus increases by 1. 
Fortifying Armor: The armor's equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense increases by 1. 
Protective Armor: The armor's armor bonus to Reflex Defense increases by 1. 
BIOTECH DEVICE TRAIT: 
Add Device to Creature: Alter a bioengineered creature to accept a biotech or standard technological enhancement such as a miniaturized sensor pack. 
Enhanced Strength: Increase the device's Strength score by 2. 
Improved Durability: The device's damage reduction increases by 1, and it gains extra hit points equal to one-quarter of its maximum hit points. 
Mastercraft Device: Skill checks made using the device gain a +1 equipment bonus, or the device's existing equipment bonus increases by 1. 
BIOTECH VEHICLE TRAIT: 
Dovin Basal Enhancement: Increase the effects of a dovin basal to grant one of the following benefits to a starship:  +1 additional square of movement at starship scale, +2 SR, or +1 die of damage when using a dovin basal. 
Enhanced Dexterity: Increase the vehicle's Dexterity score by 2. 
Improved Speed: Increases the vehicle speed by one-quarter of its base speed (minimum 1 square) 
BIOTECH WEAPON TRAIT:
Improved Accuracy: The weapon gains a +1 equipment bonus on attack rolls. 
Improved Damage: The weapon deals +2 points of damage on a successful hit. If the weapon has a damage multiplier (for example, 6d10x2), apply the extra damage before applying the multiplier. 
Selective Fire: An autofire-only ranged weapon can be set to fire single shots, or a single-shot ranged weapon that doesn't have a burst radius can be made to have an autofire mode. 
Special: Nobles and scoundrels may add this feat to their class list of bonus feats. This feat allows you to make Treat Injury checks on biotechnology without the -5 penalty.

feats_list.name: Biotech Surgery
feats_list.benefit_summary: install biotech prosthesis

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can install a biotech prosthesis onto a living being. The surgical procedure takes 1 hour of uninterrupted work, after which you must make a DC 20 Treat Injury check. If the check succeeds, the prosthesis is installed correctly. If the check fails, the prosthesis is not installed properly; however, you can try again after another uninterrupted hour of surgery. Special: You can install a biotech prosthesis on yourself, but you take a -5 penalty on the Treat Injury skill check. If you have the Surgical Expertise feat (CR page 88), you can install a biotech prosthesis in 10 minutes instead of 1 hour.

feats_list.name: Blaster Barrage
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 Atk to allies with autofire if you're successful with autofire

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make an attack with a weapon set on autofire that deals damage to at least one target within the designated area, you grant a +2 circumstance bonus on any of your allies' autofire attacks made against that same target until the beginning of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Bone Crusher
feats_list.benefit_summary: When you deal damage to grappled target, move it -1 CT
feats_list.full_text_description: When you deal damage to a grappled opponent, the opponent also moves -1 step on the condition track.

feats_list.name: Bothan Will
feats_list.benefit_summary: if attack v. Will Def fails, gain +2 Will Def until start of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an attack or skill check targets your Will Defense and fails to equal or exceed it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will Defense until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Bowcaster Marksman
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend Force Point to atk w/bowcaster, add result to dam too

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to an attack with a bowcaster, if you hit the target, you gain a competence bonus to your damage roll equal to the amount added to the attack.

feats_list.name: Brilliant Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc add Int mod to Ref Def as reac until your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can add your Intelligence bonus to your Reflex Defense as a reaction; this benefit lasts until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Brink of Death
feats_list.benefit_summary: if you deal damage that kills, can reduce to 0 hp instead

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you deal sufficient damage on an attack to kill a target, you may instead choose to reduce the target to 0 hit points, leaving it unconscious but alive. Normal rules for being at 0 hit points apply (see CR page 146).

feats_list.name: Burst Fire
feats_list.benefit_summary: When using autofire weapon in autofire mode, can fire short burst (-5 attack, +2 dice damage) at single target. Expends 5 shots. (Errata applied)
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When using a ranged weapon with autofire capability in autofire mode, you may fire a short burst as a single attack against a single target. You take a -5 penalty on the attack roll but deal +2 dice of damage. For example, a weapon that deals 3d10 points of damage deals 5d10 points of damage instead. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Deadeye or Rapid Shot feat. [CRB p.83, cite: 559-560]

effects.notes: Targets a single target. Does not stack with Deadeye or Rapid Shot.

feats_list.errata_applied: Prerequisites changed from 'Str 13, Weapon Proficiency (heavy weapons), proficient with weapon' to 'Proficient with heavy weapons, proficient with weapon'. Special text added regarding STR 13.
feats_list.full_text_description: When using a ranged weapon with autofire capability in autofire mode, you may fire a short burst as a single attack against a single target. You take a -5 penalty on the attack roll but deal +2 dice of damage. For example, a weapon that deals 3d10 points of damage deals 5d10 points of damage instead. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Deadeye or Rapid Shot feat. [[This is not an area attack]] Special: Firing a burst expends five shots and can only be done if the weapon has at least five shots remaining. If you do not have a Strength of 13 or higher, increase the penalty on attacks to –10 when using this feat with non-vehicle weapons. Normal: Autofire uses ten shots, targets a 2-square-by-2-square area, and can't be aimed at a specific target. Without this feat, if you attempt an autofire attack at a specific target, it simply counts as a normal attack and all the extra shots are wasted. SSotG: Vehicle weapons capable of autofire can be used with this feat normally. This is, in fact, the only time autofire attacks are useful in starship-scale combat.
feats_list.normal_text: Autofire uses ten shots, targets a 2-square-by-2-square area, and can't be aimed at a specific target. Without this feat, if you attempt an autofire attack at a specific target, it simply counts as a normal attack and all the extra shots are wasted. [CRB p.83, cite: 561]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Proficient with heavy weapons, proficient with weapon
feats_list.special_text: Firing a burst expends five shots and can only be done if the weapon has at least five shots remaining. If you do not have a Strength of 13 or higher, increase the penalty on attacks to –10 when using this feat with non-vehicle weapons. (Errata p.290)

feats_list.name: Burst of Speed
feats_list.benefit_summary: move action to move twice speed, -1 CT at end
feats_list.full_text_description: As a move action, you can move up to twice your speed. At the end of your movement, you move -1 step along the condition track.

feats_list.name: Careful Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: If you aim before making a ranged attack, gain +1 bonus on the attack roll.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: If you aim before making a ranged attack (see Aim on page 154), you gain a +1 bonus on your attack roll. [CRB p.83, cite: 561-562]
feats_list.full_text_description: If you aim before making a ranged attack (see Aim on page 154), you gain a +1 bonus on your attack roll. SSotG: Pilots can use these feats, but since they must spend at least one move action operating their vehicles, they must split their aim (two swift actions) and attack (standard action) into two separate turns, making it more likely that the target will break line of sight or otherwise avoid you. [[NOTE: Cannot use aim with area attacks.]]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Point Blank Shot, base attack bonus +2

feats_list.name: Channel Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/day expend use of Rage for +5 to Will Def for enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per day, instead of entering into a rage, you gain a +5 bonus to Will Defense until the end of the encounter. This bonus counts as using your rage ability for that day.

feats_list.name: Charging Fire
feats_list.benefit_summary: When charging, may make a ranged attack (no attack bonus) instead of melee. Still take -2 to Reflex Defense.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you charge, you may make a ranged attack instead of a melee attack at the end of your movement. Unlike a normal charge, your momentum does not help overcome your target, so you gain no bonus on attack roll. As with a normal charge, you still take a -2 penalty to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. [CRB p.83-84, cite: 562-563]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you charge, you may make a ranged attack instead of a melee attack at the end of your movement. Unlike a normal charge, your momentum does not help overcome your target, so you gain no bonus on attack roll. As with a normal charge, you still take a -2 penalty to your Reflex Defense. Normal: You can make a single melee attack with a +2 bonus on your attack roll at the end of a charge.
feats_list.normal_text: You can make a single melee attack with a +2 bonus on your attack roll at the end of a charge. [CRB p.84, cite: 563]

feats_list.name: Charging Fire + Dodge
feats_list.benefit_summary: Ref Def penalty -1 when making a ranged attack at end of charge

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can reduce your penalty to your Reflex Defense against all opponents to -1 when making a ranged attack at the end of a charge.

feats_list.name: Clawed Subspecies
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain claws 1d6 dam
feats_list.full_text_description: You have natural weapons in the form of claws. When you make an unarmed attack, you can use your claws, dealing 1d6 points of slashing damage with that attack instead of normal unarmed damage. You are always considered armed with your natural weapons.

feats_list.name: Cleave
feats_list.benefit_summary: If you drop an opponent with a melee attack, get an immediate extra melee attack against another opponent within reach (once per round). (Errata applied)
feats_list.benefit_text_long: If you deal an opponent enough damage to reduce its hit points to 0, you get an immediate extra melee attack against another opponent within your reach. The extra attack is with the same weapon and at the same bonus as the attack that dropped the previous opponent. You can use this ability once per round. [CRB p.84, cite: 563-564]
feats_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.299: Removed sentence 'You cannot adjust 1 square before making this extra attack.' [cite: 2018]
feats_list.full_text_description: If you deal an opponent enough damage to reduce its hit points to 0, you get an immediate extra melee attack against another opponent within your reach. The extra attack is with the same weapon and at the same bonus as the attack that dropped the previous opponent. You can use this ability once per round. [[Battle Strike damage is definitely limited to your next attack roll, so it seems that the damage bonus would NOT apply to the extra Cleave attack, since the Cleave attack would be your second attack. But I do think you can retain the +1 attack from Battle Strike to use with your Cleave attack. Cleave specifically says it's at the same attack bonus as the attack that dropped your first target. Basically, you retain attack bonuses, but not damage bonuses.]] Unleashed: When you deal enough damage to an opponent to reduce its hit points to 0, you can spend a Destiny Point to get an immediate extra melee attack against all opponents within your reach. This feat works in all other ways as the Cleave feat.
feats_list.special_text: Unleashed: When you deal enough damage to an opponent to reduce its hit points to 0, you can spend a Destiny Point to get an immediate extra melee attack against all opponents within your reach. This feat works in all other ways as the Cleave feat. (This 'Unleashed' text is from Force Unleashed Campaign Guide, not CRB.)

feats_list.name: Close Combat Escape
feats_list.benefit_summary: if escape grapple, swif action for single melee atk v. grappler

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully use Acrobatics to escape a grapple, you can spend a swift action to make a single attack with a melee weapon or an unarmed attack against the opponent that had grappled you. If the attack hits, it deals normal damage, and your opponent is considered flat-footed until the start of its next turn.

feats_list.name: Collateral Damage
feats_list.benefit_summary: with Rapid Shot make a 2nd atk at -2 w/in 2sq of target, deal half dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you deal damage with a single, non-area attack using the Rapid Shot feat, once per turn on your turn, you can immediately make a second attack at a -2 penalty against a second target within 2 squares of the first. If this attack hits, you deal half of the original attack's damage to that target.

feats_list.name: Combat Reflexes
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain additional attacks of opportunity equal to DEX modifier per round, and can make AoOs while flat-footed.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When opponents leave themselves open, you may make a number of additional attacks of opportunity equal to your Dexterity modifier. For example, a character with a Dexterity of 15 can make a total of three attacks of opportunity in a round: the one attack of opportunity every character is entitled to, plus two more attacks because of his +2 Dexterity bonus. You still only make one attack of opportunity on a single opponent for a single provoking action. With this feat, you may also make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed. [CRB p.84, cite: 564-565]
feats_list.full_text_description: When opponents leave themselves open, you may make a number of additional attacks of opportunity equal to your Dexterity modifier. For example, a character with a Dexterity of 15 can make a total of three attacks of opportunity in a round: the one attack of opportunity every character is entitled to, plus two more attacks because of his +2 Dexterity bonus. If four stormtroopers move through the character's threatened area, he can make attacks of opportunity against three of the four. You still only make one attack of opportunity on a single opponent. With this feat, you may also make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed. Normal: A character without the Combat Reflexes feat can make only one attack of opportunity per round and can't make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed. (See Attacks of Opportunity, page 155, for more information.)
feats_list.normal_text: A character without the Combat Reflexes feat can make only one attack of opportunity per round and can't make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed. (See Attacks of Opportunity, page 155, for more information.) [CRB p.84, cite: 565]

feats_list.name: Combat Trickery
feats_list.benefit_summary: spend 2 swif on same turn for Deception v. Will Def for target to be flat-footed v. your next atk, spend FP for until end of enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can spend two successive swift actions on the same turn to make a Deception check against a target’s Will Defense [[feint?]]. If the check is successful, the target is flat-footed against your next attack made before the end of your next turn. Additionally, you can spend a Force Point [[to make your target flat-footed against your next attack before the end of the encounter. It has been suggested that spending a FP will make your target flat-footed against your next attack before the end of the encounter, after which, the target will no longer be flat-footed.]]

feats_list.name: Conditioning
feats_list.benefit_summary: reroll Str & Con skills trained in (must take re-roll) & 1/encounter add Str to Fort
feats_list.full_text_description: You can reroll any Strength- or Constitution-based skill checks for skills that you are trained in (Climb, Endurance, Jump, Swim). The result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. Additionally, once per encounter you can add your Strength bonus to your Fortitude Defense as a reaction; this bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Confident Success
feats_list.benefit_summary: when successfully use Learn Secret Info gain Force Point up to 3 & max

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you successfully use the Learn Secret Information application of the Gather Information skill, you gain 1 Force Point. You cannot gain more than 3 Force Points each level, and you cannot have more Force Points than you gained when you reached your current level.

feats_list.name: Controlled Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: enter Rage as free action, end 1 round after you want to
feats_list.full_text_description: You can enter a rage as a free action. Your rage ends 1 round after you declare it is finished. Normal: You must use a swift action to begin a rage and may not end it at will. Special: You may not use this feat to extend the number of rounds of rage available to your character.

feats_list.name: Coordinated Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: Automatically succeed with Aid Another action for ally's attack or to suppress enemy if target is adjacent or point blank.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are automatically successful when using the aid another action to aid an ally's attack or suppress an enemy as long as the target is adjacent to you or within point blank range. [CRB p.84, cite: 566]
feats_list.full_text_description: You are automatically successful when using the aid another action to aid an ally's attack or suppress an enemy as long as the target is adjacent to you or within point blank range. Normal: You must make an attack roll against a Reflex Defense of 10 to gain the benefits of the aid another action.
feats_list.normal_text: You must make an attack roll against a Reflex Defense of 10 to gain the benefits of the aid another action. [CRB p.84, cite: 566]

feats_list.name: Coordinated Barrage
feats_list.benefit_summary: when aid for every 3 over Ref Def +1 die dam (+5 max)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you aid an ally's attack, for every 3 points that the ally's attack roll beats the target's Reflex Defense, the attack deals +1 die of damage. The maximum number of bonus damage dice the attack receives is equal to the number of allies with this feat that aided on the attack roll or +5 dice, whichever is lower. SSotG: You may use this feat to aid an ally's attack. You can't use the aid another action to suppress a vehicle, but you can suppress an individual gunner (such as the lead gunner for a single weapon battery). You may use this feat even if you are using the aid another action as a sensor operator using a Use Computer check or a commander using a Knowledge (tactics) check.

feats_list.name: Cornered
feats_list.benefit_summary: when threatened & unable to withdraw +2 Atk against opponents

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are threatened by an opponent and unable to take the withdraw action, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against opponents that threaten you.

feats_list.name: Covert Operatives (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Stealth & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), when moving your spd or more penalties reduced by 2

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Stealth checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when moving more than your speed or more than twice your speed, reduce the penalties to Stealth checks by 2.

feats_list.name: Critical Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: 2 swif for crit range +1 on next melee Atk, no other actions before

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can take two consecutive swift actions in the same round to increase the critical range of your next melee attack by 1. Thus, if a weapon scores a critical hit on a natural 20, it can score a critical hit on a natural roll of 19 or 20 instead. However, any roll other than a natural 20 is not considered an automatic hit; if you roll a natural 19 and miss the target, you do not score a critical hit. You lose the benefits of Critical Strike if you lose line of sight to your target or if you take any other action before making your attack.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: BAB +9, Weapon Focus (chosen melee weapon), proficient with chosen melee weapon*

feats_list.name: Crossfire
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/round, if you miss v. soft cover, make attack v. soft cover

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you miss when making a ranged attack against a target that has soft cover (that is, cover provided by another character, creature, or droid), you can immediately make an attack roll (with the same weapon and at the same attack bonus) against the target that is providing the soft cover. You can use this feat only once per round.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: BAB +6, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot

feats_list.name: Crush
feats_list.benefit_summary: If you successfully pin an opponent with a grapple attack, can immediately deal unarmed/claw damage.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: If you successfully pin an opponent with a grapple attack (see the Pin feat, page 87), you can immediately deal bludgeoning damage to it equal to your unarmed damage or claw damage, whichever is greater. [CRB p.84, cite: 567]
feats_list.full_text_description: If you successfully pin an opponent with a grapple attack (see the Pin feat, page 87), you can immediately deal bludgeoning damage to it equal to your unarmed damage or claw damage, whichever is greater. [Works with Martial Arts to increase damage, but not with Sneak Attack.]

feats_list.name: Cunning Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 Atk v. flat-footed or any denied Dex to Ref Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against a flat-footed enemy or one who is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense.

feats_list.name: Cut the Red Tape
feats_list.benefit_summary: Knowledge (bureaucracy) replaces Gather Info & considered trained

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use your Knowledge (bureaucracy) modifier instead of your Gather Information modifier when making Gather Information checks. If you are entitled to a Gather Information check reroll, you can reroll your Knowledge (bureaucracy) check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations). You are considered trained in the Gather Information skill for the purposes of this check.

feats_list.name: Cybernetic Surgery
feats_list.benefit_summary: Can install cybernetic prosthesis on living being (DC 20 Treat Injury, 1 hour).
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can install a cybernetic prosthesis (see page 137) on a living being. The surgical procedure takes 1 hour of uninterrupted work, after which you must make on a DC 20 Treat Injury check. If the check succeeds, the prosthesis is installed correctly. If the check fails, the prosthesis is not properly installed; however, you can try again after another uninterrupted hour of surgery. [CRB p.84, cite: 567-568]

effects.details: DC 20 Treat Injury check, takes 1 hour. Failure allows retry.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can install a cybernetic prosthesis (see CR page 137) on a living being. The surgical procedure takes 1 hour of uninterrupted work, after which you must make on a DC 20 Treat Injury check. If the check succeeds, the prosthesis is installed correctly. If the check fails, the prosthesis is not properly installed; however, you can try again after another uninterrupted hour of surgery. Special: You can install a cybernetic prosthesis on yourself, but you take a -5 penalty on the Treat Injury skill check. If you have the Surgical Expertise feat (see CR page 88), you can install a cybernetic prosthesis in 10 minutes instead of 1 hour.
feats_list.special_text: You can install a cybernetic prosthesis on yourself, but you take a -5 penalty on the Treat Injury skill check. If you have the Surgical Expertise feat (see page 88), you can install a cybernetic prosthesis in 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. [CRB p.85, cite: 568-569]

feats_list.name: Damage Conversion
feats_list.benefit_summary: if dam from atk (not area, ion, or Force) equals or exceeds thresh can take 10 dam & not move down CT (each additional use increases dam by 5)
feats_list.full_text_description: When you take damage from an attack against you (other than an area attack, or an attack that deals ion or Force damage) and that damage equals or exceeds your damage threshold, you can take an additional 10 points of damage instead of moving down the condition track. Each subsequent time you use this feat in a single encounter, the additional damage you take increases by 5 points.

feats_list.name: Darkness Dweller
feats_list.benefit_summary: enemy that makes Stealth check w/in 10 sq of you is -2

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Any enemy that makes a Stealth check within 10 squares of you takes a -2 penalty to the check. This penalty does not stack with the same penalty imposed by other characters with this feat.

feats_list.name: Deadeye
feats_list.benefit_summary: If you aim before a ranged attack and hit, increase damage by one additional weapon die.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: If you aim before making a ranged attack (see Aim, page 154) and the attack hits, increase the damage you deal by an additional weapon die. For example, if you score a hit with a blaster pistol using the Deadeye feat, the blaster shot deals 4d6 points of damage (instead of the normal 3d6 points). The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Burst Fire or Rapid Shot feat. [CRB p.85, cite: 569-570]

effects.notes: Dice type matches weapon. Does not stack with Burst Fire or Rapid Shot damage bonus.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you aim before making a ranged attack (see Aim, page 154) and the attack hits, increase the damage you deal by an additional weapon die. For example, if you score a hit with a blaster pistol using the Deadeye feat, the blaster shot deals 4d6 points of damage (instead of the normal 3d6 points). The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Burst Fire or Rapid Shot feat. [[NOTE: Cannot use aim with area attacks]]. SSotG: Pilots can use these feats, but since they must spend at least one move action operating their vehicles, they must split their aim (two swift actions) and attack (standard action) into two separate turns, making it more likely that the target will break line of sight or otherwise avoid you.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4

feats_list.name: Deadly Sniper
feats_list.benefit_summary: if target is unaware of you +2 Atk & +1 die dam on first attack

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack against a target that is unaware of you, you gain a +2 bonus on your attack roll and deal +1 die of damage on the first attack each turn. [[A target is usually unaware if you surprise him]]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: BAB +9, Sniper, trained in Stealth, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot

feats_list.name: Deceptive Drop
feats_list.benefit_summary: in surprise rnd if you dam flat-foot opp they are prone if over FortDef

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: During the surprise round, if you damage a flat-footed target, that target is also knocked prone if your attack roll also exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense. The target adds its size modifier to its Fortitude Defense: Colossal, +50; Gargantuan, +20; Huge, +10; Large, +5; Medium and smaller, +0.

feats_list.name: Deep Sight
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain darkvision

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain darkvision, ignoring concealment (including total concealment) from darkness. You cannot perceive colors in total darkness.

feats_list.name: Deft Charge
feats_list.benefit_summary: after you charge, you may take swif, reac & free actions
feats_list.full_text_description: After you charge, you can take swift actions, reactions, and free actions before your turn ends. Normal: Without this feat, charging ends your turn immediately after the attack is resolved.

feats_list.name: Demoralizing Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you dam target with AoO = free Persuasion to intimidate them
feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully deal damage to an opponent with an attack of opportunity, you can immediately make a Persuasion check to intimidate the opponent as a free action.

feats_list.name: Desperate Gambit
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/turn if miss Atk, reroll w/ -2 RefDef until end next turn, nat 1=-5 (must take re-roll)
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per turn when you miss on an attack roll, you reroll the attack, but you take a -2 penalty to Reflex Defense until the end of your next turn. If your first attack missed because you rolled a natural 1, you can still use this feat, but you take a -5 penalty to Reflex Defense instead. You must accept the result of the second roll, even if it's worse than the first.

feats_list.name: Destructive Force
feats_list.benefit_summary: deal 1 die dam to all targets & allies adjacent to a vehicle or object you reduce to 0 hp or equal or exceed thresh

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you deal damage to an object or vehicle that equals or exceeds the target's damage threshold and reduces the target to 0 hit points, you deal 1 die of damage (of the same type as the damage used in the attack) to all targets, including allies, that are adjacent to the vehicle or object.

feats_list.name: Devastating Bellow
feats_list.benefit_summary: bellow atk deals 4d6 dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Your bellow attack deals 4d6 points of damage on a hit and half damage on a miss. Normal: Without this feat, your bellow attack deals 3d6 points of damage on a hit.

feats_list.name: Disabler
feats_list.benefit_summary: Ion Grenade 3sq burst, Ion Pistol dam dice d8, Ion Rifle is accurate

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack with an ion weapon, you gain one of the following benefits, depending on the kind of weapon you use. Ion Grenade: When you use an ion grenade, the grenade's burst radius is 3 squares instead of 2 squares. Ion Pistol: When you use an ion pistol, the damage dice increase from d6 to d8. Ion Rifle: You treat the ion rifle as an accurate weapon.

feats_list.name: Disarming Charm
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you successfully change attitude, +2 Deception & Persuasion v. target for next 24 hours

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you successfully use the Change Attitude application of the Persuasion skill to change a target's attitude, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all Deception or Persuasion checks against that target for the next 24 hours.

feats_list.name: Distracting Droid
feats_list.benefit_summary: as stan action, Persuasion v. Will Def of all w/in 6 sq & enemy loses 1 move & if by 10 or more enemy flat-footed
feats_list.full_text_description: As a standard action, make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of all enemies that are within 6 squares of you and that can see or hear you, as determined appropriate by the Gamemaster. If the check equals or exceeds an enemy's Will Defense, the enemy loses one move action on its next turn. If the attack exceeds an enemy's Will Defense by 10 or more, the enemy is also flat-footed until the start of your next turn. This is a mind-affecting effect.

feats_list.name: Disturbing Presence
feats_list.benefit_summary: DC 15 Deception check to "tumble" through threatened area, move x2
feats_list.full_text_description: If you succeed on a DC 15 Deception check, you can move through the threatened area or fighting space of an enemy as part of your move action without provoking an attack of opportunity. Each threatened square or occupied square that you move through in this manner counts as 2 squares of movement. Normal: You can tumble through an occupied enemy square only by using the Acrobatics skill.

feats_list.name: Dive for Cover
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/turn as reac when targeted by ranged atk make horizontal Jump to gain cover & land prone

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per turn, as a reaction to being targeted by a ranged attack, you can make a Jump check to jump horizontally. If you land in a square that provides you with cover from your attacker, you gain the normal cover bonus against the attack, even if you didn't have cover at the time the attack was made. When you use this feat, you always land prone. [Dev: Q. Does the Dive For Cover feat make you immune to the incoming attack if you dive behind full cover? A. Yes.]

feats_list.name: Dodge
feats_list.benefit_summary: Designate an opponent to receive a +1 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against their attacks.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: During your turn, you designate an opponent and receive a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense against attacks from that opponent. You can select a new opponent on any action. A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. [CRB p.85, cite: 570-571]

effects.notes: Can select new opponent on any action. Lost if DEX bonus to Reflex Defense is lost. Dodge bonuses stack.

feats_list.full_text_description: During your turn, you designate an opponent and receive a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense against attacks from that opponent. You can select a new opponent on any action. A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. SSotG: The pilot of a vehicle may use Dodge to grant the vehicle a +1 dodge bonus against a single opponent (whether a vehicle or a single character). [[Can be used by a mount. *Weak feat option: Instead of designating a single opponent you may designate either a single opponent, all ranged attacks, or all melee attacks against which you gain the +1 Reflex Defense.]]

feats_list.name: Dodge + Charging Fire
feats_list.benefit_summary: Ref Def penalty -1 when making a ranged attack at end of charge

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can reduce your penalty to your Reflex Defense against all opponents to -1 when making a ranged attack at the end of a charge.

feats_list.name: Dodge + Running Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: add Dodge bonus to Ref Def v. Atk of opp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can add your Dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense against anyone who makes an attack of opportunity against you while using the Running Attack feat.

feats_list.name: Double Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: Choose a weapon group/exotic weapon. When using full attack with it, make one additional attack, but take -5 on all attacks this turn.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: Choose a single exotic weapon or one of the following weapon groups: advanced melee weapons, heavy weapons, lightsabers, pistols, rifles, simple weapons. When you use the full attack action, you may make one additional attack when wielding such a weapon. However, you take a -5 penalty on all attack rolls until your next turn because you're trading precision for speed. [CRB p.85, cite: 571-572]
feats_list.full_text_description: Choose a single exotic weapon or one of the following weapon groups: advanced melee weapons, heavy weapons, lightsabers, pistols, rifles, simple weapons. When you use the full attack action, you may make one additional attack when wielding such a weapon. However, you take a -5 penalty on all attack rolls until your next turn because you're trading precision for speed. Normal: Making a single attack is a standard action. Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you select this feat, it applies to a different exotic weapon or weapon group. SSotG: If you take these feats with heavy weapons, they work normally with vehicle weapons.
feats_list.normal_text: Making a single attack is a standard action. [CRB p.85, cite: 572]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +6, proficient with chosen weapon
feats_list.special_text: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you select this feat, it applies to a different exotic weapon or weapon group. [CRB p.85, cite: 572]

feats_list.name: Dreadful Countenance
feats_list.benefit_summary: Persuasion or Use the Force for fear effect, may reroll (must take re-roll)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can reroll any Persuasion or Use the Force check made to activate a fear effect. The result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse.

feats_list.name: Dreadful Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: While raging, your rage bonus on melee attack and damage rolls increases to +5.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: While raging, your rage bonus on melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls increases to +5. [CRB p.85, cite: 572-573]
feats_list.full_text_description: While raging, your rage bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls increases to +5. Normal: A character with the rage species trait gains a +2 rage bonus on melee attack rolls and damage rolls while raging.
feats_list.normal_text: A character with the rage species trait gains a +2 rage bonus on melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls while raging. [CRB p.85, cite: 573]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Rage species trait, base attack bonus +1

feats_list.name: Droid Focus
feats_list.benefit_summary: +1 to Deception, Mechanics, Perception, Persuasion, Use Computer on or against droid & +1 to all Def v. attacks & skill checks made by droids

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +1 bonus to Deception, Mechanics, Perception, Persuasion, and Use Computer checks when used on or against a droid of the selected degree, and a +1 bonus to all defenses against attack rolls and skill checks made by droids of the selected degree. Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different degree of droid.

feats_list.name: Droid Hunter
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 dam v. droids, +4 dam v, droids with ion

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.
