feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls against droid enemies, or +4 if you are using a weapon that deals ion damage.

feats_list.name: Droid Shield Mastery
feats_list.benefit_summary: automatically restore SR by 5 & with only 2 swif actions

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You automatically succeed on Endurance checks to restore your shield rating by 5 points (up to your normal shield rating). Additionally, you replenish your shields in two swift actions. Normal: Three swift actions and a DC 20 Endurance check are normally required to restore lost shield power (see page 197 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

feats_list.name: Droidcraft
feats_list.benefit_summary: repair droids in 10 minutes not 1 hour

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can perform repairs on a droid in 10 minutes. Normal: Repairing a droid typically takes I hour (see the Mechanics skill, page 70 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

feats_list.name: Dual Weapon Mastery I
feats_list.benefit_summary: When attacking with two weapons or a double weapon (full attack), take -5 penalty on all attacks instead of -10.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you attack with two weapons or with both ends of a double weapon as a part of a full attack action, you take a -5 penalty (instead of a -10 penalty) on all attack rolls until the start of your next turn. You only gain this reduced penalty if you are wielding a weapon with which you are proficient. [CRB p.85, cite: 573]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you attack with two weapons or with both ends of a double weapon as a part of a full attack action, you take a -5 penalty (instead of a-10 penalty) on all attack rolls until the start of your next turn. You only gain this reduced penalty if you are wielding a weapon with which you are proficient. Normal: If you use a full attack action to make more than one attack on your turn (see Full Attack, page 154), you take a -10 penalty on all attack rolls for the round. feats_list.normal_text: If you use a full attack action to make more than one attack on your turn (see Full Attack, page 154), you take a -10 penalty on all attack rolls for the round. [CRB p.85, cite: 574]

feats_list.name: Dual Weapon Mastery I + Quick Draw
feats_list.benefit_summary: draw or holster 2 weapons as single swif action

feats_list.full_text_description: You can draw or holster two weapons with a single swift action; you must have both hands free to draw both weapons, and each weapon must be able to be held in one hand.

feats_list.name: Dual Weapon Mastery III
feats_list.benefit_summary: When attacking with two weapons or a double weapon (full attack), take no penalty on attack rolls.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: When you wield two weapons or attack with both ends of a double weapon as a part of a full attack action, you take no penalty on your attack rolls. You only gain this benefit if you are wielding a weapon with which you are proficient. [CRB p.85, cite: 576-577]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you wield two weapons or attack with both ends of a double weapon as a part of a full attack action, you take no penalty on your attack rolls. feats_list.name: Duck and Cover
feats_list.benefit_summary: if area attack misses 1/turn you can move 2 sq as a reac, no atk opp
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are the target of an area attack that misses, once per turn you can move 2 squares as a reaction. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

feats_list.name: Echani Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: dam bonus from Str x2 if make only one unarmed Atk, 1/enc when deal dam, make unarmed Atk to knock prone, w/Expertise talent w/crit target is knocked prone if not more than 1 size larger

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you make only one unarmed attack during your turn, you can double the damage bonus to that attack provided by your Strength modifier (minimum +1). Once per encounter when you deal damage to a target with an unarmed attack, you can immediately make an unarmed attack against the target's Fortitude Defense as a free action. If successful, you knock the target to the ground (prone) in its current square, provided that the target is no more than one size larger than you. Special: Targets gain a bonus to Fortitude Defense against being knocked prone based on their size: Medium or smaller, +0; Large, +5; Huge, +10; Gargantuan, +20; and Colossal, +50. In addition, unusually stable creatures (such as those with four legs) gain a +5 bonus to their Fortitude Defense against being knocked prone. If you have the Echani Expertise talent (see the Martial Arts Forms talent tree on page 32), whenever you score a critical hit with an unarmed attack, the target is immediately knocked to the ground (prone) in its current square, provided that the target is no more than one size larger than you.

feats_list.name: Echani Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: dam bonus from Str x2 if make only one unarmed Atk, 1/enc when deal dam, make unarmed Atk to knock prone

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can double the damage bonus provided by your Strength bonus to unarmed attacks (minimum +1) provided you make only one unarmed attack this turn. [[You can still make AoO's if these are done when it's not your turn]] Once per encounter when you deal damage to a target with an unarmed attack you may make an immediate unarmed attack against the target's Fortitude Defense as a free action; if successful you knock your opponent to the ground (prone) in their current square, provided they are one size larger than you or smaller. Special: Targets gain a bonus to Fortitude Defense against being knocked prone based on their size: Large +5, Huge +10, Gargantuan +20, Colossal +50. Unusually stable creatures (such as those with four legs) gain a +5 bonus to their Fortitude Defense against being knocked prone as well.

feats_list.name: Elder's Knowledge
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc replace Wisdom or Wisdom-related check with Know (social science) or (galactic lore)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can substitute a Knowledge (social sciences) or Knowledge (galactic lore) check for a Wisdom or Wisdom related check. [[ie, You replace the Wis-related check with the skill check. Perception, Survival, or Treat Injury?]]

feats_list.name: Erratic Target
feats_list.benefit_summary: reduce spd by 1 or 2 to increase Dodge +1 or +2, must move 2 sq
feats_list.full_text_description: You can reduce your speed by up to 2 squares to increase your Dodge bonus by 1 for each square of speed you give up, until the start of your next turn. You must move at least 2 squares to gain this benefit.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: equipped with hovering locomotion or flying locomotion

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid, equipped with hovering locomotion or flying locomotion, Dex 13, Dodge.

feats_list.name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
feats_list.benefit_summary: Choose one exotic weapon (e.g., bowcaster, amphistaff). You can use that weapon without penalty.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: Choose an exotic weapon, such as bowcaster or atlatl (see Exotic Weapons, page 119). You understand how to use that type of exotic weapon in combat. You make attack rolls with the weapon normally. [CRB p.85, cite: 577-578]

effects.notes: Benefit applies to one chosen exotic weapon.

feats_list.full_text_description: Choose an exotic weapon, such as bowcaster or atlatl (see Exotic Weapons, page 119). You understand how to use that type of exotic weapon in combat. You make attack rolls with the weapon normally. Normal: A character who uses a weapon without being proficient with it takes a -5 penalty on attack rolls. Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different weapon.
feats_list.normal_text: A character who uses a weapon without being proficient with it takes a -5 penalty on attack rolls. [CRB p.85, cite: 578]
feats_list.special_text: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different weapon. [CRB p.85, cite: 578]

feats_list.name: Experienced Medic
feats_list.benefit_summary: perform surgery on number = to Int mod (2 min), check individually

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can perform surgery (see page 74 of the Saga Edition core rulebook) on a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence bonus (minimum 2) simultaneously. You make Treat Injury checks for each individual creature as normal.

feats_list.name: Expert Briber
feats_list.benefit_summary: reduce Persuasion's Haggle DC by 10

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the Haggle application of the Persuasion skill (see page 71 of the Saga Edition core rulebook), you reduce the DC reduce the price of the item haggled over by 10.

feats_list.name: Expert Droid Repair
feats_list.benefit_summary: repair droids = to Int mod (minimum 2)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can repair a number of droids equal to your Intelligence bonus (minimum 2) simultaneously. You make Mechanics checks for each droid as normal.

feats_list.name: Extra Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: Can rage one additional time per day.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can fly into a rage more often. You can rage one additional time per day. [CRB p.86, cite: 578-579]
feats_list.full_text_description: You can rage one additional time per day. Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you can rage an additional time per day.
feats_list.special_text: You can take this feat multiple times; each time you take the feat, you can rage one additional time per day. [CRB p.86, cite: 579]

feats_list.name: Extra Second Wind
feats_list.benefit_summary: Can catch second wind one additional time per day (still only once per encounter).
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You tend to come back from the edge of oblivion more often. You can catch your second wind one additional time per day, but you can still only catch a second wind once per encounter (see Second Wind, page 146). [CRB p.86, cite: 579]
feats_list.full_text_description: You can catch your second wind one additional time per day, but you can still only catch a second wind once per encounter (see Second Wind, page 146). Normal: A hero can catch his or her second wind once per day. Special: A nonheroic character that takes this feat for the first time can catch a second wind once per day. You can take this feat multiple times; each time you take this feat, you can catch a second wind one additional time per day.
feats_list.normal_text: A hero can catch his or her second wind once per day. [CRB p.86, cite: 579]
feats_list.special_text: A nonheroic character that takes this feat for the first time can catch a second wind once per day. You can take this feat multiple times; each time you take this feat, you can catch a second wind one additional time per day. [CRB p.86, cite: 580]

feats_list.name: Far Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: Range categories for ranged attacks are considered one less (e.g., short range has no penalty, medium is -2, long is -5).
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are better at shooting distant foes. When you use a ranged weapon against targets at short, medium, or long range, the range category is considered one less. In other words, you take no penalty on ranged attack rolls against targets at short range, a -2 penalty on ranged attack rolls made against targets at medium range, and a -5 penalty on a ranged attack rolls made against targets at long range. [CRB p.86, cite: 580-581]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you use a ranged weapon against targets at short, medium, or long range, the range category is considered one less. In other words, you take no penalty on ranged attack rolls against targets at short range, a -2 penalty on ranged attack rolls made against targets at medium range, and a -5 penalty on a ranged attack rolls made against targets at long range. Normal: When making a ranged attack roll, a character takes a -2 penalty against targets at short range, a -5 penalty against targets at medium range, and a -10 penalty against targets at long range. [Does not work with Redirect Shot.] SSotG: This feat works normally with vehicle weapons. However, if you are using a missile or a torpedo and you miss with your attack roll, the projectile does not gain the benefit of this feat for the second attack roll.
feats_list.normal_text: When making a ranged attack roll, a character takes a -2 penalty against targets at short range, a -5 penalty against targets at medium range, and a -10 penalty against targets at long range. [CRB p.86, cite: 581]

feats_list.name: Fast Surge
feats_list.benefit_summary: catch second wind as free not swif
feats_list.full_text_description: On your turn, you can catch a second wind as a free action instead of as a swift action.

feats_list.name: Fast Swimmer
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 swim spd

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Your swim speed increases by 2 squares.

feats_list.name: Fatal Hit
feats_list.benefit_summary: if your attack drops target to 0 hp you can kill them even if not over thresh, perform coup-de-grace as stan

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When your attack drops a target to 0 hit points, you may choose to automatically kill that enemy even if the damage dealt does not exceed the target's damage threshold. In addition, you can perform the coup de grace action as a standard action. Normal: A creature that drops to 0 hit points becomes unconscious if the damage dealt does not exceed its damage threshold. Performing a coup de grace is a full-round action.

feats_list.name: Feat of Strength
feats_list.benefit_summary: take 20 on trained Str skill check as full, DC15 Endurance to use again

effects.target_description: trained str skill check as full, dc15 endurance to use again

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter as a full-round action, you can take 20 on a single Strength check or Strength-based skill check (Climb, Jump, Swim; you must be trained in the skill), even if you are distracted or threatened. Normal: You may not take 20 when distracted or threatened, or in a single round. Special: After using this feat for the first time in a given encounter, make a DC 15 Endurance check (as a free action). If the check succeeds, you can use this feat once more during the same encounter.

feats_list.name: Fight Through Pain
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use Will Def instead of Fort Def to determine thresh

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use your Will Defense instead of your Fortitude Defense when determining your damage threshold.

feats_list.name: Flash and Clear
feats_list.benefit_summary: if damage opponent with burst or splash, gain concealment

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you damage a target with a burst or splash weapon, you gain concealment against that target until the beginning of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Flawless Pilot
feats_list.benefit_summary: always keep the better result on a Pilot reroll

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll a Pilot check, you always keep the better result, even if you have multiple reroll abilities.

feats_list.name: Fleet-Footed
feats_list.benefit_summary: if move before & after attack increase speed 2 sq
feats_list.full_text_description: If you move both before and after you make an attack using the Running Attack feat, your speed is increased by 2 squares until the end of your turn.

feats_list.name: Flood of Fire
feats_list.benefit_summary: with autofire targets lose all dodge or deflection bonuses

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make an area attack with a weapon set on autofire, all targets in the area lose all dodge or deflection bonuses to Reflex Defense against the autofire attack. [[NOTE: Does not lose Dex bonus to Ref]]

feats_list.name: Flurry
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 Atk melee with light weapons or lightsabers, -5 Ref Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When wielding only light weapons or lightsabers, you can make a flurry of attacks. You take a -5 penalty to your Reflex Defense, but you gain a +2 bonus on your melee attack rolls. The bonus on attacks and penalty to Reflex Defense apply until the start of your next turn. Special: You can use this feat in the place of the Point Blank Shot feat to qualify for the elite trooper prestige class.

feats_list.name: Flèche
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc when you charge nat 17-20 is a critical

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when you charge, you can turn any natural attack roll of 17+ into a critical hit.

feats_list.name: Focused Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use concentration skills with Rage at -5 penalty

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: While raging, you can use skills that require patience and concentration, at a -5 penalty. Normal: While raging, you cannot use skills that require patience and concentration, such as Mechanics, Stealth, or Use the Force.

feats_list.name: Follow Through
feats_list.benefit_summary: if reduce opp to 0 hp with melee atk can move your speed, with Cleave can move 1st
feats_list.full_text_description: If you deal enough damage to your opponent with a melee attack to reduce it to 0 hit points, you can immediately move up to your speed. You can use this ability once per turn. Special: If you have the Cleave feat, you can move up to your speed before making the extra melee attack granted by the Cleave feat.

feats_list.name: Force Boon
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain three additional Force Points at each level.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are able to draw upon the Force more often than less skilled users. You gain three additional Force Points at each level. [CRB p.86, cite: 581-582]
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain three additional Force Points at each level.

feats_list.name: Force Readiness
feats_list.benefit_summary: spend Force Points as free action out of turn
feats_list.full_text_description: You can spend Force Points as a free action, even if it is not your turn. All other restrictions to Force Point use still apply. Normal: Unless otherwise specified, you can spend Force Points only on your turn, preventing you from enhancing attacks and skill checks made as reactions.

feats_list.name: Force Regimen Mastery
feats_list.benefit_summary: Learn a number of Force Regimens = 1 + Wis mod (min one)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You learn a number of Force regimens (see JATM page 10) equal to 1+ your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Special: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you take this feat, you learn a number of additional Force regimens equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). If your Wisdom modifier permanently increases, you immediately gain a number of Force regimens equal to the number of Force Regimen Mastery feats you have taken.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Force Sensitivity, Trained in Use Force

feats_list.name: Force Sensitivity
feats_list.benefit_summary: Can make Use the Force checks; Use the Force is a class skill. Can select Force Talents.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are Force-sensitive, allowing you to call on the Force and learn to draw on its power. You can make Use the Force checks, and Use the Force is considered a class skill for you. In addition, whenever you gain a new talent, you have the option of selecting a Force talent instead. You must meet the prerequisites of the Force talent to select it (see Force Talents, page 100). [CRB p.86, cite: 582-583]
feats_list.full_text_description: You can make Use the Force checks, and Use the Force is considered a class skill for you. In addition, whenever you gain a new talent, you have the option of selecting a Force talent instead. You must meet the prerequisites of the Force talent to select it (see Force Talents, CR page 100). Normal: You can't make Use the Force checks (page 77) or select Force talents unless you have the Force Sensitivity feat.
feats_list.normal_text: You can't make Use the Force checks (page 77) or select Force talents unless you have the Force Sensitivity feat. [CRB p.86, cite: 583]

feats_list.name: Force Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: Learn Force powers equal to 1 + WIS modifier (min 1). Can select the same power multiple times.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You learn one or more Force powers (see Force Powers, page 95). You add to your Force power suite a number of Force powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You can add the same power more than once. [CRB p.86, cite: 583]
feats_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.290: Benefit for taking feat multiple times clarified to '1 + your Wisdom modifier' new powers.
feats_list.full_text_description: You add to your Force power suite a number of Force powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You can add the same power more than once. Special: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you take this feat, you add to your Force suite a number of new Force powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier. If your Wisdom modifier permanently increases, you immediately gain a number of Force powers equal to the number of Force Training feats you have taken.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Force Sensitivity, trained in the Use the Force skill
feats_list.special_text: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you take this feat, you add to your Force suite a number of new Force powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier. If your Wisdom modifier permanently increases, you immediately gain a number of Force powers equal to the number of Force Training feats you have taken. (Errata p.290 clarifies the number of powers gained on taking the feat again is 1 + WIS mod). [CRB p.86, cite: 584]

feats_list.name: Force Training + Improved Disarm
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain +5 from Improved Disarm on Use the Force check

effects.target_description: improved disarm on use the force check

feats_list.full_text_description: When you use the Force disarm Force Power, you gain the +5 bonus from Improved Disarm on your Use the Force check as though you were making an attack roll.

feats_list.name: Force of Personality
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use either Wis or Cha mod to determine Will Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use either your Wisdom modifier or your Charisma modifier to determine your Will Defense.

feats_list.name: Forceful Blast
feats_list.benefit_summary: if dam a Large or smaller creature with a grenade or thermal detonator compare to Fort Def & can move target(s) 1 sq in any direction as free
feats_list.full_text_description: When you damage a Large or smaller creature with a grenade or thermal detonator, compare the result of your attack roll to the target's Fortitude Defense. If your result equals or exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, you can move the target 1 square in any direction as a free action. If the grenade or thermal detonator deals damage to multiple eligible creatures, you can use this benefit against all of them. You can't move a target that's being grabbed or grappled, and you can't move a target into a solid object or into another creature's fighting space. [Dev: Bantha Herder and Forceful Blast are meant to be mutually exclusive]

feats_list.name: Forceful Recovery
feats_list.benefit_summary: When you use second wind, return a force power already used also

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you catch a second wind, choose one expended Force power and return that power to your Force suite.

feats_list.name: Forest Stalker
feats_list.benefit_summary: always keep the better result on a Stealth reroll

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll a Stealth check, you always keep the better result, even if you have multiple reroll abilities.

feats_list.name: Fortifying Recovery
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you recover gain hp = 2 x Con mod (min 2)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you take the recover action, you also gain a number of bonus hit points equal to 2x your Constitution bonus (minimum 2). Damage is subtracted from the bonus hit points first, and any bonus hit points remaining at the end of the encounter are lost. Bonus hit points do not stack.

feats_list.name: Friends in Low Places
feats_list.benefit_summary: to acquire license Gather Info replaces Know (bureaucracy)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you would acquire a license for a restricted or military object, you can substitute a Gather Information check for a Knowledge (bureaucracy) check. Reduce the black-market cost multiplier of such items by 1.  [ie, use GI instead of Know (bureau)]

feats_list.name: Frightening Cleave
feats_list.benefit_summary: after use Cleave each enemy w/in 6sq & LOS -1 Ref Def, atk, skill until end of enc, stacks to -5

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Immediately after you use the Cleave feat, each enemy within 6 squares of you and within your line of sight takes a -1 penalty to its Reflex Defense, attack rolls, and skill checks against you until the end of the encounter. This penalty stacks to a maximum of -5. This is a mind-affecting effect.

feats_list.name: Fringe Benefits
feats_list.benefit_summary: whenever you buy black market goods reduce multiplier by 2 (min x1)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you buy goods on the black market, reduce the cost multiplier by 2 (for example, from x5 to x3), to a minimum of xl.

feats_list.name: Galactic Alliance Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: do not move down CT first time in an encounter
feats_list.full_text_description: You do not move down the condition track the first time an attack exceeds your damage threshold in an encounter.

feats_list.name: Gearhead
feats_list.benefit_summary: full = stan, stan = move, move = swif, mult swif = swif, full+ = half -10
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can make Mechanics and Use Computer checks more quickly than normal. A check requiring a full-round action can be attempted as a standard action, a check requiring a standard action can be attempted as a move action, and a check requiring a move action can be attempted as a swift action. Checks requiring multiple swift actions can be reduced by one swift action. Checks requiring more than a full round action can be attempted in one-half the amount of time required at a -10 penalty.

feats_list.name: Grab Back
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 Ref Def v. grab/grapple, if enemy misses you can make grab/grapple v. same

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus to your Reflex Defense against grab and grapple attacks. If an enemy misses you when making a grab or grapple attack, you can immediately make your own grab attack against the same enemy as a reaction. If you have a feat that enables you to make a grapple attack (such as Pin or Trip), you can make a grapple attack instead.

feats_list.name: Grand Army of the Republic Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: apply armor's Fort Def to Will Def also

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you wear armor that provides an equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense, you also apply the armor's equipment bonus to your Will Defense.

feats_list.name: Grapple Resistance
feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 v. grab or grapple, +5 opposed grapple, +5 all your objects

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 bonus to your Reflex Defense when an enemy makes a grab or grapple attack against you, and you gain a +5 bonus to all opposed grapple checks (regardless of who started the grapple -Rodney). All objects that you are holding or carrying gain a +5 bonus to their Reflex Defense when attacked (see "Attack an Object" on page 151 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

feats_list.name: Grazing Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: with ranged atk, target a second creature w/in LOS & 6sq of target, divide dam between both, or no dam to either if 2nd atk fails

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully make a ranged attack against a single target, you can make a second attack roll against an additional target that is in direct line of sight and no farther than 6 squares from the original target. If the second attack roll succeeds, make a single damage roll, and divide the damage equally between the two targets. If the second attack roll fails, you deal no damage to either target.

feats_list.name: Great Cleave
feats_list.benefit_summary: As Cleave feat, but no limit to the number of times you can use it per round.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can wield a melee weapon with such power that you can strike multiple times when you drop your opponents. As the Cleave feat (page 83), except that you have no limit to the number of times you can use it per round. [CRB p.86, cite: 584-585]
feats_list.full_text_description: As the Cleave feat (page 83), except that you have no limit to the number of times you can use it per round.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Str 13, Power Attack, Cleave, base attack bonus +4

feats_list.name: Gungan Weapon Master
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend Force Point to atk w/atlatl or cesta increase dam die by 1 step

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to an attack roll with an atlatl or a cesta, increase the die type by one step (from d6 to d8, or from d8 to d10).

feats_list.name: Gunnery Specialist
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/encounter reroll vehicle atk, proficient w/vehicle weapons
feats_list.full_text_description: While you are the gunner of a vehicle, you are considered proficient with vehicle weapons. Additionally, once per encounter, you can reroll an attack roll made with a vehicle weapon, though you must keep the second result, even if it is worse. You can declare this reroll after you learn the result of the attack roll, but before damage is resolved. Special: Taking this feat satisfies the prerequisites for the Starship Tactics feat (page 20 of Starships of the Galaxy); however, unless you are trained in the Pilot skill and have the Vehicular Combat feat, you may only take [gunner) maneuvers when you select starship maneuvers for Starship Tactics.

feats_list.name: Halt
feats_list.benefit_summary: if hit w/Atk of Opp compare same die roll result v. grapple target halts move & prone, if over thresh than lose all actions
feats_list.full_text_description: If you hit with an attack of opportunity against an enemy of up to one size larger than you, compare the same die roll result against the target’s grapple check (CR page 154). If the die roll succeeds against the grapple check, the target immediately halts all movement and falls prone in its current square. The target can spend any remaining actions normally. If your attack exceed the target’s damage threshold, the target loses any remaining actions and ends its turn immediately. Apply damage normally to the target regardless of the results of this feat. Special: If the target is using the charge action when moving past you, its charge is ended if you successfully knock it prone, and the target cannot charge again on this turn.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Trip, Weapon Focus in selected weapon, Weapon Proficiency in selected weapon*, BAB +8.

feats_list.name: Hasty Modification
feats_list.benefit_summary: exchange a trait for another, 1 min DC 20 Mechanics

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can exchange a trait that you have applied to a piece of equipment or droid for another one by spending 1 minute to make a DC 20 Mechanics check. If you succeed, the equipment loses the old trait and gains a new trait until the end of the encounter, at which point the device loses all traits it had previously acquired through use of the Tech Specialist feat.

feats_list.name: Heavy Hitter
feats_list.benefit_summary: +1 die dam every 5 pts over Ref Def, if over thresh then target can't atk next turn & reduce spd 2sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When making an attack roll using a weapons emplacement or a vehicle weapon, you add an additional 1 point of damage for every 5 points you roll above the target’s Reflex Defense. If you exceed the target’s damage threshold, then on its next turn the target cannot attack and its speed is reduced by 2 squares (1 square starship scale).
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Weapon Focus (heavy weapons), Weapon Proficiency (heavy weapons).

feats_list.name: Hideous Visage
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/encounter swif Deception v. WillDef move target 1sq & -1 atk v. you
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a swift action, you can make a Deception check against one opponent that can see you. If the check equals or exceeds the opponent's Will Defense, you move the target 1 square away from you and it takes a -1 penalty on all attacks until the start of your next turn. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

feats_list.name: Hijkata Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/rnd when adjacent enemy damages you w/melee atk you can make Atk of Opp w/-5 atk, 1/enc w/Atk of Opp from you that enemy takes penalty on atk = your Dex mod until end of next turn, w/Expertise 1/enc spend full & designate single ally, any enemy adjacent to you or ally provokes Atk of Opp. If ally moves you can move spd as reac but must end adjacent to enemy
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per round, when an adjacent enemy successfully damages you with a melee attack, you can make an attack of opportunity with an unarmed attack at a -5 penalty against that enemy, even if the enemy's attack normally would not provoke an attack of opportunity. Once per encounter, when an enemy provokes an attack of opportunity from you and you successfully damage that enemy with an unarmed attack of opportunity, that enemy takes a penalty to attack rolls equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum +1) until the end of your next turn. Special: If you have the Hijkata Expertise talent (see the Martial Arts Forms talent tree on page 32), once per encounter, you can spend a full-round action to designate a single adjacent ally. Until the start of your next turn, any enemy adjacent to you or the designated ally that makes an attack roll against that ally provokes an attack of opportunity from you. If the ally moves during his or her turn, you can immediately move a number of squares up to your speed as a reaction; however, you must end your movement in a square that is adjacent to the designated ally.

feats_list.name: Hobbling Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: sacrifice extra dam from Sneak Atk to reduce target's spd by 1 for enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you would deal extra damage by using Sneak Attack, Rapid Shot, or Rapid Strike, you reduce the target's speed by 1 square until the end of the encounter instead of dealing the extra damage.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Sneak Attack, Rapid Shot, or Rapid Strike

feats_list.name: Hold Together
feats_list.benefit_summary: as reac spend FP to delay dam effect to vehicle until end of round, Col

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a reaction, you can spend a Force Point to delay the effect of damage dealt to a vehicle you are riding in or piloting until the end of the round. The vehicle must be of Colossal size or smaller.

feats_list.name: Hunter's Instincts
feats_list.benefit_summary: always keep the better result on a Perception reroll

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll a Perception check, you always keep the better result, even if you have multiple reroll abilities.

feats_list.name: Hyperblazer
feats_list.benefit_summary: reduce time & penalties Use Computer to navigate the tangle & mapping

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When traversing the hyperspace tangle, you reduce by half the calculation time and penalties on Use Computer checks for astrogation (CR page 237). You also reduce hyperspace mapping time by half when mapping new hyperspace routes.

feats_list.name: Imperceptible Liar
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend Force Point to Deception, increase die type by 2 steps

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to a Deception check, increase the die type by two steps (from d6 to d10, or from d8 to d12).

feats_list.name: Imperial Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc as free action on your turn, negate 1 mind-affecting effect
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a free action on your turn, you can negate any one mind-affecting effect targeting or currently affecting you.

feats_list.name: Impersonate
feats_list.benefit_summary: alter features & voice to a specific person, Moderate deception

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can make a Deception check to alter your features to that of a specific person. This feat also allows you to change your voice to match the target's. You always treat impersonating a person as a Moderate deception. [Normally, impersonating a close friend or family member is an Incredible deception (-10 penalty)]

feats_list.name: Impetuous Move
feats_list.benefit_summary: when catch 2nd wind, regain only half hp to move half spd, no atk opp
feats_list.full_text_description: When you catch a second wind, you can choose to regain only half of the hit points you normally would with a second wind and immediately move up to half your speed. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

feats_list.name: Implant Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: not moved down CT extra step when would be moved down
feats_list.full_text_description: You are not moved an extra step down the condition track when you would normally be moved down the condition track. Normal: Characters with an implant move one extra step down the condition track when moved down the condition track for any reason.

feats_list.name: Improved Bantha Rush
feats_list.benefit_summary: Push opponent squares = Str mod (2min) after successful melee attack

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When making a Bantha Rush, you push your opponent a number of additional squares away from you equal to half your Strength modifier (round down, minimum 2 squares pushed total). Normal: When using Bantha Rush, you normally push your opponent only 1 square away from you.

feats_list.name: Improved Charge
feats_list.benefit_summary: Can charge without moving in a straight line and can alter direction to avoid obstacles.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can charge around obstacles. You can make a charge (see page 152) without having to move in a straight line, and you can alter your direction when making a charge to avoid obstacles. All other charge rules apply. [CRB p.86, cite: 585]
feats_list.full_text_description: You can make a charge (see CR page 152) without having to move in a straight line, and you can alter your direction when making a charge to avoid obstacles. All other charge rules apply. Normal: A character must charge in an unobstructed straight line.
feats_list.normal_text: A character must charge in an unobstructed straight line. [CRB p.86, cite: 585]

feats_list.name: Improved Damage Threshold
feats_list.benefit_summary: Increase your damage threshold by 5.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are harder to take down in a fight. You increase your damage threshold by 5 (see Damage Threshold, page 146). [CRB p.87, cite: 587]
feats_list.full_text_description: You increase your damage threshold by 5 (see Damage Threshold, page 146). Normal: A creature without this feat has a damage threshold equal to its Fortitude Defense plus its size modifier (+5 for Large, +10 for Huge, +20 for Gargantuan, or +50 for Colossal). Special: You can take this feat more than once. Its effects stack. Each time you take this feat, increase your damage threshold by 5.
feats_list.normal_text: A creature without this feat has a damage threshold equal to its Fortitude Defense plus its size modifier (+5 for Large, +10 for Huge, +20 for Gargantuan, or +50 for Colossal). [CRB p.87, cite: 587]
feats_list.special_text: You can take this feat more than once. Its effects stack. Each time you take this feat, increase your damage threshold by 5. [CRB p.87, cite: 587-588]

feats_list.name: Improved Defenses
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain +1 bonus to Reflex, Fortitude, and Will Defense.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at fending off attacks of many forms. You gain a +1 bonus to your Reflex Defense, Fortitude Defense, and Will Defense. [CRB p.86, cite: 585]
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Reflex Defense, Fortitude Defense, and Will Defense. SSotG: This feat does not apply to the defenses of a vehicle, even if you are piloting or commanding it. This is one reason many pilots prefer the Dodge feat to Improved Defenses.

feats_list.name: Improved Disarm
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain +5 bonus on melee attack rolls to disarm. If you fail, opponent doesn't get a free attack.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at disarming opponents in melee combat. You gain a +5 bonus on any melee attack roll made to disarm an opponent. In addition, if you fail to disarm your opponent, he doesn't get to make a free attack against you. [CRB p.86, cite: 586]
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 bonus on any melee attack roll made to disarm an opponent. In addition, if you fail to disarm your opponent, he doesn't get to make a free attack against you. Normal: See the normal disarm rules on CR page 152.
feats_list.normal_text: See the normal disarm rules on page 152. [CRB p.86, cite: 586]

feats_list.name: Improved Disarm + Force Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain +5 from Improved Disarm on Use the Force check

effects.target_description: improved disarm on use the force check

feats_list.full_text_description: When you use the Force disarm Force Power, you gain the +5 bonus from Improved Disarm on your Use the Force check as though you were making an attack roll.

feats_list.name: Improved Opportunistic Trickery
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/turn instead of AoO, reduce target's Ref Def by 5 for 1 turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you, once per turn you can sacrifice the attack to reduce the target's Reflex Defense by 5 until the end of the target's next turn.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Combat Reflexes, Opportunistic Trickery, Sneak Attack

feats_list.name: Improved Rapid Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: -5 Atk to deal +2 die damage, melee, if no Dex 13 extra -10 Atk

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using a light melee weapon or lightsaber with the Rapid Strike feat, you can take a -5 penalty to your attack roll to gain +2 dice of damage on a successful strike. This does not stack with the Rapid Strike feat or extra damage provided by any source that does not stack with the Rapid Strike feat (such as Mighty Swing). Special: If you do not have a Dexterity of 13 or higher, the penalty to your attack roll is -10.

feats_list.name: Improved Sleight of Hand
feats_list.benefit_summary: Deception as swif opposed Perception must exceed Deception & Stealth, can draw & palm weapon 2 sizes smaller than you

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the Sleight of Hand application of the Stealth skill (CR page 73), you can use your Deception skill to improve your chance of success. Prior to making the Stealth check, you can make a Deception check as a swift action. The opposed Perception check of anyone attempting to notice your action must exceed both your Deception check and your Stealth check. Additionally, you can, as a single action, use Improved Sleight of Hand to simultaneously draw and palm a weapon two sizes smaller than you. Make a Stealth check as a free action when drawing your weapon to successfully conceal it in a position in your hand (or similar appendage), where you can use it on a following action. Once the weapon is used, you can attempt to palm it again as a swift action.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: DEX 15, Skill Focus (Deception), trained in Deception and Stealth

feats_list.name: Improvised Weapon Mastery
feats_list.benefit_summary: all improvised as simple & +1d6 dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You treat all improvised weapons as simple weapons, and you can use them without penalty and with talents and feats designed for use with simple weapons. You also deal an additional 1d6 points of damage on a successful hit.

feats_list.name: Impulsive Flight
feats_list.benefit_summary: can withdraw one extra square

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can withdraw one extra square using the withdraw action.

feats_list.name: Inborn Resilience
feats_list.benefit_summary: reduce species bonus to 1 Def to 0 & another to +2, cannot change back

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can reduce your species bonus to any one defense score to +0 and increase your species bonus to another defense score to +2. Once you change your species bonuses in this way, they cannot be changed back.

feats_list.name: Increased Agility
feats_list.benefit_summary: increase Climb, Jump or Swim by 2 squares & don't lose Dex climbing

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You increase your Climb speed, Swim speed and Jump distance by 2 squares and do not lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense when climbing.

feats_list.name: Increased Resistance
feats_list.benefit_summary: if attack v. Fort Def fails, gain +2 Fort Def until start of your next turn

effects.target_description: t def until start of your next turn

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an attack or skill check targets your Fortitude Defense and fails to equal or exceed it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude Defense until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Indomitable Personality
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc add Cha mod to Will Def for 1 turn as reac

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Will Defense as a reaction; this benefit lasts until the end of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Informer
feats_list.benefit_summary: Perception replaces Gather Info, considered trained, reduce time

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use your Perception modifier instead of your Gather Information modifier when making Gather Information checks. You are considered trained in the Gather Information skill. If you are entitled to a Gather Information check reroll, you can reroll your Perception check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations). Additionally, when you have favorable conditions for your Gather Information check (such as from operating on your home planet), you reduce by half the time it takes to make a Gather Information check.

feats_list.name: Instinctive Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: when use FP on atk can reroll & keep better & apply Force Point

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you use a Force Point when making an attack, you can reroll the attack and take the better result. Apply the results of the die from the Force Point to the better result.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Proficient in weapon used*, living character (not a droid).

feats_list.name: Instinctive Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: as free spend FP to increase all defenses by 2 until next turn
feats_list.full_text_description: On your turn, as a free action, you can spend a Force Point to increase all your defenses by 2 until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Instinctive Perception
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you reroll Perception & take lower gain FP to use w/Perception until the end of the encounter
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll a Perception check and take the second result, if your second result is lower than your first result, you gain a temporary Force Point. This Force Point can be spent only to add to the result of a Perception check, and if it is not spent before the end of the encounter, it is lost.

feats_list.name: Intimidator
feats_list.benefit_summary: when intimidate instead of normal target -5 skills & -2 atk w/you in LOS

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully use the Intimidate application of the Persuasion skill against a creature, instead of the normal results, the creature takes a -5 penalty to all skill checks (including Use the Force) and a -2 penalty to all attacks when you are with in its line of sight, until the end of your next turn. If aboard another vehicle, your enemy must be able to see or detect your vehicle. Special: You cannot use this feat with the Maniacal Charge feat.

feats_list.name: Ion Shielding
feats_list.benefit_summary: if ion dam before being halved equals thresh move only -1 CT
feats_list.full_text_description: If the ion damage (before being halved) equals or exceeds your damage threshold, you move only -1 step on the condition track. Normal: If the ion damage (before being halved) equals or exceeds your damage threshold, you normally move -2 steps on the condition track.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Droid with Str 13 or cyborg with Con 13

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid with Str 13 or cyborg with Con 13

feats_list.name: Jedi Familiarity
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/encounter if targeted by Force from ally gain 1 FP until end of enc.

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when you are targeted or affected by a Force power or Force talent originating from an ally, you gain one temporary Force Point, which must be spent before the end of the encounter or it goes away. If the Force power or Force talent damages you or moves you down the condition track, you do not gain the benefit of this feat.

feats_list.name: Jedi Heritage
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain 2 extra Force powers for each Force Training

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Your Wisdom is considered to be 4 points higher for the purpose of determining how many Force Powers you gain from the Force Training feat, granting you two extra Force powers for each Force Training feat.

feats_list.name: Justice Seeker
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 dam against targets that dam you or allies since end of your last turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls for attacks against targets that have damaged one of your allies since the end of your last turn.

feats_list.name: K'tara Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: roll an extra die of dam v. flat-footed enemy on 1 unarmed atk, 1/enc when you dam a target denied Dex to Ref Def make 2nd unarmed atk v. Fort Def as free to render target incapable of speech until end of next turn, w/Expertise spend 2 swif to cause single adjacent enemy to be flat-footed v. your 1st atk the same round
feats_list.full_text_description: You are trained in the K'tara style of unarmed fighting, which enables you to neutralize enemies before they even know that you are present. You roll an extra die of damage against a flat-footed enemy on one unarmed attack during your turn. Once per encounter, when you deal damage with an unarmed attack to a target that has been denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, make a second unarmed attack against the target's Fortitude Defense as a free action. If successful, you render the target incapable of speech until the end of your next turn. This is a stunning effect. Special: If you have the K'tara Expertise talent (see the Martial Arts Forms talent tree on page 33), you can spend two swift actions to cause a single adjacent enemy to be flat-footed against your first attack during the same round.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Martial Arts I, trained in Stealth

feats_list.name: K'thri Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/rnd spend swif to make 1 unarmed atk w/in reach dealing your base unarmed dam w/no bonus to dam from Str or HL, 1/enc if an unarmed atk misses deal half dam, must be wearing light or no armor, w/Expertise 1/enc w/full atk reroll 1 atk but you must take reroll & wearing light or no armor
feats_list.full_text_description: You are trained in the K'thri style of unarmed fighting, striking with flashy moves and incredible speed. Once per round, you can spend a swift action to make a single unarmed attack against one enemy within reach, dealing your base unarmed damage with no bonus to the damage roll from your Strength or heroic level. [[From Donovan Morningfire, author of feat: Feats and talents like Rapid Strike, Teras Kasi basics, and Weapon Specialization would apply]]. Once per encounter, when you make an unarmed attack that misses the target, you deal half damage to the target. You must be wearing light or no armor to gain the benefit of this feat. Special: If you have the K'thri Expertise talent (see the Martial Arts Forms talent tree on page 33), once per encounter when making a full attack, you can reroll one of your unarmed attack rolls; however, you must accept the result of the reroll, even if it is worse. You must be wearing light or no armor to gain this special benefit (must take re-roll).
feats_list.prerequisites_text: DEX 13, BAB +1, Dual Weapon Mastery I, Martial Arts I.

feats_list.name: Keen Scent
feats_list.benefit_summary: range of Scent is 20 sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: The range of your Scent ability increases to 20 squares.

feats_list.name: Knife Trick
feats_list.benefit_summary: w/Atk Opp can draw concealed weapon & make 1 atk, still threaten sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you have a concealed weapon, you threaten squares as though armed with a melee weapon. When you can make an attack of opportunity, you can draw a weapon you have successfully concealed on your person (see page 72 of the Saga Edition core rulebook) and make a single attack against the target. If you choose not to draw your concealed weapon and attack with it, you cannot make the attack of opportunity unless you would otherwise normally be able to do so. Normal: With the Quick Draw feat, drawing or holstering a weapon is a swift action.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Quick Draw, Lightning Draw, trained in Stealth

feats_list.name: Knock Heads
feats_list.benefit_summary: deal 1d6+Str mod dam to adjacent you multi-grabbed, thresh -5

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: After successfully using the Multi-Grab feat against two targets that are both adjacent to you and each other, you can immediately knock their heads together, dealing automatic bludgeoning damage to each creature equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier. When comparing the damage to each creature's damage threshold, treat their damage thresholds as if they were 5 points lower. Both creatures are still considered grabbed at the end of using this feat.

feats_list.name: Lasting Influence
feats_list.benefit_summary: with successful Persuasion gain favorable circumstances next 24 hours

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you make a successful Persuasion check against a target's Will Defense, you gain favorable circumstances on future Persuasion checks against that target for the next 24 hours. For more details on favorable circumstances, see page 59 of the Saga Edition core rulebook. Gain a +2 circumstance bonus; reduce the DC by 2.

feats_list.name: Leader of Droids
feats_list.benefit_summary: provide mind-affecting effect to allied droids = Int mod (min 1)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you provide a beneficial, mind-affecting effect to your allies, you may select from among these allies a number of droids equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). The droids you designate ignore their mind-affecting immunity with regards to this effect, provided they are willing to ignore this immunity.

feats_list.name: Lightning Draw
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/encounter draw holstered weapon & attack as single stan action

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can draw a holstered weapon and attack as a single standard action. Normal: With the Quick Draw feat, drawing or holstering a weapon is a swift action.

feats_list.name: Linguist
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain bonus languages equal to 1 + INT modifier (min 1).
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You pick up languages quickly and easily. You gain a number of bonus languages equal to 1 plus your Intelligence bonus (minimum of 1). See the sidebar on page 22 for a list of common languages. [CRB p.87, cite: 588]
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a number of bonus languages equal to 1 plus your Intelligence bonus (minimum of 1). See the sidebar on CR page 22 for a list of common languages. Special: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you take this feat, you gain a number of additional languages equal to 1 plus your Intelligence bonus (minimum of 1).
feats_list.special_text: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you take this feat, you gain a number of additional languages equal to 1 plus your Intelligence bonus (minimum of 1). [CRB p.87, cite: 588]

feats_list.name: Logic Upgrade: Self-Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter, as reac +2 one defense

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you can grant yourself a +2 morale bonus to the defense score of your choice until the end of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Logic Upgrade: Skill Swap
feats_list.benefit_summary: full-round swap skill not trained in for trained skill (not trained)
feats_list.full_text_description: Select a skill you are not trained in (other than Use the Force). As a full-round action, you can swap this skill for one you are trained in. You do not gain any benefit from the original trained skill while it is swapped out. You are not considered trained in the swapped-in skill, and therefore you cannot use any trained-only options or add a bonus to your skill check. You still add one-half your level and your associated ability bonus, as usual. Special: If you become trained in the skill selected for this feat, you can select another skill to replace it. You can take this feat more than once each time selecting a different skill to swap.

feats_list.name: Logic Upgrade: Tactician
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter, aid another +5 Atk

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can use the aid another action to grant a single ally a +5 bonus to their next attack roll against an opponent. Normal: Successfully aiding an attack roll grants a +2 bonus to an ally’s next attack roll against an opponent.

feats_list.name: Long Haft Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: can attack with both ends of lightsaber pike or long-handled lightsaber

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you use a lightsaber pike or long-handle lightsaber, you can attack with both ends of the weapon, treating it as a double weapon. See the description of the individual weapon for more information on attack with both ends of the weapon. [[A character with the Long Haft Form feat (see page 23) can use the lightsaber pike as a double weapon. If you have this feat, you can attack with both ends of the weapon as a full-round action, but both attack rolls take a -10 penalty; certain feats and talents can reduce these penalties. The non-lightsaber end of the pike deals 1d6 damage. Weak feat option: If you have this feat, you can attack with both ends of the weapon as a full-round action, but both attack rolls take a -2 penalty. The non-lightsaber end of the pike deals 1d6 damage. If you have the Dual Weapon Mastery 1 feat, the penalty is reduced to 0. Reasons: First off, the feat is a character feat. Character feats are rare and precious, especially for jedi, since they need them to take Force Training. That’s also why I don’t really want any prerequisites for the feat. Secondly, as noted, an extra 1d6 damage is not that much, that’s why I made the penalty -2 instead of -5 (or the original -10). It’s not overpowering. It’s pretty balanced.]]

feats_list.name: Mandalorian Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: make ranged +2 Atk at end of charge, -2 to Ref Def, +2 Will Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the Charging Fire feat, you gain a +2 bonus to a ranged attack made at the end of a charge. As with a normal charge, you take a –2 penalty to your Reflex Defense, but you also gain a +2 morale bonus to your Will Defense until the beginning of your next turn. Normal: You gain no bonus to a ranged attack made at the end of a charge with the Charging Fire feat.

feats_list.name: Maniacal Charge
feats_list.benefit_summary: when charge make Persuasion as free to intimidate each target pass w/in 1 sq, if succeed they can't make AoO v. you, if over v. target loses Dex & flat-footed
feats_list.full_text_description: When using the charge action, you can make a Persuasion check as a free action to intimidate your target and each enemy you pass within 1 square of. When your check succeeds against an enemy you pass, it cannot make an attack of opportunity against you. When your check succeeds against your target, it loses its Dexterity bonus and is considered flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Martial Arts I
feats_list.benefit_summary: Unarmed attack damage increases by one die step (e.g., 1d4 to 1d6). Gain +1 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are adept at fighting unarmed. Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d3 becomes 1d4, 1d4 becomes 1d6, and 1d6 becomes 1d8. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense. [CRB p.87, cite: 588-589]
feats_list.full_text_description: Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d3 becomes 1d4,1d4 becomes 1d6, and 1d6 becomes 1d8. [Natural weapons (claws, bite, etc.) stack with the Martial Arts feats]. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense. Normal: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. Special: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses.
feats_list.normal_text: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. [CRB p.87, cite: 589]
feats_list.special_text: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. [CRB p.87, cite: 589-590]

feats_list.name: Martial Arts II
feats_list.benefit_summary: Unarmed attack damage increases by another die step (e.g., 1d6 to 1d8). Gain additional +1 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are a master at fighting unarmed. Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d4 becomes 1d6, 1d6 becomes 1d8, and 1d8 becomes 1d10. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense (which stacks with the dodge bonus granted by the Martial Arts I feat). [CRB p.87, cite: 590-591]

effects.stacking_note: stacks with Martial Arts I bonus

feats_list.full_text_description: Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d4 becomes 1d6,1d6 becomes 1d8, and 1d8 becomes 1d10. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense (which stacks with the dodge bonus granted by the Martial Arts I feat). Normal: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. Special: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses.
feats_list.normal_text: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. [CRB p.87, cite: 591]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Martial Arts I, base attack bonus +3
feats_list.special_text: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. [CRB p.87, cite: 591]

feats_list.name: Martial Arts III
feats_list.benefit_summary: Unarmed attack damage increases by a final die step (e.g., 1d8 to 1d10). Gain additional +1 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: Your martial arts prowess is second to none. Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d6 becomes 1d8, 1d8 becomes 1d10, and 1d10 becomes 1d12. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense (which stacks with the dodge bonus granted by the Martial Arts I and Martial Arts II feats). [CRB p.87, cite: 591-592]

effects.stacking_note: stacks with Martial Arts I & II bonuses

feats_list.full_text_description: Damage dealt by your unarmed attacks increases by one die step: 1d6 becomes 1d8, 1d8 becomes 1d10, and 1d10 becomes 1d12. In addition, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense (which stacks with the dodge bonus granted by the Martial Arts I and Martial Arts II feats). Normal: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. Special: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. [Dev: Q. What is the damage dealt by a Yuzzem with the Martial Arts III feat? What comes after d12s? A. The damage should probably cap at d12. (The benefit being that the Yuzzem get their a feat earlier than everyone else.)]
feats_list.normal_text: The amount of damage you deal with a successful unarmed attack is based on your size: Small, 1d3; Medium, 1d4; Large, 1d6. [CRB p.87, cite: 592]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Martial Arts I, Martial Arts II, base attack bonus +6
feats_list.special_text: A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Also, dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most other types of bonuses. [CRB p.87, cite: 592-593]

feats_list.name: Master Tracker
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend Force Point to Survival, increase die type by 2 steps

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to a Survival check, increase the die type by two steps (from d6 to d10, or from d8 to d12).

feats_list.name: Master of Disguise
feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 Deception for forging documents or appearance, -2 penalty if rush

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 insight bonus to your Deception check when creating a deceptive appearance or a forged document. In addition, you can rush the process by taking a penalty of -2 to the Deception check. Normal: When you rush the creation of a deceptive appearance or forged document, you take a -10 penalty to your Deception check.

feats_list.name: Meat Shield
feats_list.benefit_summary: If opponent uses creature for cover, you gain that cover too from them

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an opponent attacks you while in cover provided by another character, creature, or droid, you are treated as being in cover from attacks by that opponent.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, BAB +4

feats_list.name: Mechanical Martial Arts
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you dam enemy w/unarmed atk enemy -5 melee atk & dam until next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully damage an enemy with an unarmed attack, the enemy takes a -5 penalty to all melee attack rolls and damage rolls until the start of your next turn. Special: If you strike an organic enemy while using this feat during an attack of opportunity, the penalty lasts until the start of the enemy's next turn.

feats_list.name: Medical Team (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Treat Injury & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), aid another to restore hp restores +4 hp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Treat Injury checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you use the aid another action to assist an ally who has this feat with a Treat Injury check to restore hit points, your ally always restores an extra 4 hit points to the target.

feats_list.name: Melee Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: When making a melee attack (standard action), can take penalty up to -5 on attack and add same as dodge bonus to Reflex Defense (up to BAB). Lasts until start of next turn.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are trained at using your combat ability for defense as well as offense. When you use a standard action to make a melee attack, you can take a penalty of up to -5 on your attack roll and add the same number (up to +5) as a dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The changes to attack rolls and Reflex Defense last until the start of your next turn. [CRB p.87, cite: 593-594]
feats_list.full_text_description: When you use a standard action to make a melee attack, you can take a penalty of up to -5 on your attack roll and add the same number (up to +5) as a dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The changes to attack rolls and Reflex Defense last until the start of your next turn. Normal: A character without the Melee Defense feat can fight defensively while using the attack action to take a -5 penalty on his attack roll and gain a +2 dodge bonus to his Reflex Defense. [You can use fight defensively and the Melee Defense feat together, provided you find a way to gain an extra Standard Action in the round.]
feats_list.normal_text: A character without the Melee Defense feat can fight defensively while using the attack action to take a -5 penalty on his attack roll and gain a +2 dodge bonus to his Reflex Defense. [CRB p.87, cite: 594]

feats_list.name: Metamorph
feats_list.benefit_summary: full round can change mass & change size, number of rounds = Con

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a full-round action, you can change your mass when you use your shapeshift species trait, increasing or decreasing your size by one step. If you reduce your size to Small, you gain a +1 size bonus to your Reflex Defense and a +5 size bonus on Stealth checks, but your carrying capacity is three-quarters of what it was prior to your use of Metamorph. If you increase your size to Large, you take a -1 size penalty to your Reflex Defense and a -5 size penalty on your Stealth checks. However, your carrying capacity doubles, you gain a +5 size bonus to your Damage Threshold, and your reach increases by 1. You can maintain this form for a number of rounds per day equal to your Constitution score.

feats_list.name: Mighty Swing
feats_list.benefit_summary: Spend two swift actions in same round to deal +1 die of damage on next melee attack in same round.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are capable of delivering jarring melee attacks. You can spend two swift actions in the same round to deal +1 die of damage on your next melee attack in the same round. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Rapid Strike feat. [CRB p.87, cite: 595]
feats_list.full_text_description: You can spend two swift actions in the same round to deal +1 die of damage on your next melee attack in the same round. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Rapid Strike feat. Unleashed: When you use the Mighty Swing feat, you can spend a Destiny Point to gain a +5 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls, and you can make an automatic trip attack (as with the Trip feat) against the target, also with a +5 bonus on the opposed grapple check.

feats_list.name: Mighty Throw
feats_list.benefit_summary: add Str & Dex to thrown Atk, range + squares = Str mod

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can add your Strength bonus (in addition to your Dexterity bonus) to your ranged attack bonus when using thrown weapons (including grenades and grenade-like weapons). Also, you can increase the length of each range category by a number of squares equal to your Strength modifier.

feats_list.name: Mind of Reason
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use Wisdom instead of Intelligence for Intelligence-based skills

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use your Wisdom bonus instead of your Intelligence bonus for all Intelligence-based skill checks.

feats_list.name: Mission Specialist
feats_list.benefit_summary: choose a trained skill, allies not trained gain +2 w/in 12 sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Choose one skill in which you are trained. Allies who are not trained in that skill gain a +2 competence bonus to the skill while they are within 12 squares of you. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you select this feat, it applies to a different skill. Special: Only allies who have the Force Sensitivity feat gain this bonus to Use the Force checks.

feats_list.name: Mobility
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain +5 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against attacks of opportunity caused when moving out of or into a threatened area.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at moving past opponents and avoiding opportunistic attacks. You get a +5 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or into a threatened area (see Attacks of Opportunity, page 155). A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses. [CRB p.87, cite: 595-596]
feats_list.full_text_description: You get a +5 dodge bonus to Reflex Defense against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or into a threatened area (see Attacks of Opportunity, CR page 155). A situation that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses. [[Can be used by a mount.]]

feats_list.name: Momentum Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: melee Atk +1 die damage if mounted and moving

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When riding a beast as a mount or on a speeder bike (as a passenger or a pilot), you add a +1 die of damage to any melee attacks if your mount or vehicle has already moved at least its speed this turn.

feats_list.name: Mon Calamari Shipwright
