feats_list.benefit_summary: spend 2 swif to move vehicle up CT not 3, automatically reroute power
feats_list.full_text_description: You need spend only two swift actions to move a vehicle you occupy +1 step on the condition track. In addition, you automatically succeed on Mechanics checks to reroute power (see page 172 of the Saga Edition core rulebook). Normal: It takes three swift actions to use the reroute power action.

feats_list.name: Mounted Combat
feats_list.benefit_summary: DC20 Ride as swif +2sq spd, failure = mount -1 CT, 1/round negate hit v. you or mount w/Ride check, DC20 Endurance for mount each time after in enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can make a DC 20 Ride check as a swift action to spur your living mount to move faster than its normal speed. If the check fails, your mount’s speed does not increase and it moves -1 step on the condition track. If the check succeeds, your mount’s speed increases by 2 squares until the start of your next turn. You cannot take 10 on this check. Your mount must succeed on a DC 20 Endurance check prior to each subsequent attempt to use this feat in the same encounter. Additionally, once per round, as a reaction, when you are riding a mount, you can negate a weapon hit against either you or the mount by making a successful Ride check. The DC of the skill check is equal to the result of the attack roll you want to negate.

feats_list.name: Mounted Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter, can redirect Atk to mount or vehicle, after Atk

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When riding a beast as a mount or on a speeder bike (as a passenger or a pilot), once per encounter you can redirect any attack against you at your mount or vehicle instead. The decision to redirect the attack is made after the result of the attack roll is determined but before the damage or the effects are resolved.

feats_list.name: Mounted Regiment (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Ride & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), 1/rnd as reac to mount being atked make Ride check & if over mount's Ref Def use instead

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Ride checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, once per round as a reaction to your mount being attacked, you can make a Ride check; if the result exceeds the mount's Reflex Defense, use your check result against the attack instead of using the mount's Reflex Defense.

feats_list.name: Moving Target
feats_list.benefit_summary: if end turn 3 sq from start +1 dodge to Ref Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If you end your turn at least 3 squares away from where you started, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Multi-Grab
feats_list.benefit_summary: as stan action, grab atk v. 2 adjacent if you have 2 empty hands

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a standard action, you can make a grab attack against two targets adjacent to you (roll a separate attack against each target). You must have two empty hands to use this feat.

feats_list.name: Multi-Targeting
feats_list.benefit_summary: use swif actions across more than 1 rnd to aim if target stays in LOS & atk others

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use swift actions across more than one round to aim at a target. You can attack different targets prior to the completion of your aim action. If the subject of your aim is out of your line of sight for any reason, you lose your aim and must start again. Normal: You must normally use two consecutive swift actions in the same round to aim (see page 154 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

feats_list.name: Natural Leader
feats_list.benefit_summary: organization has scale = 1/2 HL + Cha mod, +10 organization score

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You become the leader of an organization of your design (see FU page 58: Chapter 4: Organizations for more information on designing new organizations). The organization has a scale equal to one-half your heroic level plus your Charisma bonus, and continues to grow in scale as you gain levels. You automatically begin with a +10 bonus to your organization score for your new organization.

feats_list.name: Nature Specialist
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend FP to Knowledge (life sciences), increase die type by 2 steps

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to a Knowledge (life sciences) check, increase the die type by two steps (from d6 to d10, or from d8 to d12).

feats_list.name: Never Surrender
feats_list.benefit_summary: make Endurance check 1st time reduced to 0 hp as reac w/DC = dam done, if successful reduced to 1 hp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: The first time you would be reduced to 0 hit points in an encounter, you can make an Endurance check as a reaction, with a DC equal to the number of points of damage being dealt to you. If your check succeeds, you are instead reduced to 1 hit point.

feats_list.name: Nikto Survival
feats_list.benefit_summary: reroll Survival & keep better in environment of subspecies
feats_list.full_text_description: Select a Nikto subspecies: Kajain’sa’Nikto (desert), Kadas’sa’Nikto (forest), Esral’sa’Nikto (mountains), Gluss’sa’Nikto (ocean), or M’shento’su’Nikto (arctic). In addition to the usual Nikto species traits, when you are operating in an environment advantageous to your native subspecies, you can reroll any Survival check, taking the better result.

feats_list.name: Nimble Team (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Acrobatics & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), can tumble 1 extra sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Acrobatics checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you use the Acrobatics skill to tumble, you can tumble 1 extra square.

feats_list.name: Officer Candidacy Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 to Rank & Privilege organization score

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus to your Rank and Privilege organization score (see page GW 73 for more information).

feats_list.name: Opportunistic Retreat
feats_list.benefit_summary: instead of Atk of Opp 1/turn not attack to move half speed, no atk opp
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you, once per turn you can sacrifice the attack to move a number of squares equal to one-half your speed. Moving in this way does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

feats_list.name: Opportunistic Shooter
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 to attacks of opportunity with ranged

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +2 bonus to attacks of opportunity with ranged weapons.

feats_list.name: Opportunistic Trickery
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/turn instead of AoO, reduce target's Ref Def by 2 next round

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you, once per turn you can sacrifice that attack to reduce the target's Reflex Defense by 2 for the following round.

feats_list.name: Overwhelming Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: 2 swif for -5 on target's attempt to negate (Block, Vehicular Combat)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You must spend two swift actions in the same round to activate this feat. If your target attempts to use a talent, feat, or other ability to negate your attack (such as Block, Deflect, or Vehicular Combat), the target takes a -5 penalty to any attack rolls or skill checks it makes to negate the attack. This effect applies to the next attack you make before the end of the same round.

feats_list.name: Pall of the Dark Side
feats_list.benefit_summary: add one-half Dark Side Score to Use the Force to resist detection

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can add one-half your Dark Side Score (minimum 1) to any Use the Force checks made to resist attempts to detect you with the Sense Force application of the Use the Force skill.

feats_list.name: Perfect Intuition
feats_list.benefit_summary: always keep the better result on a Initiative reroll

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll an Initiative check, you always keep the better result, even if you have multiple reroll abilities.

feats_list.name: Perfect Swimmer
feats_list.benefit_summary: always keep the better result on a Swim reroll

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reroll a Swim check, you always keep the better result, even if you have multiple reroll abilities.

feats_list.name: Pin
feats_list.benefit_summary: If successful grapple attack and opponent fails opposed grapple check, opponent is pinned until start of your next turn.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at immobilizing grappled foes. If you succeed on a grappling attack and your opponent fails the opposed grapple check, your opponent is automatically pinned until the start of your next turn. A pinned creature can't move or take any actions while pinned, and it loses its Dexterity bonus (if any) to Reflex Defense. [CRB p.88, cite: 596-597]
feats_list.full_text_description: If you succeed on a grappling attack and your opponent fails the opposed grapple check, your opponent is automatically pinned until the start of your next turn. A pinned creature can't move or take any actions while pinned, and it loses its Dexterity bonus (if any) to Reflex Defense. Special: You cannot use the Pin and Trip feats during the same round. You can use the Pin and Crush feat in the same round, however.
feats_list.special_text: You cannot use the Pin and Trip feats during the same round. You can use the Pin and Crush feat in the same round, however. [CRB p.88, cite: 597]

feats_list.name: Pincer
feats_list.benefit_summary: can maintain Pin beyond 1 rnd & make grapple checks against pinned as swif & apply Crush

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully Pin an enemy (see page 87 of the Saga Edition core rulebook), you can maintain the Pin beyond 1 round and can make subsequent grapple checks against the pinned enemy as a swift action. You can apply the Crush feat whenever your subsequent checks are successful. Normal: Grapple checks are normally a standard action. The Pin feat must usually be rerolled each round as a new grapple check.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: equipped with claw or hand appendage

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid, equipped with claw or hand appendage, base attack bonus +1, Pin, Crush.

feats_list.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
feats_list.benefit_summary: target of Aiming Accuracy cannot take the recover action until next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the Aiming Accuracy feat, a target you damage cannot take the recover action until the end of its next turn.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid, Aiming Accuracy, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, proficient with weapon.

feats_list.name: Pistoleer
feats_list.benefit_summary: Blaster Pistol is accurate, Heavy Blaster Pistol not inaccurate, Hold-out if target has not acted +2 atk until the target acts

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack with a pistol, you gain one of the following benefits, depending on the kind of pistol you use. Blaster Pistol: You treat the blaster pistol as an accurate weapon. Heavy Blaster Pistol: You do not treat the heavy blaster pistol as an inaccurate weapon. Hold-Out Blaster Pistol: If you fire a hold-out blaster pistol at a target that has not yet acted in combat, you gain a +2 bonus to your attack rolls with that weapon against that target. The bonus applies to all such attacks until the target acts.

feats_list.name: Pitiless Warrior
feats_list.benefit_summary: gain hp = 5 + 1/2 level if reduce opponent to 0 hp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you reduce a target to 0 hit points, you gain a number of bonus hit points equal to 5 + one-half your level. Damage is subtracted from bonus hit points first, and any bonus hit points remaining at the end of the encounter are lost. Bonus hit points do not stack.

feats_list.name: Point Blank Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against opponents within point blank range.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at making well-placed shots with ranged weapons at point blank range. You get a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against opponents within point blank range (see Table 8-5: Weapon Ranges, page 129). [CRB p.88, cite: 597-598]
feats_list.full_text_description: You get a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against opponents within point blank range (see Table 8-5: Weapon Ranges, CR page 129). [This feat applies to area effect weapons such as flamethrowers and grenades. The benefit of this feat (and similar ranged-based benefits) do not extend to Short Range when used with an Accurate weapon or a scope.] SSotG: This feat works normally with vehicle weapons. However, if you are using a missile or a torpedo and you miss with your attack roll, the projectile does not gain the benefit of this feat for the second attack roll.

feats_list.name: Poison Resistance
feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 Fort Def v. Poison, half dam if fail

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 bonus to your Fortitude Defense when attacked by poison. If the attack succeeds, you take only half damage.

feats_list.name: Power Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: Subtract from melee attack rolls to add same number to melee damage rolls (up to BAB). Bonus doubled for two-handed wielding.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: On your action, before making an attack roll, you may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage applies until the start of your next turn.
feats_list.full_text_description: On your action, before making an attack roll, you may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage applies until the start of your next turn. Special: If you attack with a two-handed weapon, or with a one-handed weapon wielded in two hands, instead add twice the number subtracted from your attack rolls. You can't add the bonus from Power Attack to the damage dealt against an object or vehicle.
feats_list.special_text: If you attack with a two-handed weapon, or with a one-handed weapon wielded in two hands, instead add twice the number subtracted from your attack rolls. You can't add the bonus from Power Attack to the damage dealt against an object or vehicle.

feats_list.name: Power Blast
feats_list.benefit_summary: trade Atk bonus on ranged atk for dam (BAB), no Str 13 -5 Atk

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, before making an attack roll, you can choose to subtract a number from all ranged attack rolls and add the same number to all ranged damage rolls. This number cannot exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage applies until the start of your next turn but you gain no bonus to damage with area attacks or when attacking objects or vehicles from this feat. Special: If you do not have a Strength of 13 or higher, you take a -5 penalty to attacks when using this feat with non-vehicle weapons.

feats_list.name: Powerful Charge
feats_list.benefit_summary: When you charge, gain an additional +2 to melee attack roll and deal extra damage equal to 1/2 your level.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can charge with extra force. When you charge, you gain an additional +2 bonus to your melee attack roll. If your melee attack hits, you deal additional damage equal to one-half your level.
feats_list.full_text_description: When you charge, you gain an additional +2 bonus to your melee attack roll. If your melee attack hits, you deal additional damage equal to one-half your level. [[Can be used by a mount.]]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Medium or larger size, base attack bonus +1

feats_list.name: Powerful Rage
feats_list.benefit_summary: +4 Str checks & Str skill checks while raging

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +4 bonus on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks when raging.

feats_list.name: Precise Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: No -5 penalty for shooting or throwing a ranged weapon at an opponent engaged in melee with an ally.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are skilled at timing your ranged attacks so that you don't hit your allies by mistake. You can shoot or throw a ranged weapon at an opponent engaged in melee combat with one or more of your allies without taking the standard -5 penalty (see Shooting or Throwing into a Melee, page 161).
feats_list.full_text_description: You can shoot or throw a ranged weapon at an opponent engaged in melee combat with one or more of your allies without taking the standard -5 penalty (see Shooting or Throwing into a Melee, CR page 161).

feats_list.name: Predictive Defense
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use Dex or Int mod to determine Ref Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use either your Dexterity modifier or your Intelligence modifier to determine your Reflex Defense. [[HR: You still lose your INT bonus to Ref if you are flat-footed.]]

feats_list.name: Prime Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: if none of your allies are closer than you, +1 ranged atk (short or closer)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: If none of your allies is closer to your target than you are when you make a ranged attack, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. Your target must be at short range or closer to gain this bonus.

feats_list.name: Primitive Warrior
feats_list.benefit_summary: +1 die dam with simple melee weapons

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You deal +1 die of damage with simple melee weapons.

feats_list.name: Quick Comeback
feats_list.benefit_summary: when moved down CT can move +1 up CT until end of next turn
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are moved down the condition track by an attack that deals damage that equals or exceeds your damage threshold, until the end of your next turn you can move +1 step on the condition track as a single swift action. You can use this feat only once per attack that moves you down the condition track.

feats_list.name: Quick Draw
feats_list.benefit_summary: Draw or holster a weapon as a swift action instead of a move action.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can draw and holster weapons with startling quickness. You can draw or holster a weapon as a swift action instead of as a move action.
feats_list.full_text_description: You can draw or holster a weapon as a swift action instead of as a move action. [If a Jedi has the Quick Draw feat and wanted to draw his lightsaber, he does not have to use another swift action to activate the lightsaber. The "draw a weapon" action normally includes everything necessary to render that weapon immediately usable, including deactivating the safety on a blaster pistol and activating a lightsaber or vibroblade.]

feats_list.name: Quick Draw + Dual Weapon Mastery I
feats_list.benefit_summary: draw or holster 2 weapons as single swif action

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can draw or holster two weapons with a single swift action; you must have both hands free to draw both weapons, and each weapon must be able to be held in one hand.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Combo, requires Dual Weapon Mastery I

feats_list.name: Quick Draw + WP (lightsabers)
feats_list.benefit_summary: draw and ignite lightsaber as single swif action

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can draw and ignite your lightsaber as a single swift action.

feats_list.name: Quick Skill
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter, can take 10 when rushed, can take 20 in half time

effects.target_description: half time

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can take 10 when rushed on a single skill check for a skill you are trained in, unless the skill description explicitly forbids it. Alternatively, you can take 20 when using a skill you are trained in at half the normal time required. Normal: Taking 20 normally requires 20 times the amount of time needed by a regular skill check.

feats_list.name: Rancor Crush
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you Pin an opponent & use Crush feat, target -1 CT

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you successfully pin an enemy with the Pin feat (see page 87 of the Saga Edition core rulebook) and use the Crush feat at the same time, the enemy moves -1 step down the condition track in addition to taking damage. Normal: The Crush feat deals damage to a grappled enemy but does not move the enemy along the condition track.

feats_list.name: Rapid Reaction
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc you can use two different reactions to the same trigger
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can use two different reactions in response to the same trigger. For example, if you use the Deflect talent and fail to negate the attack, you can also use negate energy as a response to the same attack. Normal: Without this feat, you can use only one reaction in response to a particular trigger.

feats_list.name: Rapid Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: With a ranged weapon, fire two shots as a single attack (-2 attack penalty, +1 die damage). Expends 2 shots. (Errata applied)
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can make two quick shots with a ranged weapon as a single attack. When using a ranged weapon, you may fire two shots as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but you deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack.
feats_list.errata_applied: Strength prerequisite removed. Special text added regarding STR 13 for penalty with non-vehicle weapons.
feats_list.full_text_description: When using a ranged weapon, you may fire two shots as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but you deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack. Special: Using this feat fires two shots and can only be done if the weapon has sufficient ammunition remaining. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Burst Fire feat (page 82) or Deadeye feat (page 84). If you do not have a Strength of 13 or higher, increase the penalty to attacks to -5 when using this feat with non-vehicle weapons. SSotG: This feat works normally with vehicle weapons. However, if you are using a missile or a torpedo and you miss with your attack roll, the projectile does not gain the benefit of this feat for the second attack roll.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +1, proficient with weapon
feats_list.special_text: Using this feat fires two shots and can only be done if the weapon has sufficient ammunition remaining. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Burst Fire feat (page 82) or Deadeye feat (page 84). If you do not have a Strength of 13 or higher, increase the penalty to attacks to –5 when using this feat with non-vehicle weapons. (Errata p.290 [cite: 2003])

feats_list.name: Rapid Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: With a melee weapon, make two strikes as a single attack (-2 attack penalty, +1 die damage). (Errata applied)
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can make two quick strikes with a melee weapon as a single attack. When using a melee weapon, you may make two strikes as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but you deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Mighty Swing feat.
feats_list.errata_applied: Dexterity prerequisite removed. Special text added regarding DEX 13 for penalty with non-light weapons.
feats_list.full_text_description: When using a melee weapon, you may make two strikes as a single attack against a single target. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, but you deal +1 die of damage with a successful attack. The effects of this feat do not stack with the extra damage provided by the Mighty Swing feat. Special: If you do not have a Dexterity of 13 or higher, increase the penalty to attacks to –5 when using this feat with non-light weapons. [[Does not work with Whirlwind Attack.]]
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Base attack bonus +1, proficient with weapon
feats_list.special_text: If you do not have a Dexterity of 13 or higher, increase the penalty to attacks to –5 when using this feat with non-light weapons. (Errata p.290)

feats_list.name: Rapport
feats_list.benefit_summary: additional +2 aid another, does not stack with Coordinate

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the aid another action, you grant an additional +2 insight bonus on skill checks and attack rolls to the character you are assisting. This bonus does not stack with any bonus provided by the noble's Coordinate talent.

feats_list.name: Read the Winds
feats_list.benefit_summary: ignore concealment & cover for Perception w/in 10 sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You ignore concealment and cover for the purposes of Perception checks against targets within 10 squares of you.

feats_list.name: Rebel Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: if move before & after attack +2 Ref Def
feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you use the Running Attack feat to move both before and after making an attack, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Recall
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per day, reroll trained Knowledge check, taking best
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per day, you can reroll any check for a Knowledge skill that you are trained in, using the better result.

feats_list.name: Recovering Surge
feats_list.benefit_summary: move +1 up CT when catch Second Wind
feats_list.full_text_description: When you catch a second wind, you move +1 step on the condition track.

feats_list.name: Recurring Success
feats_list.benefit_summary: choose one talent or feat. That feat may be used once more /enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you select this feat, choose one talent or feat that can normally be used only once per encounter. You can use that talent or feat one additional time per encounter. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different skill to gain the benefits of this talent. [[Cannot be used with talents that allow for 3 actions]]

feats_list.name: Regenerative Healing
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/day with Second Wind regain no hp but gain 5 hp at end of each turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per day when you catch a second wind, you can regain no hit points immediately and instead regain 5 hit points at the end of each of your turns until you reach full hit points or until the end of the encounter (whichever comes first).

feats_list.name: Relentless Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: if miss, add +2 on next atk roll before end of next turn against missed

effects.target_description: next atk roll before end of next turn against missed

feats_list.full_text_description: Choose one weapon group or exotic weapon for which you have the Double Attack feat. Whenever you miss a target with that weapon, you gain a +2 competence bonus on your next attack roll made before the end of your next turn against the missed target. Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you select this feat, it applies to a different weapon group or exotic weapon.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Proficient with weapon used*, Double Attack with weapon used, BAB +6

feats_list.name: Republic Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: Once per encounter as reac, gain DR10 if you have cover even v. aim
feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a reaction, you gain DR 10 against an incoming attack if you have cover from the attacker. You can gain the DR as long as you have cover, even if your opponent uses aim to ignore your cover bonus to Reflex Defense.

feats_list.name: Resilient Strength
feats_list.benefit_summary: can use Str or Con mod to determine Fort Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can use either your Strength modifier or your Constitution modifier to determine your Fortitude Defense.

feats_list.name: Resolute Stance
feats_list.benefit_summary: fight defensively to gain +2 or +5 to Will Def with no attacks

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you fight defensively, you gain a +2 morale bonus to your Will Defense. If you make no attacks until your next turn, you gain a +5 morale bonus to your Will Defense until the start of your next turn. Normal: When you fight defensively, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense. If you make no attacks until your next turn, you gain a +5 dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Resurgence
feats_list.benefit_summary: catch second wind & immediately gain immediate move action
feats_list.full_text_description: When you catch your second wind, you immediately gain a move action to be used immediately.

feats_list.name: Resurgent Vitality
feats_list.benefit_summary: with Second Wind gain additional hp = twice Con bonus (min 2)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you catch a second wind, you regain an additional number of hit points equal to twice your Constitution bonus (minimum 2).

feats_list.name: Return Fire
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc as reac ranged atk v. target that missed you w/ranged atk in LOS

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Select one exotic weapon or weapon group. Once per encounter as a reaction, you can make a single ranged attack with the chosen weapon or group against an enemy that misses you with a ranged attack, provided you have line of sight to that enemy. Special: If you have the Combat Reflexes feat, you may use this feat a number of times during an encounter equal to your Dexterity bonus, but no more than once during a given enemy's turn. This feat does not apply to vehicle weapons or heavy weapons. You must have your weapon in hand to use this feat. You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different weapon group or exotic weapon.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Weapon Focus (chosen exotic ranged weapon or weapon group)
prerequisites_structured.name: Weapon Focus

feats_list.prerequisites_text: DEX 15, Quick Draw, Weapon Focus (chosen exotic ranged weapon or weapon group), BAB +1

feats_list.name: Returning Bug
feats_list.benefit_summary: if you miss with razor or thud bug it automatically returns

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you miss with a razor bug or a thud bug (see page 64), the weapon returns to your hand immediately.

feats_list.name: Riflemaster
feats_list.benefit_summary: Blaster Carbine can brace set to autofire, Blaster Rifle is accurate, Heavy Blaster Rifle dam dice d12, Light Repeating Blaster as if M not L

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack with a rifle, you gain one of the following benefits, depending on the kind of rifle you use. Blaster Carbine: You can brace a blaster carbine set to autofire, even though it is not an autofire-only weapon. Blaster Rifle: You treat the blaster rifle as an accurate weapon. Heavy Blaster Rifle: When you use a heavy blaster rifle, the damage dice increase from d10 to d12. Light Repeating Blaster: You treat the light repeating blaster as if it were Medium instead of Large.

feats_list.name: Risk Taker
feats_list.benefit_summary: fall only if fail by 10 or more & make Jump to land safely, can spend FP & add to distance jumped & must land on solid surface

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You fall only if you fail a Climb check by 10 or more. Additionally, if you make a Jump check and fail to land on a safe or solid surface (such as if you fall into a pit or fail to clear a stream of lava), you can spend a Force Point as a free action and add the result of the Force Point roll to your distance jumped. However, you must land in the first available safe square. Normal: You fall if you fail a Climb check by 5 or more.

feats_list.name: Running Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: When making a melee or ranged attack, can move both before and after the attack (total distance not greater than speed).
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You can move as you attack. When making an attack with a melee or ranged weapon, you can move both before and after the attack, provided that your total distance moved is not greater than your speed.
feats_list.full_text_description: When making an attack with a melee or ranged weapon, you can move both before and after the attack, provided that your total distance moved is not greater than your speed. [[Can be used by a mount. wording implies one single attack; not compatible with charge or multiple attacks, even if you have an ability that allows for multiple attacks as a standard action. I don't think it's compatible with lightsaber form powers. Once you activate your lightsaber form power as a standard action, the target is usually "one enemy within your reach." I think that means, One enemy within your reach at the time you activate the power. Therefore, you can't activate the power if you're not within melee reach of your target, and then use Running Attack to get to your target. On the other hand, it can be argued that as along as you're making an attack, the fact that it is the result of a Force power is irrelevant. It can also be argued that as long as you're making a melee or ranged attack, then it doesn't matter if you make more than one attack.]]

feats_list.name: Running Attack + Dodge
feats_list.benefit_summary: add Dodge bonus to Ref Def v. Atk of opp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can add your Dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense against anyone who makes an attack of opportunity against you while using the Running Attack feat.

feats_list.name: Sadistic Strike
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you deliver a coup de grace all enemies in LOS move -1 CT until end of enc
feats_list.full_text_description: When you deliver a coup de grace to a helpless creature, all opponents within line of sight move -1 step on the condition track until the end of the encounter.

feats_list.name: Savage Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: with full attack if hit on first attack, +1 die dam v. same target

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Choose one of the weapon groups or exotic weapons you selected for the Double Attack feat. When you use a full attack action and successfully hit the target with your first attack, you deal +1 die of damage on each successful attack remaining in the full attack action made against that target.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Double Attack (chosen weapon), proficient with weapon*, BAB +6

feats_list.name: Scavenger
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1 hour scavenging, Perception check to determine value

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can spend 1 hour scavenging materials from other vehicles or objects. When you do so, you make a Perception check to determine the value of the parts scavenged. You produce raw materials equal in value to the result of your Perception check x 30 credits. You must apply these raw materials toward the cost of construction of a single object (see the build object application of the Mechanics skill, described on FU page 30), and you can scavenge parts for only a single object at any given time. Additionally, you can scavenge raw materials only once for any given object you are attempting to build.

feats_list.name: Scion of Dorin
feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 Fort Def v. natural hazards

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense against all natural hazards.

feats_list.name: Sensor Link
feats_list.benefit_summary: as swif broadcast input to any receiver in 24 sq as if they were with you, allies can use aid another on Perception

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can broadcast the input from your audio, visual, and any special sensors to a droid ally, com link, communications system, or holographic receiver within 24 squares. That ally is aware of anything you are aware of, and can use the aid another action to aid on your Perception checks even if you do not have line of sight to one another. lf both you and your ally have Sensor Link, you share information simultaneously, granting a +2 bonus to Perception checks. Special: Cyborgs with built-in cybernetic sensors and communications gear can also take this feat.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Droid or cyborg with associated hardware

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid or cyborg with associated hardware

feats_list.name: Separatist Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: +1 Atk to one attack if adjacent to ally

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: While you are adjacent to at least one of your allies, gain a +1 circumstance bonus on any one attack roll you make on your turn.

feats_list.name: Shake It Off
feats_list.benefit_summary: Spend two swift actions (instead of three) to move +1 step along the condition track.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You have learned to shake off debilitating conditions. You can spend two swift actions instead of three swift actions to move +1 step along the condition track (see Conditions, page 148).
feats_list.full_text_description: You can spend two swift actions instead of three swift actions to move +1 step along the condition track (see Conditions, page 148). Normal: It takes three swift actions to move +1 step along the condition track.
feats_list.normal_text: It takes three swift actions to move +1 step along the condition track.

feats_list.name: Sharp Senses
feats_list.benefit_summary: when spend Force Point to Perception, increase die type by 2 steps

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to a Perception check, increase the die type by two steps (from d6 to d10, or from d8 to d12).

feats_list.name: Shield Surge
feats_list.benefit_summary: as reac if dam over SR reduce dam to vehicle by remaining SR amount & SR reduced by same amount, recharge shields can't be used for 1 full rnd

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a reaction, when your vehicle takes damage above its shield rating, after the shield rating is reduced you can reduce the amount of damage sustained by the vehicle by an amount up to the remaining shield rating (see page 161 of the Saga Edition core rulebook) . However, the shield rating is immediately reduced by one point for every point of damage reduced. Special: The Recharge Shields action cannot be used on the vehicle until a full round after the use of Shield Surge.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Droid or cyborg with scomp link or similar direct data link with the vehicle

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Droid or cyborg with scomp link or similar direct data link with the vehicle, trained in Mechanics skill.

feats_list.name: Shrewd Bargainer
feats_list.benefit_summary: when you use Persuasion target does not receive bonuses to Will Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you make a Persuasion check against a target's Will Defense, the target does not receive the benefit of insight or morale bonuses to its Will Defense.

feats_list.name: Signature Device
feats_list.benefit_summary: one item two traits from Tech Spec, switch between with swif

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You designate a single weapon, suit of armor, vehicle, or other item as your signature item. When making Mechanics checks to modify that piece of equipment, you can take 10 on the check. In addition, you can allow the device to gain two traits from the Tech Specialist feat. To install the second trait, you must succeed on a DC 30 Mechanics check. Once installed, the device can use only one trait at a time, and switching from one trait to the other requires a swift action to adjust the item's settings. You can have only one signature device at a time, but you can designate another device as your signature item (the former signature item loses all benefit gained from this feat). [[This feat works with Superior Tech, because Superior Tech speficially says it replaces the Tech Specialist functions.]]

feats_list.name: Silver Tongue
feats_list.benefit_summary: Intimidate or change attitude as a standard not full
feats_list.full_text_description: You can intimidate a creature or change its attitude as a standard action. Normal: Intimidating a creature or changing its attitude requires a full-round action.

feats_list.name: Sith Military Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/encounter, if reduce opp to 0hp or over thresh, w/in 6sq of opp -2 def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a reaction when you reduce a target to 0 hit points or deal damage that exceeds the target's damage threshold, you can activate this feat to cause all enemies within 6 squares of that target to take a -2 to defenses until the end of your next turn. This is a mind-affecting effect.

feats_list.name: Skill Challenge: Catastrophic Avoidance
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/challenge catastrophic fail only by 15, and only 1 failure, not 2

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per skill challenge that has a chance of catastrophic failure, this failure occurs only if you fail a skill check by 15 or more. In addition , when a catastrophic failure occurs, you accrue one failure in the skill challenge, not two. Special: This feat is allowed only in campaigns that use the skill challenge rules described in Chapter 2.

feats_list.name: Skill Challenge: Last Resort
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/challenge if third failure accrues, you or ally can reroll & keep better

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per skill challenge, when you or an ally accrues a third failure (which would normally end the skill challenge), you or the ally can reroll the attempt, keeping the better result. Special: This feat is allowed only in campaigns that use the skill challenge rules described in Chapter 2.

feats_list.name: Skill Challenge: Recovery
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/challenge treat the challenge as if it had the recovery effect

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per skill challenge, you treat the challenge as if it had the recovery effect, even if it does not have that effect. Special: This feat is allowed only in campaigns that use the skill challenge rules described in Chapter 2.

feats_list.name: Skill Focus
feats_list.benefit_summary: Gain +5 competence bonus on skill checks with one chosen trained skill.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: One of your skills is particularly well honed. You gain a +5 competence bonus on skill checks made with one trained skill of your choice.
feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +5 competence bonus on skill checks made with one trained skill of your choice. Special: This feat may be selected multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a different trained skill.
feats_list.special_text: This feat may be selected multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a different trained skill.

feats_list.name: Skill Training
feats_list.benefit_summary: Choose one untrained skill from your list of class skills; you become trained in it.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are considered trained in a new skill. Choose one untrained skill from your list of class skills. You become trained in that skill.
feats_list.full_text_description: Choose one untrained skill from your list of class skills. You become trained in that skill. Special: This feat may be selected multiple times. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a different class skill.
feats_list.special_text: This feat may be selected multiple times. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a different class skill.

feats_list.name: Slammer
feats_list.benefit_summary: as stan action slam 2 appendages crushing target, deal unarmed dam w/Str bonus x2 & if over thresh = persistent condition

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: As a standard action, you slam two of your appendages together from either side of an enemy, crushing your target between them. Make a melee attack. If the attack is successful, you deal unarmed damage with double your Strength bonus. If you also exceed the target's damage threshold, it has a persistent condition that can be removed only with 8 hours of rest or a DC 20 Treat Injury check (not need to be trained-only). Special: If you also have the Crush feat, increase your unarmed damage by 1 die when using Slammer.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Small or larger droid with 2 appropriate appendages

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Small or larger droid with 2 appropriate appendages, Str 13

feats_list.name: Slicer Team (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Use Computer & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), aid another provides +4

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Use Computer checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you use the aid another action to assist an ally who has this feat with a Use Computer check, you provide a bonus of +4 instead of +2.

feats_list.name: Slippery Maneuver
feats_list.benefit_summary: apply Dodge to two opp, use withdraw at full spd v. Dodge opp

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can apply the effects of the Dodge feat against attacks made from two opponents. In addition, when you use the withdraw action to move away from a target against whom you use the Dodge feat, you can move at your full speed. You still provoke an attack of opportunity if you must move more than 1 square to escape a threatened area. Normal: The benefit of Dodge applies to one target. Once you clear a threatened area, you can continue to move up to a total of half your speed.

feats_list.name: Sniper
feats_list.benefit_summary: Always ignore soft cover when making a ranged attack.
feats_list.benefit_text_long: You are particularly adept at hitting the right target in a crowd. You always ignore soft cover (that is, cover provided by a character, creature, or droid) when you make a ranged attack.
feats_list.full_text_description: You always ignore soft cover (that is, cover provided by a character, creature, or droid) when you make a ranged attack. Normal: You can only ignore cover if you aim (see page 154) before making a ranged attack.
feats_list.normal_text: You can only ignore cover if you aim (see page 154) before making a ranged attack.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4

feats_list.name: Sniper Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: +2 ranged Atk, -5 Ref Def, not with vehicle or heavy weapons

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When wielding only weapons with which you are proficient, you can gain a +2 bonus on your ranged attack, but you take a -5 penalty to Reflex Defense until the beginning of your next turn. The bonus to attacks applies to all attack rolls made until the beginning of your next turn. Special: This feat cannot be used with vehicle weapons or heavy weapons.

feats_list.name: Spacer's Surge
feats_list.benefit_summary: when roll Nat 20 on Pilot check, gain Force Point to use before end of enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you roll a natural 20 on a Pilot check, you gain 1 temporary Force Point. If that Force Point is not spent before the end of the encounter, it is lost.

feats_list.name: Sport Hunter
feats_list.benefit_summary: Slugthrower Pistol at PB +1 die dam, Slugthrower Rifle dam d12, Sporting Blaster Pistol reroll any rolls of 1 for dam, Sporting Blaster Rifle +1 atk when aiming
feats_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack with a slugthrower or sporting weapon, you gain one of the following benefits, depending on the kind of weapon you use. Slugthrower Pistol: When you use a slugthrower pistol at point-blank range, you deal an extra +1 die of damage with the weapon. Slugthrower Rifle: When you use a slugthrower rifle, the damage dice increase from d8 to dl2. Sporting Blaster Pistol: When you use a sporting blaster pistol, reroll any result of 1 on the damage dice until you get a result other than 1. Sporting Blaster Rifle: When you use a sporting blaster rifle, you gain a + 1 bonus to attack rolls when you aim before firing.

feats_list.name: Spray Shot
feats_list.benefit_summary: reduce autofire to 1 square

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When you have a weapon set on autofire, you can reduce the area targeted by your autofire attack to 1 square.

feats_list.name: Staggering Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: melee atk -2 atk & deal dam target -2 to skill checks or you can take -5 atk for -5 to skills

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using a melee weapon, you can make an attack that disrupts an enemy's concentration. You take a -2 penalty to your attack roll, and if your attack deals damage, the target takes a -2 penalty to skill checks until the end of your next turn. Alternatively, you can take a -5 penalty to your attack roll, and if your attack deals damage, the target takes a -5 penalty to skill checks until the end of your next turn.

feats_list.name: Staggering Attack
feats_list.benefit_summary: if deal extra dice dam, can move 2 sq per extra die not used
feats_list.full_text_description: Any time you would deal additional damage from a feat [[or talent]] that grants one or more extra dice of damage, you can forgo the extra damage to move the target 2 squares per extra die sacrificed. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: Rapid Shot or Rapid Strike or Sneak Attack talent
prerequisites_structured.name: Rapid Shot or Rapid Strike or Sneak Attack talent

feats_list.prerequisites_text: Rapid Shot or Rapid Strike or Sneak Attack talent

feats_list.name: Stand Tall
feats_list.benefit_summary: 1/enc when you take dam all allies w/in 6 sq & LOS may atk attacker, reac

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter when you take damage, all allies who are within 6 squares of you and within your line of sight can, as a reaction, make a single attack on the target that damaged you.

feats_list.name: Starship Designer
feats_list.benefit_summary: you can design a starship from scratch

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description:
You can design a starship from scratch. Doing so takes a minimum of 30 days and a DC 25 Mechanics check, adding 1 to the DC and 1 day to the time for every additional 100,000 credits of the design's final cost beyond the first 100,000 credits (even a genius starship designer can spend years working out the blueprints for a Star Destroyer). Other characters trained in the Mechanics skill may use the aid another action to assist your Mechanics check; if any assisting character also has the Starship Designer feat, divide the starship's cost by the number of characters who have this feat (including the primary designer) when determining the time required. When making modifications to starships, you never treat the work as if though it were a nonstandard modification, even if it normally would be (see Nonstandard Modifications, SotG page 39). Additionally, you can make custom modifications to starships. Each of these modifications has a base cost of 5,000 credits (multiplied by the star-ship size cost modifier given on SotG page 38) and requires a DC 25 Mechanics check. On a failed check, the modification fails; you must spend half again as much time and money to make a second attempt, and you gain a +2 bonus on your Mechanics check for each attempt after the first. Installation of a custom modification normally takes one day per 5,000 credits of final cost. The same system can be customized multiple times, but doing so becomes increasingly difficult and expensive. For every previous custom modification on a given system, increase the DC by 5 and the base cost by 10,000 credits. No system can be customized more than three times. Multiple benefits from successive customizations stack. Typical customizations are described below. The Gamemaster may allow other modifications.
•Add Emplacement: You add 1 unused emplacement point to a starship. 
•Improve Hull: You add a number of hit points to a starship equal to 1/2 its Strength score (rounded down to the nearest multiple of 10). 
•Improve Hyperdrive: You can reengineer a hyperdrive to improve its class by 1 step (x2 to x1, x1 to x.75, and so on). The hyperdrive obeys all the restrictions of its new class. (This is the primary way that class .75 and class .5 hyperdrives come into existence.)
•Improve Shields: The SR of the shields is increased by 5.
•Improve Weapons: You can grant one weapon a +1 equipment bonus on attack rolls.
See SotG Chapter 3 for more information on designing and modifying starships.

feats_list.name: Superior Tech
feats_list.benefit_summary: see page 24-25 SV

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description:
Select one of the following: armor, weapons, droids, vehicles, or devices. You can install advanced traits when modifying the selected type of equipment. These traits replace the traits granted by the Tech Specialist feat. You may still use the Tech Specialist options if you so choose. You must pay one-fifth the cost of the device, armor, weapon, droid, or vehicle you wish to modify or 2,000 credits, whichever is more, before beginning the modification. This fee replaces the normal cost of modification from the Tech Specialist feat. Completing the modification requires 1 day per 1,000 credits of the modification's cost. At the end of this time, make a DC 30 Mechanics check; you cannot take 10 or take 20 on this check. If the check succeeds, the modification is completed successfully, and the object gains the desired trait. If the check fails, you lose all credits spent making the modification, and the object does not gain the desired trait. However, you can start over from scratch if you wish. Only characters with the Tech Specialist feat can assist you, reducing proportionately the time needed to complete the modification. At the end of modification process, they can make a Mechanics check to aid your check. The market value of a modified item is equal to the base cost of the item plus double the cost of the modifications made to it (not including credits wasted on failed modification attempts). Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different set of traits (armor, devices, droids, vehicles, or weapons).
•Mobile Armor (armor): Increase the armor’s speed by 1 square (medium and heavy armors only). 
•Reinforced Armor (armor): The armor grants damage reduction 2. 
•Superior Agile Armor (armor): Increase the armor’s maximum Dexterity bonus by 2. 
•Superior Fortifying Armor (armor): Increase the armor’s equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense by 2. 
•Superior Helmet Package (armor): The armor grants a +5 equipment bonus on Perception checks. 
•Superior Protective Armor (armor): Increase the armor’s armor bonus to Reflex Defense by 2. 
•Superior Durability (device): Increase the device’s DR by 2 and its hit points by 150%. [[Unofficial errata: should be 50%, not 150%. This would follow the logical progression from Tech Specialist]]
•Reinforced Device (device): The device's break DC increases by 5.
•Superior Mastercraft (device): Skill checks made using the device gain a +2 equipment bonus, or any existing equipment bonus increases by 2. 
•Superior Strength (device): Increase the device’s Strength score by 4. 
•Superior Upgrade (device): The device gains two additional upgrade slots. 
•Ion Dispersal Coating (droid): The droid gains DR 5 against ion damage. 
•Superior Ability (droid): Increase the droid’s Dexterity, Intelligence or Strength by 4. 
•Superior Ability (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s Dexterity score by 4 or its Strength score by 2. 
•Superior Sensors (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s Perception modifier by 2. 
•Superior Shields (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s SR by 10. 
•Superior Speed (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s speed by one-third of its base speed (minimum 1 square). 
•Superior Accuracy (weapon): The weapon gains a +2 equipment bonus on attack rolls. 
•Superior Capacity (weapon): The weapon’s power pack provides double the normal number of shots. 
•Superior Damage (weapon): The weapon deals +5 damage. If the weapon has a damage multiplier, apply the extra damage before applying the multiplier. 
•Superior Range (Weapon): The weapon’s ranges all increase by 50%. 
*S&V 48: Device Traits: Weapons, armor, and vehicles are also devices, so they are eligible for all of these modifications. (Droids are characters, not devices.) In addition to the listed modifications, it is possible to install an additional upgrade slot on any device using the Tech Specialist feat. This modification can be made only once. 
Droid Traits: Any equipment with the droidification upgrade (page 40) or weapon with the autonomous upgrade (page 42) is technically a droid, so it is eligible for these modifications. 
Armor Traits : If a device or vehicle has an armor bonus to its Reflex Defense (either normally or because of an upgrade). it can benefit from the protective armor modification. 
*optional: you can consider increasing the license value for this upgrade, causing the buyer the need to acquire a new license.

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description:
You can modify a device, suit of armor, weapon, droid, or vehicle so that it gains a special trait. Specific traits are given on the table below. You may perform only one modification at a time. Unless noted otherwise, you cannot grant more than one benefit to a single device, suit of armor, weapon, droid, or vehicle, and you cannot apply the same benefit more than once. Before beginning the modification, you must pay one-tenth the cost of the device, suit of armor, weapon, droid, or vehicle you wish to modify or 1,000 credits, whichever is more. Completing the modification requires 1 day per 1,000 credits of the modification's cost. At the end of this time, make a DC 20 Mechanics check; you can't take 10 or take 20 on this check. If the check succeeds, the modification is completed successfully, and the object gains the desired trait. If the check fails, you lose all credits spent making the modification, and the object doesn't gain the desired trait. However, you may start over if you wish. Other characters trained in the Mechanics skill can assist you, reducing proportionately the time needed to complete the modification. At the end of the modification process, they can make a Mechanics check to aid your check. The market value of a modified item is equal to the base cost of the item + double the cost of the modifications made to it (not including credits wasted on failed modification attempts). 
•Agile Armor (armor*): Increase the armor’s maximum Dexterity bonus by 1. 
•Fortifying Armor (armor*): Increase the armor’s equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense by 1. 
•Protective Armor (armor*): Increase the armor’s armor bonus to Reflex Defense by 1. 
•Additional Upgrade (device*): The device gains an additional upgrade slot. 
•Enhanced Strength (device*): Increase the device’s Strength score by 2. 
•Improved Durability (device*): The device's damage reduction increases by 1, and it gains extra hit points equal to one-quarter of its maximum hit points.
•Mastercraft Device (device*): Skill checks made using the device gain a +1 equipment bonus, or the device's existing equipment bonus increases by 1.
•Enhanced Ability (droid*): Increase the droid’s Dexterity, Intelligence or Strength by 2. 
•Enhanced Intelligence (droid*): Increase the droid's Intelligence score by 2.
•Enhanced Strength (droid*): Increase the droid's Strength score by 2.
•Enhanced Dexterity (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s Dexterity score by 2. 
•Improved Speed (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s speed by one-quarter of its base speed (minimum 1 square). 
•Improved Shields (vehicle): Increase the vehicle’s SR by 5. 
•Improved Accuracy (weapon): The weapon gains a +1 equipment bonus on attack rolls. 
•Improved Damage (weapon): The weapon deals +2 points of damage with a successful hit. If the weapon has a damage multiplier (for example, 6d10x2), apply the extra damage before applying the multiplier.
•Selective Fire (Weapon): An autofire-only ranged weapon can be set to fire single shots, or a single-shot ranged weapon can be made to have an autofire mode. It is still treated as an autofire-only weapon for purposes of bracing (Not allowed for weapons that have a burst radius or splash radius.)
*S&V 48: Device Traits: Weapons, armor, and vehicles are also devices, so they are eligible for all of these modifications. (Droids are characters, not devices.) In addition to the listed modifications, it is possible to install an additional upgrade slot on any device using the Tech Specialist feat. This modification can be made only once. 
According to the devs, you may add an upgrade slot to advanced cybernetics using Tech Specialist or Increase Size (S&V). You may use TS's device traits on advanced cybernetics.
Droid Traits: Any equipment with the droidification upgrade (page 40) or weapon with the autonomous upgrade (page 42) is technically a droid, so it is eligible for these modifications. 
Armor Traits : If a device or vehicle has an armor bonus to its Reflex Defense (either normally or because of an upgrade). it can benefit from the protective armor modification.

feats_list.full_text_description: When using the withdraw action, you can move up to 2 squares to escape threatened squares without provoking an attack of opportunity, and you can move your speed. You can spend a Force Point as a reaction to an enemy ending its movement adjacent to you to withdraw. Normal: When using the withdraw action, you can normally move only 1 square to escape a threatened square without provoking an attack of opportunity and can move only up to half your speed.

feats_list.name: Unhindered Approach (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Jump & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), add 1 sq to jump

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Jump checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, when you use the Jump skill, add 1 square to your total jump distance.

feats_list.name: Unified Squadron (team feat)
feats_list.benefit_summary: +3 Pilot & +1 each ally w/feat w/in 12 sq (max +7), always avoid collisions w/allies

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You gain a +3 competence bonus to Pilot checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this feat, the competence bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +7). Additionally, you always succeed when trying to avoid collisions with vehicles piloted by allies who also have this feat (no collisions occur, even at character scale). Dev: Q. Does the Unified Squadron team feat work at starship scale? A. Yes.

feats_list.name: Unleashed
feats_list.benefit_summary: spend Destiny Point to access Unleashed abilities

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description:
You can activate Unleashed abilities by spending a Destiny Point. You must have the Force Sensitivity feat in order to activate Unleashed abilities for Force powers and talents. Normal: You may not use Unleashed abilities and powers without this feat. [[Unleashed feats & talents: Bantha Rush, Charge, Cleave, Devastating Attack, Extreme Effort, Firepower, Ignite Fervor, Keen Shot, Mighty Swing, Penetrating Attack, Rage, Skirmisher, Sneak Attack, Strafe, Whirlwind Attack. Unleashed Force Powers: Battle Meditation, Battle Strike, Corruption, Dark Rage, Force Blast, Force Grip, Force Lightning, Force Storm, Force Thrust, Move Object, Repulse.]]
Unleashed Charge: By spending a Destiny Point, you make an amazing charge attack. As a standard action, you gain a +5 bonus on each attack roll and take a -2 penalty to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. You can move up to twice your speed (minimum 2 squares) in a straight line through obstructed or unobstructed terrain, and then take a full attack action as a part of this standard action instead of a full-round action. Allies do not hinder your ability to charge. Special: If you have the Improved Charge feat, you can alter your course around obstructions and enemies. If you have the Powerful Charge feat, you can apply the benefit of that feat as well.
Unleashed Firepower: By spending a Destiny Point, as a standard action you can fire at up to five separate targets within range of your ranged weapon. Make a single attack roll and compare the result to the Reflex Defense of each target. Roll a single damage roll and apply it to every target successfully hit. Special: Bonuses and penalties from other feats and talents stack with this ability. You can attack each target only once. You must have enough ammunition for each target; otherwise you stop dealing damage when you run out. Aiming provides no benefit on this attack.
Unleashed Rage: By spending a Destiny Point at the start of your rage, you gain an additional + 10 to your melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls and +5 to your Fortitude Defense. At the end of your rage, you move -2 persistent steps along the condition track. The penalties imposed by this condition persist until you take at least 20 minutes to recuperate, during which time you can’t engage in any strenuous activity. Special: Bonuses and penalties from other feats and talents stack with this ability.

feats_list.benefit_summary: can catch more than one Second Wind per encounter

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: You can catch more than one second wind per encounter. Normal: Even if you can catch multiple second winds per day, without this feat you are limited to one second wind per encounter.
feats_list.prerequisites_text: Extra Second Wind, Trained in Endurance

feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 Fort Def & Will Def v. Use the Force

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.name: Unswerving Resolve
feats_list.benefit_summary: if targeted by fear or mind-affecting effect that fails, gain FP to be spent before next turn as long as you did not negate

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are targeted by a fear effect or mind-affecting effect that fails to affect you (such as when the skill check required to use the effect fails to beat your Will defense), you gain a temporary Force Point. If this Force Point is not used before the end of your next turn, it goes away. If you negate the contingent effect in any way (such as by using rebuke to negate a mind-affecting Force power), you do not gain the benefit of this feat.

feats_list.name: Unwavering Focus
feats_list.benefit_summary: when mind-affecting effect is against your Will Def, you impose -2

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

feats_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are targeted by a mind-affecting effect that requires a skill check against your Will Defense, as a reaction you can impose a -2 penalty to that skill check.

feats_list.name: Unwavering Resolve
feats_list.benefit_summary: +5 Will Def v. Deception & Persuasion

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.
