species_list.name: Duros
species_list.description_general: Tall, hairless humanoids from the Duro system, Duros were one of the first species to be a major influence in the Republic, credited with creating the first hyperdrive. They have a natural affinity for space travel and astrogation. Duros tend to be intense and adventurous, proud, self-sufficient, fun-loving, and gregarious. Average 1.8m tall, with blue-gray to deep azure skin, large eyes, and wide, lipless mouths. Homeworld: Duro system. Adventurers include explorers, spacers, scientists, engineers, smugglers, traders, and diplomats. [Source: CRB p.26]

special_qualities.name: Expert Pilot
special_qualities.description: As natural spacers, a Duros may choose to reroll any Pilot check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. [CRB p.26]

species_list.name: Ebruchi
species_list.description_general: The Ebruchi are a sentient species known for their resilience and imposing presence. They are often characterized by their strong will and physical toughness. Their societal structures and specific homeworld details are less commonly documented in widespread galactic records. [Web Source: Based on common Star Wars species information and provided traits.]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Improved Damage Threshold as a bonus feat if your have a CON 13 or better

special_qualities.name: Iron Will
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus to your Will Defense

special_qualities.name: Unsettling
special_qualities.description: Once per encounter, when an Ebruchi successfully uses the Persuasion skill to intimidate a target, the Ebruchi can move the target -1 step on the condition track instead of applying one of the standard intimidation effects. The target must be within 6 squares of the Ebruchi, and the effect lasts until the end of the encounter. This is a mind-affecting effect.

species_list.name: Elomin
species_list.description_general: Elomin are tall, slender humanoids from the planet Elom, distinguished by their pointed ears, tapir-like snouts, and a reputation for meticulous organization and adherence to complex social structures. They value order and efficiency, often excelling in bureaucratic and administrative roles. Elomin society is highly structured, and they are known for their logical minds and ability to coordinate large groups. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Impose Order
special_qualities.description: Once per encounter, an Elomin can spend a swift action to allow each ally within 12 squares to move up to half that ally's speed as a reaction. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

special_qualities.name: Logical Mind
special_qualities.description: You gain a +5 species bonus to Will Defense against mind-affecting effects

species_list.name: Ewok
species_list.description_general: Intelligent omnivores native to a moon of Endor, Ewoks live in tree-dwelling tribes with gender-based division of labor and complex animistic beliefs. Though technologically primitive, they are clever, inquisitive, and inventive. Tend to be curious, superstitious, and courageous, but can be fearful of the new. Average 1m tall. Fur color varies. Homeworld: Forest moon of Endor. Adventurers may be motivated by excitement, inquisitiveness, or warrior quests. [Source: CRB p.26-27]

special_qualities.name: Primitive
special_qualities.description: Ewoks do not gain Weapon Proficiency (pistols, rifles, or heavy weapons) as starting feats at 1st level, even if their class normally grants them. [CRB p.27]

effects.notes: Does not gain these as starting feats even if class normally grants them.

special_qualities.name: Scent
special_qualities.description: Ewoks have a keen sense of smell. At close range (within 10 squares), Ewoks ignore concealment and cover for purposes of Perception checks, and they take no penalty from poor visibility when tracking. [CRB p.27, cite: 146-147]

special_qualities.name: Sneaky
special_qualities.description: An Ewok may choose to reroll any Stealth check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. [CRB p.27]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Ewoks are skilled foragers. An Ewok with Survival as a trained skill gains Skill Focus (Survival) as a bonus feat. [CRB p.27]

species_list.name: Falleen
species_list.description_general: Falleen are a sentient reptilian species known for their striking, exotic beauty and their ability to subtly influence others through the emission of potent pheromones. They possess the ability to alter their skin pigmentation and can hold their breath for extended periods. Falleen are often seen as aloof and calculating, valuing control and precision, and are prominent in organizations like the Black Sun crime syndicate. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Hold Breath
special_qualities.description: You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to 25 x your CON score before having to make Endurance checks to hold your breath

effects.notes: Before Endurance checks are required.

special_qualities.name: Pheromone Acclimation
special_qualities.description: You gain a +5 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense against the pheromones of other Falleen

special_qualities.name: Pheromones
special_qualities.description: As a standard action, you can make a special attack vs adjacent creature; the attack bonus = your character level + your CHA bonus; if the attack equals or exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, the target moves -1 step on the condition track. If you fail, target is immune for 24h. If target reaches -5 CT, instead of falling unconscious, it becomes friendly. Pheromones function as an inhaled poison. Any creature holding its breath is unaffected. A creature can be affected by Falleen pheromones only once per round. Multiple exposures to pheromones from different Falleen in the same round produce no additional effects. A hostile creature cannot be targeted by this effect.

species_list.name: Feeorin
species_list.description_general: Feeorin are a long-lived, powerfully built reptilian species known for their incredible strength, resilience, and potent rage. They possess impressive regenerative capabilities and can enter a state of heightened ferocity in combat. Feeorin are often considered rare due to a past cataclysm on their homeworld, and individuals are known for their tenacity and ability to endure extreme hardship. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Brutal
special_qualities.description: Once per encounter, after making a successful melee attack, a Feeorin may treat its opponents damage threshold as though it were 5 points lower when determining the result of the attack.

special_qualities.name: Great Fortitude
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense

special_qualities.name: Inborn Resilience
special_qualities.description: A Feeorin can use Second Wind even when unconscious (no action required, but the Second Wind can only be taken when the Feeorin would normally get a turn). Taking a Second Wind while unconscious also move the Feeorin +3 steps on the condition track.

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Stronger by Age
special_qualities.description: At middle age, a Feeorin adds a +1 species bonus to all Strength or Constitution checks. At old age, this bonus increases to +2. Feeorin do not increase their Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma or decrease their Strength, Dexterity or Constitution as they age.

species_list.name: Felucian
species_list.description_general: Felucians are a sentient plant-like species native to the vibrant and dangerous jungle world of Felucia. They possess a strong connection to the Force, often manifesting as innate Force abilities. Felucians are known for their natural camouflage, amphibious traits, and a tribal, often primitive culture that coexists with the unique flora and fauna of their planet. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Force Sensitivity as a bonus feat

special_qualities.name: Breathe Underwater
special_qualities.description: You cannot drown in water

effects.details: Cannot drown in water.

special_qualities.name: Force Blast (Innate)
special_qualities.description: Once per encounter a Felucian can make an untrained Use the Force check to activate the Force blast power. A Felucian who takes the Force Training feat automatically adds a single use of the Force blast power to his Force power suite (for free) instead of this ability.

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Natural Camouflage
special_qualities.description: You can choose to reroll any Stealth check to sneak, keeping the better result

special_qualities.name: Primitive
special_qualities.description: Regardless of your starting class, you only gain Weapon Proficiency for the simple weapons group

effects.notes: Regardless of starting class.

special_qualities.name: Weapon Familiarity
special_qualities.description: You treat the Felucian skullblade as a simple weapon instead of an exotic weapon

species_list.name: Fosh
species_list.description_general: Fosh are a diminutive, avian-like sentient species known for their wisdom, diplomatic skills, and unique ability to secrete healing fluids from glands in their wrists. They are often characterized by their calm demeanor and philosophical outlook. Due to their fragility and peaceful nature, they are rarely found in aggressive roles but excel as negotiators and healers. [Web Source: Wookieepedia, based on common Fosh descriptions.]

special_qualities.name: Deceptive
special_qualities.description: You may choose to reroll any Deception check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll).

special_qualities.name: Healing Glands
special_qualities.description: You are always considered to have a medpac or medical kit for the purposes of making Treat Injury checks, and can perform Trained Only applications of the Treat Injury skill even when untrained.

species_list.name: Gamorrean
species_list.description_general: Green-skinned, porcine creatures from Gamorr. Their tendency toward violence makes them valued as criminal enforcers. Gamorrean civilization revolves around never-ending clan wars, preferring large melee weapons. Males live to fight; females farm, hunt, and manufacture weapons. They are brutish, violent, and proud, respecting physical prowess. Average 1.8m tall, with thick green skin, snouts, tusks, and small horns. Homeworld: Gamorr. Adventurers are often escaped slaves or mercenaries. [Source: CRB p.27]

special_qualities.name: Primitive
special_qualities.description: Gamorreans do not gain Weapon Proficiency (pistols, rifles, or heavy weapons) as starting feats at 1st level, even if their class normally grants them. [CRB p.27]

effects.notes: Does not gain these as starting feats even if class normally grants them.

special_qualities.name: Great Fortitude
special_qualities.description: Gamorreans gain a +2 species bonus to their Fortitude Defense, accounting for their great physical resistance. [CRB p.27]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Gamorreans gain Improved Damage Threshold as a bonus feat. [CRB p.27]

species_list.name: Gand
species_list.description_general: Gand are an insectoid species from the ammonia-gas giant planet Gand, famous for their Findsman tradition of ritualistic bounty hunting. They possess regenerative abilities, chitinous exoskeletons, and often require special breathing apparatus off-world. Gands are typically humble, referring to themselves in the third person until they achieve a significant accomplishment. Many are Force-sensitive and follow ancient mystical traditions. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Darkvision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Hardy
special_qualities.description: When you catch a second wind, you regain a number of additional hit points equal to 5 + your character level.

special_qualities.name: Limb Regeneration
special_qualities.description: You can regrow a lost limb in 1d10 days.

special_qualities.name: Special Equipment (Breathing Apparatus Requirement)
special_qualities.description: You require a breathing apparatus and a transliterator. Without a breathing apparatus, a Gand will suffocate. Without a transliterator, a Gand cannot communicate in any language other than Gand. A breathing apparatus costs 2,000 credits, and a year's supply of breathing filters cost 200 credits (50 credits on Gand). A transliterator costs 100 credits. A Gand character begins play with these items at no cost.

effects.starting_equipment_note: Begins play with this item at no cost.
Begins play with this item at no cost.

species_list.name: Gen'Dai
species_list.description_general: The Gen'Dai are a unique and extraordinarily long-lived species characterized by their boneless, nerve-cluster-based physiology, allowing them to sustain incredible amounts of damage and regenerate. They appear as large, heavily armored humanoids, but their true form is a mass of reddish-purple nerve fibers. Gen'Dai are known for their calm demeanor, which can shift to a berserk rage in combat. Due to their rarity and resilience, they are often legendary warriors and bounty hunters. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

species_list.name: Geonosian
species_list.description_general: Geonosians are an insectoid sentient species native to the arid, rocky planet Geonosis. They possess a rigid caste system, with winged aristocrats and wingless drones. Known for their engineering prowess, particularly in droid and weapon manufacturing, they were instrumental in creating the Separatist Droid Army. Geonosians live in hive-like spires and are characterized by their hard exoskeletons and sonic weaponry. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Weapon Proficiency (advanced melee weapons).

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Skill Focus (Mechanics) if trained in Mechanics.

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Natural Armor
special_qualities.description: You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to your Reflex Defense.

special_qualities.name: Radiation Resistance
special_qualities.description: You gain a +5 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense to resist the effect of radiation.

species_list.name: Givin
species_list.description_general: The Givin are skeletal-looking humanoids from the planet Yag'Dhul, known for their exceptional mathematical and astrogation skills. They possess a natural exoskeleton that protects them from vacuum and grants them resilience. Givin society is highly logical and ordered, with a deep cultural appreciation for precision and complex calculations. They are often sought after as navigators and engineers. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Deductive Reasoning
special_qualities.description: You can reroll any Knowledge check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll).

special_qualities.name: Exoskeleton
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense and DR 2.

special_qualities.name: Unique Physiology (Vacuum Immunity)
special_qualities.description: You are immune to the effects of vacuum and to the effects of inhaled chemicals and poisons.

species_list.name: Gotal
species_list.description_general: Gotals are energy-sensitive humanoids from Antar 4, recognizable by their twin conical horns which allow them to perceive electromagnetic fields, radiation, and even the emotional states of others. This unique sense often makes them skilled hunters, trackers, and scouts. While generally peaceful, they are wary of droids due to their disruptive effect on Gotal senses. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Energy Reading
special_qualities.description: Gotals can read the emotions of any sentient being within 6 squares. As a standard action, a Gotal can make a Perception check against a target's Will Defense. A successful check reveals the target's emotional state (such as happy, sad, nervous, or scared).

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Sensor Cones
special_qualities.description: You can use the Sense Force and Sense Surroundings applications of the Use the Force skill untrained.

species_list.name: Gran
species_list.description_general: Gran are a three-eyed sentient species native to the planet Kinyen, though many have spread throughout the galaxy, particularly on Malastare. Their multiple eyes provide excellent depth perception and a wide field of vision. Gran society is generally peaceful and community-oriented, though some individuals can be corrupted by greed or power. They are often found in trade and agricultural roles. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Precise Shot as a bonus feat if you have the Point Blank Shot feat.

special_qualities.name: Darkvision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Target Awareness
special_qualities.description: You take no distance penalties on Perception checks made to notice targets for the first 50 squares between you and the targets.

special_qualities.name: Triple Vision
special_qualities.description: Once/encounter you can aim by taking a swift action instead of two swift actions.

species_list.name: Gungan
species_list.description_general: Omnivorous humanoids native to the swamps of Naboo. Technologically advanced, relying on biotech for homes and production. Culture is peaceful but evolved from clan wars; they admire strength and cunning. Most communities farm or manufacture, trading with other Gungans and reluctantly with Naboo Humans. Tend to be inquisitive, cautious, and suspicious. Range 1.6 to 2m tall, with eyestalks, floppy ears, and long tongues. Homeworld: Naboo. Adventurers may leave to explore or regain warrior spirit. [Source: CRB p.27-28]

special_qualities.name: Expert Swimmer
special_qualities.description: A Gungan may choose to reroll any Swim check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. In addition, a Gungan may choose to take 10 on Swim checks even when distracted or threatened. [CRB p.28]

special_qualities.name: Hold Breath
special_qualities.description: Gungans are at home either in air or water. A Gungan can hold his breath for a number of rounds equal to 25 times his Constitution score before he needs to make Endurance checks to hold his breath. [CRB p.28]

effects.notes: Before Endurance checks are required.

special_qualities.name: Lightning Reflexes
special_qualities.description: Gungans gain a +2 species bonus to their Reflex Defense, accounting for their uncanny ability to avoid danger. [CRB p.28]

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: Gungans ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness. [CRB p.28]

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Weapon Familiarity
special_qualities.description: Gungans with the Weapon Proficiency (simple weapons) feat are proficient with the atlatl and the cesta. (Errata p.297: Gungans treat the atlatl and the cesta as simple weapons instead of exotic weapons.) [CRB p.28]

effects.notes: Errata clarifies they treat these as simple rather than needing WP(Simple) first.

species_list.name: Herglic
species_list.description_general: Herglics are a massive, cetacean-like species from Giju, known for their great size and strength. Historically a spacefaring race with a trade empire, they were later subjugated by the Galactic Empire. Herglics value tradition and oral history, and despite their bulk, they possess a certain degree of manual dexterity. Their large frames make them imposing figures. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Gather Information) if you are trained in the Gather Information skill.

special_qualities.name: Sturdy
special_qualities.description: When you catch a second wind you regain a number of additional hit points equal to 5 + half of your level.

species_list.name: Houk
species_list.description_general: Houk are a physically imposing and aggressive humanoid species known for their strength, resilience, and typically violet skin. They are often found in roles that leverage their intimidating presence, such as mercenaries, enforcers, or pirates. Houk society values strength and directness, and they have a reputation across the galaxy for being formidable and often confrontational. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Natural Armor
special_qualities.description: You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to your Reflex Defense.

special_qualities.name: Physically Intimidating
special_qualities.description: You use your STR bonus instead of your CHA bonus for Persuasion checks made to intimidate others.

species_list.name: Human
species_list.description_general: Humans dominate the Core Worlds and can be found in virtually every corner of the galaxy. They are adaptable, tenacious, and ambitious, diverse in tastes, morals, customs, and habits. Humans average 1.8 meters tall, with varied skin and hair color. They mature around 15 and live beyond 100. Homeworlds include Coruscant, Corellia, Naboo, Tatooine, and Alderaan. Human adventurers are audacious, championing causes. [Source: CRB p.24]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Trained Skill
special_qualities.description: Humans are versatile and accomplished at many tasks. A Human character chooses one additional trained skill at 1st level. The skill must be chosen from the character's list of class skills. [CRB p.24]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Humans gain one bonus feat at 1st level. [CRB p.24]

species_list.name: Hutt
species_list.description_general: Hutts are immense, slug-like gastropods from Nal Hutta, known for their criminal empires, longevity, and resistance to many forms of coercion, including the Force. They possess tough hides and are notoriously manipulative and corrupt. Hutt society is clan-based, with complex alliances and rivalries. [Source: CRB p.285-286 (Other Species section)]

special_qualities.name: Force Resistance
special_qualities.description: You gain a +5 species bonus to your Will Defense against any Use the Force checks. [CRB p.286]

special_qualities.name: Supreme Stability
special_qualities.description: Hutts can't be tripped or knocked prone. [CRB p.286]

special_qualities.name: Skills (Persuasion Reroll)
special_qualities.description: A Hutt may reroll a Persuasion check, keeping the better result. [CRB p.286]

species_list.name: Iktotchi
species_list.description_general: Iktotchi are a horned humanoid species from the moon Iktotch, known for their limited precognitive abilities, allowing them to anticipate immediate future events. They possess tough hides, downward-curving horns, and are often stoic and deliberate in their actions due to their precognitive insights. Their homeworld is subject to fierce storms, which may have contributed to the development of their foresight. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Expert Pilot
special_qualities.description: You may choose to reroll any Pilot check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll).

special_qualities.name: Limited Precognition
special_qualities.description: Once/encounter as a reaction you can grant yourself or a vehicle you are piloting a +2 species bonus to Reflex Defense against any single attack.

special_qualities.name: Natural Armor
special_qualities.description: You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to your Reflex Defense.

species_list.name: Ishi Tib
species_list.description_general: Ishi Tib are an amphibious humanoid species from the planet Tibrin, characterized by their green skin, large eyes on stalks, and prominent beaks. They are known for their sharp intellect, ecological awareness, and skill in organization and management. Ishi Tib society is highly structured, and they are often found in leadership roles or positions requiring careful planning. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Breathe Underwater
special_qualities.description: You cannot drown in water.

effects.details: Cannot drown in water.

special_qualities.name: Ecological Awareness
special_qualities.description: You can roll twice when making a Knowledge (life sciences) check, keeping the better result.

special_qualities.name: Expert Swimmer
special_qualities.description: You can choose to reroll any Swim check, but you must accept the second result, and you can take 10 on Swim checks even when distracted or threatened.

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Natural Weapons (Beak)
special_qualities.description: When you make an unarmed attack, you may choose to use your beak, dealing 1d6 piercing damage.

species_list.name: Ithorian
species_list.description_general: Tall humanoids often called 'Hammerheads,' peaceful and gentle, recognized as talented artists, brilliant agricultural engineers, and skilled diplomats. Greatest ecologists, living in 'herds' in hovering cities to preserve their homeworld's jungles. Travel in massive 'herd ships,' replicas of their native jungle. Tend to be calm, peaceful, tranquil, and gentle. Range 1.8 to 2.3m tall, long curling necks, dome-shaped heads, two mouths (one on each side of neck, producing stereo speech). Homeworld: Ithor or herd ship. Adventurers love meeting new beings and seeing new places. [Source: CRB p.28-29]

special_qualities.name: Iron Will
special_qualities.description: Ithorians have above-average willpower and gain a +2 species bonus to their Will Defense. [CRB p.28]

special_qualities.name: Bellow
special_qualities.description: As a standard action, an Ithorian can open all four of its throats and emit a terrible subsonic bellow. Attack roll (1d20 + character level) vs. Fortitude Defense of all in a 6-square cone. Hit: 3d6 sonic damage. Miss: half damage. Each use moves Ithorian -1 step on condition track. Can add more d6s to damage, each adds another -1 step on condition track. Add heroic level damage bonus. [CRB p.28-29, cite: 160-161]

special_qualities.name: Survival Instinct
special_qualities.description: An Ithorian may choose to reroll any Survival check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. [CRB p.29, cite: 161-162]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Ithorians like to maintain close ties with nature. An Ithorian with Knowledge (life sciences) as a trained skill gains Skill Focus (Knowledge [life sciences]) as a bonus feat. [CRB p.29]

species_list.name: Jawa
species_list.description_general: Jawas are diminutive, rodent-like humanoids native to the desert planet Tatooine, typically shrouded in heavy robes and hoods to protect them from the twin suns, leaving only their glowing yellow eyes visible. They are known for their obsessive scavenging habits, technical aptitude (especially with droids), and unique Jawa Trade Language. Jawas live in nomadic clans, traversing the deserts in large sandcrawler vehicles. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Darkvision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Desert Dweller
special_qualities.description: When making Survival checks to resist the effects of extreme heat, you can reroll the check and keep the better result.

special_qualities.name: Scavenger
special_qualities.description: Whenever a Jawa armed with an ion weapon successfully damages a droid or vehicle, the Jawa adds half its level in ion damage.

special_qualities.name: Skills (Mechanics)
special_qualities.description: You have Mechanics as a class skill and you can choose to reroll any Mechanics check, but must accept the result of the reroll.

species_list.name: Kaleesh
species_list.description_general: The Kaleesh are a nomadic reptilian humanoid species from the planet Kalee, known for their warrior culture and distinctive masks worn to honor their dead. They possess reddish-brown skin, tusks, and a strong sense of honor and tradition. Kaleesh are skilled hunters and fighters, often driven by a desire for vengeance or glory, a trait famously embodied by General Grievous before his cybernetic transformation. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Survival) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Survival skill.

special_qualities.name: Persistent
special_qualities.description: You can reroll any Endurance check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll).

species_list.name: Kaminoan
species_list.description_general: Kaminoans are tall, slender sentient beings from the aquatic planet Kamino, known for their advanced cloning technology. They possess pale skin, large dark eyes, and long necks, often appearing aloof and detached. Kaminoan society is highly ordered and pragmatic, with a focus on scientific achievement, particularly in genetics. They were responsible for creating the Republic's clone army. [Web Source: Wookieepedia - Note: General description for Kaminoans; specific traits from C source should be prioritized if different.]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Treat Injury) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Treat Injury skill.

special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense.

special_qualities.name: Skills (Aquatic Survival)

species_list.name: Kel Dor
species_list.description_general: Evolved on Dorin (helium & unique gas atmosphere), Kel Dor need antiox breath masks and protective goggles off-world. Masks include vocoders. Calm and kind, believe in quick, simple justice. Skin peach to deep red, black eyes. Average 1.6 to 2m tall. Homeworld: Dorin. Adventurers are often diplomats, bounty hunters, or Jedi. [Source: CRB p.29]

special_qualities.name: Keen Force Sense
special_qualities.description: Kel Dor may choose to reroll any Use the Force check made to search their feelings or sense the Force, keeping the better of the two results. [CRB p.29]

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: Kel Dor ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness. [CRB p.29]

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Special Equipment (Goggles and Mask Requirement)
special_qualities.description: Require protective goggles (without, considered blind) and an antiox breath mask (without, begins to suffocate). Replacement mask 2,000cr (500 on Dorin), year's filters 200cr (50 on Dorin). Start with these at no cost. Antiox mask poisonous to other species. [CRB p.29, cite: 166-167]

effects.starting_equipment_note: Begins play with these items at no cost.
effects.additional_note: Antiox breath mask is poisonous to other species.

species_list.name: Kerkoiden
species_list.description_general: Kerkoiden are a lean, lupine humanoid species known for their cunning and pack-based social structures. They are agile hunters and trackers, often possessing a keen predatory instinct. Kerkoiden society values strength, loyalty, and strategy, and they are often found in military or scouting roles. [Web Source: Based on general Star Wars species information, often found in expanded universe materials and fan compilations like Wookieepedia.]

special_qualities.name: Predator's Heritage
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus on damage rolls against a target that has been damaged since the beginning of your last turn.

special_qualities.name: Social Cunning
special_qualities.description: You may use your WIS bonus in the place of your CHA bonus for determining your skill bonus on Deception and Persuasion.

species_list.name: Khil
species_list.description_general: The Khil are a humanoid species from the planet Belnar, distinguished by their drooping jowls and wrinkled skin, giving them a mournful appearance. They possess a unique biological trait allowing them to derive sustenance from ambient microorganisms. Khil society is known for its cooperative spirit and emphasis on community, making them dependable workers and allies. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Cooperative Spirit
special_qualities.description: As a swift action you can aid adjacent allies or vice-versa on skill checks with the following skills: Climb, Endurance, Gather Information, Jump, Knowledge, Mechanics, Pilot, Ride, Survival, Swim, Treat Injury or Use Computer

effects.effect_description: Aid adjacent allies (or be aided by them) on checks with specified skills.

special_qualities.name: Dependable Worker
special_qualities.description: Once per encounter, a Khil can treat one skill check with certain skills [detailed below) as though he or she had taken 10, even after the roll has been made (but before the result of the check is known). The Khil may only use this ability on checks with one of the following skills: Climb, Endurance, Gather Information, Jump, Knowledge [any), Mechanics, Pilot, Ride, Survival, Swim, Treat Injury, or Use Computer.

effects.effect_description: Treat one skill check (from specified list) as if Take 10 was used, even after roll is made but before result is known.

special_qualities.name: Hullepi
special_qualities.description: You do not suffer the effects of starvation, except in a sterile environment

species_list.name: Killik
species_list.description_general: Killiks are an intelligent insectoid species native to Alderaan, later migrating to the Unknown Regions. They exist as a collective hive mind, with individual identity being secondary to the Nest. Killiks are known for their ability to absorb other species into their hive as 'Joiners' through pheromonal and telepathic means. They possess natural armor, claws, and a complex social structure. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Hive Mind
special_qualities.description: When you are within 1 kilometre of another Killik you can communicate via telepathy

special_qualities.name: Joiners
special_qualities.description: Whenever a Killik reduces a living creature with an Intelligence of 3 or higher to 0 hit points, or the Killik knocks the creature unconscious by moving it down the condition track, the Killik can transform the target into a Joiner. The target must be helpless for this to occur. The process takes 1 minute and exposes the target to mind-altering pheromones. Once the target becomes a Joiner, its attitude shifts to friendly to the Killik and its allies, and the target gains a +10 bonus to Will Defense against attempts to use Persuasion to alter its perceptions of its new Killik friends. A target transformed into a Joiner in this manner can make a DC 20 Intelligence check once per day to remove the effect and return to its original attitude. This is a mind-affecting effect.

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Multiple Limbs
special_qualities.description: When making multiple attacks, reduce the penalty to your attack rolls by 2

special_qualities.name: Natural Armor
special_qualities.description: You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to your Reflex Defense

special_qualities.name: Natural Weapons (Claws)

species_list.name: Kissai

They possess a strong hierarchical society, often serving as advisors and scholars to Sith Lords. Kissai are typically characterized by their sharp features, ceremonial attire, and deep connection to Sith traditions. [Web Source: Wookieepedia, based on Sith Pureblood lore relating to castes.]

species_list.name: Lurmen
species_list.description_general: Lurmen, also known as Mygeetans, are small, lemur-like pacifistic humanoids from Mygeeto. They are characterized by their fur, large eyes, and ability to curl into a ball for rapid rolling movement. Lurmen society emphasizes peace and non-violence, and they are skilled healers and menders. They are generally light and agile. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Roller
special_qualities.description: A Lurmen can curl into a ball and quickly roll along the ground. As a swift action, a Lurmen can increase his or her base speed by 4. In this form, the Lurmen can take only move, withdraw, catch a second wind, drop an item, recover, and run actions. The Lurmen can also spend a swift action to emerge from rolling form, losing the +4 speed bonus and regaining access to all actions he or she can normally take.

species_list.name: Mantellian Savrip
species_list.description_general: Mantellian Savrips are large, powerfully built reptilian predators native to the planet Ord Mantell. They possess formidable natural weaponry, including claws and poisonous attacks, and are covered in tough, natural armor. Savrips are known for their ferocity and can enter a rage-like state in combat. Despite their intimidating appearance, some possess a primitive level of sentience. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Poison (Claws)

If the poison succeeds on an attack roll (1d20 + the Savrip's character level) against the target's Fortitude Defense, the target moves -1 step along the condition track. A target moved to the end of the condition track by the poison is immobilized, but not unconscious.

species_list.name: Massassi
species_list.description_general: The Massassi were an ancient warrior offshoot of the Sith species, known for their brute strength, ferocity in combat, and unwavering loyalty to their Sith masters. They were often used as shock troops and temple guardians. Massassi typically possessed red skin, sharp claws, and a primitive but highly effective warrior culture, deeply immersed in the dark side of the Force. [Web Source: Wookieepedia, based on Sith Pureblood and Massassi lore.]

species_list.name: Miraluka
species_list.description_general: The Miraluka are a Force-sensitive near-Human species whose eyes have atrophied, causing them to 'see' their surroundings through the Force (Force Sight) instead of conventional vision. They typically wear veils or masks over their vestigial eye sockets. Miraluka are known for their deep connection to the Force, often becoming Jedi, and their culture values insight and perception beyond the physical. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Force Training as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Use the Force skill.

special_qualities.name: Force Sight
special_qualities.description: Although blind, Miraluka can "see" by using the Force. They act normally without taking any penalties for blindness when in the presence of living creatures or life of any kind. This trait enables them to make Perception checks, and read and write as a sighted person. They can ignore the effect of darkness as if they had darkvision. Miraluka cannot, however, detect creatures that are "invisible" to the Force such as the Yuuzhan Vong and the ysalamiri. These creatures have total concealment from Miraluka, as do creatures in areas that dampen or suppress the Force. Additionally, the Miraluka ignores all penalties to Perception checks from cover and concealment (but not total cover or total concealment). Miraluka do not increase the DC of Use the Force checks made to Sense Surroundings against targets with total cover.

Does not increase DC of Use the Force (Sense Surroundings) against targets with total cover.

species_list.name: Mon Calamari
species_list.description_general: Amphibious land-dwellers sharing Mon Calamari with Quarren. Soft-spoken but vigorously defend causes. Suffered under Empire, early supporters of Rebel Alliance. Renowned for analytical/organizational abilities and ship design. View creations as art. Creative, quiet, inquisitive dreamers who cherish peace but fight for beliefs. Average 1.8m tall, high-domed heads, large eyes, smooth mottled skin. Homeworld: Mon Calamari. Idealistic and daring adventurers. [Source: CRB p.29-30]

species_list.name: Nagai

They are known for their distinctive angular features, dark hair, and a culture that values discipline, aesthetics, and martial prowess. Nagai society has a history of conflict with the Tof. species_list.name: Nautolan

species_list.name: Neimodian
species_list.description_general: Neimoidians are reptilian humanoids (1.6-2m tall, slight build) with mottled green-gray skin, large red eyes, and flat, noseless faces. They are motivated by control and acquisition of wealth/power. Their culture values bureaucracy and commerce. Known for their association with the Trade Federation. Raised as grubs before maturing. [Source: CRB p.286 (Other Species section)]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Neimoidians with Deception as a trained skill gain Skill Focus (Deception) as a bonus feat. [CRB p.286]

special_qualities.name: Skills (Reroll Deception)
special_qualities.description: A Neimoidian may reroll a Deception check but must keep the second result. [CRB p.286]

species_list.name: Nelvaanian
species_list.description_general: Nelvaanians, also known as Nelvaans, are a primitive canine-like humanoid species from the planet Nelvaan. They are characterized by their blue fur, wolfish snouts, and a tribal warrior culture deeply connected to nature and spiritual traditions. They possess low-light vision and keen senses, making them excellent hunters and trackers. Their society was tragically affected by Separatist experiments during the Clone Wars. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Scent
special_qualities.description: At close range (within 10 squares), you ignore concealment and cover for purposes of Perception checks, and you take no penalty from poor visibility when tracking.

special_qualities.name: Shadow Swiftness
special_qualities.description: If you start your turn with concealment from a target or with the targets unaware of you, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity when moving through the target's threatened space until the end of your turn.

species_list.name: Nikto
species_list.description_general: Niktos are a reptilian humanoid species from Kintan, known for their rugged appearance, natural armor, and cultural ties to the Hutts, often serving them as enforcers. There are several subspecies (Red, Green, Mountain, Pale, Southern Niktos), each with distinct physical traits adapted to different environments on their harsh homeworld. They are generally seen as tough and resilient. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Great Fortitude
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 species bonus to your Fortitude Defense.

special_qualities.name: Natural Armor
special_qualities.description: You gain a +2 natural armor bonus to your Reflex Defense.

special_qualities.name: Survival Instinct
special_qualities.description: You may choose to reroll any Survival check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll).

species_list.name: Noghri
species_list.description_general: The Noghri are a diminutive but incredibly skilled and deadly humanoid species from the planet Honoghr. They are renowned as elite assassins and trackers, possessing exceptional senses (particularly smell), natural weaponry (claws and teeth), and a fierce loyalty to those they serve, most notably the Empire and later the New Republic through Leia Organa Solo. Their homeworld was ecologically devastated, leading to a complex relationship with offworlders. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

species_list.name: Nosaurian
species_list.description_general: Nosaurians are reptilian humanoids native to New Plympto, characterized by their horned heads, tough hides, and strong climbing abilities. They are known for their fierce independence and warrior traditions. Nosaurian culture is deeply tied to their clan structures and their history of resisting off-world domination. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Climber's Heritage
special_qualities.description: You have Climb as a class skill

special_qualities.name: Natural Weapons (Horns)
special_qualities.description: When you make an unarmed attack, you may choose to use your horns, dealing 1d6 piercing damage

special_qualities.name: Survival Instinct
special_qualities.description: You may choose to reroll any Survival check, but you must accept the result of the reroll (must take re-roll)

species_list.name: Nyriaanan
species_list.description_general: Nyriaanans are a humanoid species known for their innate survival skills and keen senses, particularly low-light vision. They are generally adaptable and resourceful, often gaining bonus feats or skills that reflect their ability to thrive in diverse environments. Their specific homeworld and broader cultural details are less commonly documented. [Web Source: Based on traits provided in GI p.144 and general Star Wars species archetypes.]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Class Skill (Survival)
special_qualities.description: Survival is always considered a class skill for Nyriaanans.

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat

species_list.name: Pa'lowick
species_list.description_general: Pa'lowick are sentient, amphibious beings from the swampy world of Lowick. They have large, froglike heads with wide mouths, bulbous eyes, and thin bodies supported by spindly legs. Pa'lowick are known for their distinctive vocalizations and often possess a natural affinity for their swampy environments, being expert swimmers and able to hold their breath for extended periods. They are generally considered a primitive species. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Expert Swimmer
special_qualities.description: You can choose to reroll any Swim check, but you must accept the second result, and you can take 10 on Swim checks even when distracted or threatened

special_qualities.name: Hold Breath
special_qualities.description: You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to 25 x your CON score before having to make Endurance checks to hold your breath

species_list.name: Pau'an
species_list.description_general: Pau'ans, also known as Utapauns or Ancients, are gaunt, long-limbed humanoids native to the sinkhole world of Utapau. They have pale, deeply grooved skin, sharp teeth, and typically possess a calm, sophisticated demeanor. Pau'an society is ancient and values tradition, with a hierarchical structure. They are known for their longevity and often serve in administrative or leadership roles. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Authority
special_qualities.description: As a species accustomed to being in authority, Pau’ans add +1 to any insight or morale bonuses they grant to themselves or other characters.

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Persuasion) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Persuasion skill

species_list.name: Phindian
species_list.description_general: Phindians are a humanoid species known for their technical aptitude and logical minds. They often excel in fields requiring engineering, mechanics, or detailed analysis. Their culture tends to value knowledge and problem-solving. [Web Source: Based on common Star Wars species archetypes valuing technology and intellect.]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Feat (Skill Training - Knowledge Technology)
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Training (Knowledge (technology)) as a bonus feat

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Mechanics) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Mechanics skill

species_list.name: Polis Massan
species_list.description_general: Polis Massans are slender, mute humanoids from the asteroid colony of Polis Massa. They are known for their exceptional medical skills, particularly in obstetrics and trauma care, as well as their archaeological expertise. Polis Massans communicate through sign language, technological aids, and a limited form of telepathy. They are generally peaceful and dedicated to preserving life and knowledge. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Treat Injury) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Treat Injury skill

special_qualities.name: Darkvision
special_qualities.description: You ignore concealment (including total concealment) from darkness

effects.details: Ignores concealment (including total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Limited Telepathy
special_qualities.description: In conjunction with their sign language and technological methods of communication, Polis Massans are able to employ a weak form telepathy that allows them to convey simple feelings and thoughts to any willing recipient within ten squares. They can use the Telepathy aspect of the Use the Force skill untrained (even if not Force-sensitive). If the target of the telepathy is within 10 squares, no skill check is requires to initiate the telepathic contact.

effects.details: Convey simple feelings/thoughts to willing recipient. Can use Use the Force (Telepathy) untrained. No check needed for willing target within 10 squares.

special_qualities.name: Mute
special_qualities.description: Polis Massans have no vocal cords, and must rely on a combination of sign language, computers, and telepathy in order to communicate with others. When they learn new languages, they can understand but not speak them.

species_list.name: Quarren
species_list.description_general: From Mon Calamari, dwelling in deep ocean cities. More isolationist than Mon Calamari. Offworld, often involved in shadowy occupations (pirates, smugglers, spies). Blame Empire and Rebels for homeworld's devastation. Practical, conservative, hate change, distrust optimism. Average 1.8m tall, leathery skin, squid-like heads with four tentacles. Homeworld: Mon Calamari. Adventurers often seek to escape dependency, operating as scoundrels or nobles in criminal organizations. [Source: CRB p.30]

special_qualities.name: Breathe Underwater
special_qualities.description: As amphibious creatures, Quarren can't drown in water. [CRB p.30]

effects.details: Cannot drown in water.

special_qualities.name: Expert Swimmer
special_qualities.description: A Quarren may choose to reroll any Swim check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. In addition, a Quarren may choose to take 10 on Swim checks even when distracted or threatened. [CRB p.30]

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: Quarren ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness. [CRB p.30]

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Adept traders and negotiators, Quarren with Persuasion as a trained skill gains Skill Focus (Persuasion) as a bonus feat. [CRB p.30]

species_list.name: Rakata
species_list.description_general: The Rakata, also known as the Builders, are an ancient amphibious humanoid species with a history of galactic conquest powered by Force-based technology. They possess distinctive finned heads and three-fingered hands. After their Infinite Empire collapsed due to a plague that severed their Force connection, their descendants became more primitive, though some retained knowledge of their advanced past. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Ancient Knowledge
special_qualities.description: Rakata retain many of the qualities that led their ancestors to create great technological works in the distant past. Rakata reduce the penalty for not being proficient in a weapon from -5 to -2 and reduce the armor check penalty for armor they are not proficient in by one step (-5 for heavy armor, -2 for medium armor, and no penalty for light armor). All other penalties for not being proficient still apply. Additionally, once per encounter the Rakata can use a trained-only application of the Mechanics, Pilot, Treat injury or Use Computer skill even if untrained in that skill.

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Rakata with Weapon Proficiency (simple weapons) or proficient in an Exotic melee weapon gain the Weapon Focus feat (for simple weapons or a chosen Exotic melee weapon) as a bonus feat.

special_qualities.name: Force Blind
special_qualities.description: Have lost the connection to the Force. Cannot take the Force Sensitivity feat. Can still increase Dark Side Score and are still affected by Force powers, talents, and the Use the Force skill as normal.

effects.notes: Still affected by Force powers/talents and can gain Dark Side Points.

special_qualities.name: Primitive
special_qualities.description: You do not gain Weapon Proficiency (pistols, rifles, or heavy weapons) as starting feats at first level, even if your class normally grants them

effects.notes: Does not gain these as starting feats even if class normally grants them.

special_qualities.name: Rage
special_qualities.description: Once/day you can fly into a rage as a swift action, temporarily gaining +2 rage bonus to melee attack rolls and damage rolls, but unable to use skills requiring concentration and patience; lasts 5 + Constitution rounds, and moves character -1 persistent step along the condition track until 10 minutes of relaxed recuperation have passed

species_list.name: Replica Droid
species_list.description_general: Replica Droids are advanced droids designed to perfectly imitate organic beings, often for infiltration, espionage, or as decoys. They possess sophisticated programming and physical construction to mimic appearance and behavior. Unlike standard droids, they often have modified behavioral inhibitors and may not require standard maintenance routines. [Web Source: Based on general Star Wars lore about advanced infiltration droids.]

special_qualities.name: Bonus Equipment (Droid Systems)
special_qualities.description: Replica droids can be constructed with two of the following droid systems installed: integrated comlink, darkvision, diagnostics package, improved sensor package, internal storage (subject to size limitations), translator unit (DC 15).

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Deception) as a bonus skill if you are trained in the Deception skill

special_qualities.name: Droid Traits (Modified)
special_qualities.description: You act as a fourth-degree droid and have all droid immunities and typical droid traits, but you ignore the maintenance requirement

effects.notes: Possesses standard droid immunities and traits.

special_qualities.name: Variable Size
special_qualities.description: Since replica droids are designed to imitate organic beings, their size depends on the species that they copy. Medium droids have no special bonuses or penalties due to their size. Those of Small size gain a +1 size bonus to their Reflex Defense and a +5 size bonus to Stealth checks but have lifting and carrying limits of three-quarters those of Medium characters.

species_list.name: Rodian
species_list.description_general: From Rodia (Tyrius system), a humid jungle world. Evolved as brutal hunters. Culture centers on 'the hunt,' glorifying violence. Bounty hunting is most honorable profession. Tend to be violent, tenacious, and dedicated. Humanoid, multifaceted eyes, tapered snout, deep green skin. Average 1.6m tall. Homeworld: Rodia. Adventurers leave to improve skills, often as bounty hunters/mercenaries. [Source: CRB p.30-31]

special_qualities.name: Heightened Awareness
special_qualities.description: A Rodian may choose to reroll any Perception check, but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse. [CRB p.31]

special_qualities.name: Low-Light Vision
special_qualities.description: Rodians ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness. [CRB p.31]

effects.details: Ignores concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness.

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: Rodians are taught how to track and survive in the wilderness of Rodia from a very young age. A Rodian with Survival as a trained skill gains Skill Focus (Survival) as a bonus feat. [CRB p.31]

species_list.name: Ryn
species_list.description_general: The Ryn are a nomadic humanoid species known for their musical beaks, prehensile tails, and a strong cultural emphasis on storytelling, music, and dance. They are often perceived as charismatic wanderers and entertainers, with a complex social structure built around family groups and traveling troupes. Ryn possess a natural talent for making connections and gathering information. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Connections
special_qualities.description: Whenever a Ryn character makes a Gather Information check to learn secret information, he can forgo the credit cost. If this check fails, the Ryn can try again, but must spend the credits as normal.

special_qualities.name: Musical Beak
special_qualities.description: Ryn can move air through their beaks to create pleasant tunes and notes. When using its musical beak to imitate sounds or noises to convey deceptive information, a Ryn can reroll Deception checks and take the better resuIt. A Ryn can also throw his voice or project sounds from his musical beak out to a range of 10 squares. As a swift action, a Ryn can use ventriloquism to create a diversion to hide (see the Deception skill description on page 66 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

effects.effect_description: Can throw voice or project sounds from musical beak.
Use ventriloquism to create a diversion to hide (Deception skill).

special_qualities.name: Prehensile Tail
special_qualities.description: Ryn have long tails nearly as strong and flexible as their hands. A Ryn can effectively hold (but not wield) a Small or smaller item with its tail. When holding a Medium or larger item with its tail, the Ryn is encumbered and considered to be carrying a heavy load.

species_list.name: Sakiyan
species_list.description_general: Sakiyans are a near-Human species from Sakiya, known for their predatory grace, keen senses (including darkvision), and a cultural emphasis on hunting and tracking. They possess an innate understanding of tactics and often excel as bounty hunters, scouts, or assassins. Sakiyan society values skill, patience, and precision. [Web Source: Wookieepedia]

special_qualities.name: Conditional Bonus Feat
special_qualities.description: You gain Skill Focus (Perception) as a bonus feat if you are trained in the Perception skill

special_qualities.name: Lightning Reflexes
