talents_list.full_text_description: You tap directly into your anger to increase the effectiveness of your attacks. Once per round as a reaction to an ally taking damage or being moved down the condition track by an enemy, you gain a +1 morale bonus to your next attack roll. If you use this talent again before you make an attack, the bonus increases by 1, up to a maximum of +5.

talents_list.name: Rising Panic
talents_list.description: 1/rnd as reac to ally taking dam or down CT UtF v. Will Def to move target -1 CT if enemy moved to bottom of CT not unconscious but must flee for 1 min until moves up CT
talents_list.full_text_description: You start a rising panic in an enemy who observes your attacks and actions, inhibiting the enemy’s ability to respond. Once per round as a reaction to an enemy damaging one of your allies or moving one of your allies down the condition track, you can make a Use the Force check against the target’s Will Defense. If the check is successful, you move the target -1 step on the condition track. An enemy moved to the bottom of the condition track by this talent does not fall unconscious, but instead must spend its actions fleeing combat for one minute or until it moves up the condition track. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

talents_list.name: Risk for Reward
talents_list.description: 1/turn if you're damaged from Atk of Opp, make a single atk v. a target

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per turn, when an enemy damages you with an attack of opportunity, you can make a single melee or ranged attack against a target in range as a reaction.

talents_list.name: Roll Out
talents_list.description: reroll Pilot to disengage from dogfight, if fail gunners do not take penalties to atk
talents_list.full_text_description: You are an expert at escaping dogfights. When making an opposed check to disengage from a dogfight, you can reroll your Pilot check, taking the better result. If you fail, you remain in the dogfight, but the gunners on your vehicle do not take penalties to their attack rolls (CR page 171).

talents_list.name: Roll With It
talents_list.description: if you take damage for an ally you gain DR = class level until end of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you take damage on behalf of an ally through the use of a talent (including Harm’s Way), you gain damage reduction equal to your class level until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Run Interference
talents_list.description: can negate an attack of an adjacent ally Colossal or smaller with Vehicular Combat

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a reaction, you can use the Vehicular Combat feat to negate an attack against an adjacent vehicle of Colossal size or smaller that is piloted by an ally. If you can use Vehicular Combat more than once per round, each use to negate an attack counts toward your limit of uses per round.

talents_list.name: Ruthless
talents_list.description: 1/encounter if you drop a foe to 0 hp or to bottom of CT take a bonus stan action

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you deal damage to a target with a melee or ranged attack roll that exceeds the target's damage threshold, you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls against that target for the remainder of the encounter.

talents_list.name: Ruthless
talents_list.description: when you deal damage over thresh, +2 dam v. that target rest of encounter

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when you drop a foe to 0 hit points or push an opponent to the bottom of the condition track, you can immediately take a bonus standard action. [[This talent possibly stacks with itself]]

talents_list.name: Ruthless Negotiator
talents_list.benefit_summary: When haggling over bounty price, can reroll Persuasion check and keep better result.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When haggling over the price of a bounty (see the Persuasion skill, page 71), you can reroll your Persuasion check and keep the better result.
talents_list.description: reroll Persuasion to haggle over a price of bounty
talents_list.full_text_description: When haggling over the price of a bounty (see the Persuasion skill, page 71), you can reroll your Persuasion check and keep the better result.

talents_list.name: Sabotage Device
talents_list.description: sabotage object with energy cell/power pack to become a grenade, can be turned back with swif

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can sabotage any object or weapon that is powered by an energy cell or power pack so that it becomes a grenade. The object or weapon is then considered to be a fragmentation grenade in all ways, but it can be turned back into its original form with another swift action.

talents_list.name: Safe Passage
talents_list.description: 1/turn 1 ally in LOS move its speed as a reac, if a target makes an Atk of Opp v. ally you can make Atk of Opp v. target
talents_list.full_text_description: Once per turn, you can spend a move action to allow one ally within line of sight to move up to its speed as a reaction. If a target makes an attack of opportunity against the ally during its movement, you can make an attack of opportunity against that target.

talents_list.name: Safe Zone
talents_list.description: 4x4 sq = safe zone, ally starting in safe zone +2 Fort & Will Def, cannot overlap another safe zone

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a standard action, you can identify a safe zone, within which your allies gain certain advantages. You designate a 4-by-4 square area of the combat area as a safe zone; at least 1 square of the safe zone must be the square that you currently occupy. Each ally who starts his or her turn within the safe zone gains a +2 circumstance bonus to his or her Fortitude Defense and Will Defense until the start of the ally’s next turn. The safe zone lasts until the end of the encounter, and you can have only one safe zone in effect at a time. You can create a new safe zone as a standard action, dismissing the old safe zone and replacing it with the new one, but no square of the old safe zone can overlap with any square of the new safe zone. You cannot create a safe zone in a space that overlaps another pathfinder’s safe zone.

talents_list.name: Savage Reputation
talents_list.description: all opponents in 6 sq -1 Atk

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You have cultivated a savage reputation, and when you are recognized, you instill fear in your enemies. All opponents within 6 squares of you take a -1 penalty on all attacks. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

talents_list.name: Scholarly Knowledge
talents_list.description: reroll Knowledge if you're trained in that Knowledge
talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can reroll a Knowledge check and keep the better of the two results. This can be used with any Knowledge skill you are trained in.

talents_list.name: Science Analyzer
talents_list.description: double Int mod to Knowledge (life sciences) & (physical sciences) checks

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You use your extensive databanks to better analyze scientific data. You can add double your Intelligence modifier to your Knowledge (life sciences) or Knowledge (physical sciences) skill check.

talents_list.name: Scomp Link Slicer
talents_list.description: 1/enc: use Disable or Erase Program v. friendly or helpful, disabling/erasing in 5 min & DC15; if succeed on opposed Use Comp locks other user out auto but they can retry; as a reac keep hostile computer from tracing your location

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Your inherent speed and advanced skill reduce the danger of slicing computer systems. You must be physically linked to the system you are slicing. You can use each of the following actions once per encounter: •Eradicate: You can use Disable or Erase Program on a computer that is friendly or helpful toward you. With this talent, disabling or erasing a program takes 5 minutes and requires a DC 15 Use Computer check (see page 76 of the Saga Edition core rulebook). •Lockout: If you succeed on an opposed Use Computer check when you Issue a Routine Command to counteract another programmer's actions, you automatically lock the other programmer out of the system. He or she must succeed in an opposed Use Computer check against you to regain access to the system (see page 76 of the Saga Edition core rulebook). You resist the attempt as a reaction. •Untraceable: As a reaction, you automatically keep a hostile computer from tracing your location if you fail a Use Computer check (see page 76 of the Saga Edition core rulebook) by 10 or less.

talents_list.name: Scripted Routines
talents_list.description: 1/enc: use a feat or talent for atk as 1 action less; apply Independent Spirit bonus a 2nd time; in combat add 1/2 cl to any skill that requires stan action or less but you must be trained

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Your extensive experience allows you to preset specific routines that give you an advantage in some situations. Once per encounter you can use each of the following actions: •Attack Script: you can use a feat or a talent that modifies your attack roll as one action less (for example, a full-round action becomes a standard action, a standard action becomes a move action, a move action becomes a swift action, a swift action becomes a free action). •Defense Script: You can apply your Independent Spirit bonus a second time during a single encounter. •Skill Script: While in combat, you can apply a bonus equal to one- half of your class level to any single skill that requires a standard action or less to use. You must be trained in the skill.

talents_list.name: Search and Destroy
talents_list.description: all squad members +2 Perception until next turn (squad = you & # = or less than cl + Cha mod, must be on foot, have LOS & be able to communicate)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a move action, you give all squad members a +2 morale bonus to Perception checks until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Second Chance
talents_list.description: if you fail Treat Injury check, patient does not take any additional damage

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: If you fail your Treat Injury check, your patient does not take any additional damage, nor does it die, even if the failed check would normally require it.

talents_list.name: Second Skin
talents_list.benefit_summary: When proficient with armor, armor bonus to Reflex Defense and equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense increase by +1.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When wearing armor with which you are proficient, your armor bonus to your Reflex Defense and equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense increase by +1.
talents_list.description: armor bonus to Ref Def and equip bonus to Fort Def increase by +1
talents_list.full_text_description: When wearing armor with which you are proficient, your armor bonus to your Reflex Defense and equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense increase by +1.

talents_list.name: Second Strike
talents_list.description: 1/enc when you miss move half spd & atk another target w/out Atk of Opp (Combat Reflexes = number of uses = Dex bonus but only once a round)
talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter when you miss a target with a single melee or ranged attack, as a free action you can move up to half your speed and make a second attack of the same type against a different target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If you have the Combat Reflexes feat, you can use this talent a number of times per encounter equal to your Dexterity bonus (minimum 1). You may still only use this talent once per round.

talents_list.name: Security Slicer
talents_list.description: can disable security without a security kit, something goes wrong if you fail by 10 not 5

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You are an expert in electronic security. When you make a Mechanics check to disable a security system, you can do so without the help of a security kit. Additionally, something goes wrong only when you fail the Mechanics check by 10 or more.

talents_list.name: Seducer
talents_list.description: if fail Persuasion to change attitude, reroll with Deception
talents_list.full_text_description: You excel at seduction through deception. If you fail a Persuasion check to change a target’s attitude (see page 71 of the Saga Edition core rulebook), you can immediately reroll the check using your Deception skill in lieu of your Persuasion skill. You must accept the result of the reroll, even if it’s lower (must take re-roll).

talents_list.name: Seek and Destroy
talents_list.description: if make charge against unaware target, target cannot make Perception check to notice you

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: If you make a charge attack against a target that is unaware of you, that target cannot make a Perception check to notice you until after the attack is resolved, even if you move away from cover or concealment.

talents_list.name: Seen It All
talents_list.description: characters using fear effects must roll twice & keep the lower result on any skill or atk rolls

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Any character using a fear effect on you must roll twice, keeping the lower result on any skill checks and attack rolls.

talents_list.name: Seize Object
talents_list.description: 1/encounter seize an object from adjacent target w/+10 to Disarm, must have free hand & can't conceal
talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter as a move action, you can attempt to seize a held, carried, or worn object from an adjacent target by making a Disarm attack, with a +10 bonus on your attack roll. If the attack succeeds, you are now holding the object. You must have a free hand with which to grab the object, and you cannot use this talent in place of the disarm action. You cannot conceal the use of this talent from the target.

talents_list.name: Seize the Moment
talents_list.description: 1/turn when enemy to 0 hp or down CT, 1 ally in LOS to take 2nd Wind as free & add hp = CL
talents_list.full_text_description: Once per round, whenever an ally successfully damages an opponent, you can take a swift action as a reaction.

talents_list.name: Seize the Moment
talents_list.description: 1/round when an ally dam an opponent you can take a swif action as a reac

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per turn as a reaction, when an enemy is reduced to 0 hit points or is moved down the condition track by any means, you allow one ally within your line of sight to take its second wind immediately (as a free action). Furthermore, when your ally takes its second wind, it regains a number of additional hit points equal to your class level.

talents_list.name: Self-Reliant
talents_list.description: 1/enc use 1 talent from Inspiration tree on yourself

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You need not rely on others when the going gets tough. Once per encounter, you can use one talent that you possess from the Inspiration talent tree on yourself, although you are not normally allowed to do so.

talents_list.name: Sense Deception
talents_list.description: Use the Force replaces Will Def against Deception or Persuasion

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever someone makes a Deception or Persuasion skill check against your Will Defense, you can make a Use the Force check, replacing your Will Defense with the result of your Use the Force check if it is higher.

talents_list.name: Sense Primal Force
talents_list.description: can use Sense Surroundings to detect targets 30sq radius, regardless of LOS

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Jedi who spend time in a diverse wilderness learn the nuances of the living Force at work within a wild ecosystem. When within a natural wilderness area, such as a jungle, a forest, a steppe, a swamp, or plains, you tap into the vibrant living Force of the area and can use Sense Surroundings to detect targets out to a 30-square radius, regardless of line of sight. [[(thus perhaps avoiding the +5 DC to targets with total cover)]]

talents_list.name: Sentinel Strike
talents_list.description: when you attack flat-footed opponent with a damage dealing Force power or lightsaber add +d6 dam

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Any time you attack a flat-footed opponent (or one who is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against you) with a damage-dealing Force power or attack with a lightsaber, you deal an extra 1d6 damage with that attack. This talent does not affect Force powers with the [dark side] descriptor. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you select it, your Sentinel Strike damage increases by 1d6 (maximum +5d6).

talents_list.name: Sentinel's Gambit
talents_list.description: 1/encounter enemy with Dark Side score 1+, enemy loses Dex to Def v. your atk until next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a swift action, you can designate an adjacent enemy with a Dark Side Score of 1 or higher as the target of this talent. The designated enemy loses its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against your attacks until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Sentinel's Observation
talents_list.description: if have concealment v. target, can spend FP for +2 atk v. that target

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: If you have concealment against a target, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls against that target.

talents_list.name: Set for Stun
talents_list.description: if stun dam over thresh target -3 CT not -2

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You are particularly adept with stun weapons. If you are using a ranged weapon that deals stun damage (including a lethal weapon set to stun), you can spend two consecutive swift actions in the same round to activate this talent. If the stun damage on your next attack exceeds the target's damage threshold, you move the target -3 steps along the condition track instead of the normal -2. You lose the benefit of this talent if you lose line of sight to your target or if you take any other action before making your attack.

talents_list.name: Severing Strike
talents_list.benefit_summary: When lightsaber damage equals/exceeds target's current HP and damage threshold, can choose to deal half damage, move target -1 step on condition track, and sever a limb.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When you deal damage with a lightsaber that is equal to or greater than both the target's current hit points and the target's damage threshold (that is, when you would deal enough damage to kill your target), you may choose to use this talent. Instead of dealing full damage, you instead deal half damage to your target and move it -1 step on the condition track (see Conditions, page 148). In addition, you sever one of your target's arms at the wrist or elbow joint, or one of the target's legs at the knee or ankle joint (your choice).
talents_list.description: if dam over current hp & threshold, then deal half dam, move down CT and sever
talents_list.full_text_description: When you deal damage with a lightsaber that is egual to or greater than both the target's current hit points and the target's damage threshold (that is, when you would deal enough damage to kill your target), you may choose to use this talent. Instead of dealing full damage, you instead deal half damage to your target and move it -1 step on the condition track (see Conditions, page 148). In addition, you sever one of your target's arms at the wrist or elbow joint, or one of the target's legs at the knee or ankle joint (your choice). Severing part of an arm prevents the target from wielding weapons or using tools in that hand and imposes a -5 penalty on skill checks and ability checks keyed to Strength and Dexterity. Severing part of a leg knocks the target prone, reduces the target's speed by half, reduces its carrying capacity by half, and imposes a -5 penalty on skill checks and ability checks keyed to Strength and Dexterity. Because of the severity of such an injury, losing a part of a limb causes a persistent condition that can only be removed by having surgery successfully performed on you (see Treat Injury skill, page 74). A cybernetic replacement limb (see page 137) negates these reductions and penalties.
talents_list.special_text: Severing part of an arm prevents wielding weapons/tools in that hand and imposes -5 penalty on STR/DEX checks. Severing part of a leg knocks target prone, halves speed and carrying capacity, and imposes -5 penalty on STR/DEX checks. Losing part of a limb causes a persistent condition removable by surgery. Cybernetic replacement negates penalties.

talents_list.name: Seyugi Cyclone
talents_list.description: if wielding no weapons (gloves or gauntlets) can use Whirlwind Attack until start of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: If you are wielding no weapons (other than combat gloves or stun gauntlets), you can use the Whirlwind Attack feat as a standard action by spending a Force Point even if you do not possess the Whirlwind Attack feat. Additionally, this talent satisfies the prerequisites for the Whirlwind Attack feat.

talents_list.name: Shadow Armor
talents_list.description: +1 Force bonus to Ref Def until start of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You use the Force to bend light around yourself, wrapping you in shadows and making it difficult for enemies to tell where you end and the shadows begin. As a swift action, you grant yourself a +1 Force bonus to your Reflex Defense until the start of your next turn. You may select this talent multiple times. Each time you select it, the Force bonus it provides increases by +1 (maximum +4).

talents_list.name: Shadow Striker
talents_list.description: each 1/enc after you Atk: if dam gain total conceal v., or if opp no Dex to Def or if you concealed & you dam target can only take swif next turn, or if you have conceal +2 Atk or +5 with total

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You excel at fighting from the shadows, hitting your opponents when they least expect it. You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action: •Blinding Strike: Make a single melee or ranged attack against an opponent within range. If you damage the target, you gain total concealment against that target until the beginning of your next turn. •Confusing Strike: You can make a single melee or ranged attack against an opponent within range. If this opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense or if you have concealment from this opponent, a successful attack also causes the opponent to be able to take only a swift action on its next turn. •Unexpected Attack: Make a melee or ranged attack within your range against an opponent from whom you have concealment. You gain a +2 bonus on this attack roll if you have concealment or a +5 bonus if you have total concealment.

talents_list.name: Shadow Vision
talents_list.description: gain low-light vision, lasts 5 min or until end of encounter whichever comes first

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you gain low-light vision, allowing you to ignore concealment (but not total concealment) from darkness. This benefit lasts for 5 minutes or until the end of the encounter, whichever comes first.

talents_list.name: Shaped Explosion
talents_list.description: blast in line or cone, length 2x radius, length of cone 3x radius of blast, originates from explosives' sq

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You know how to set charges to direct a blast in a specific direction or manner. You can shape an explosion caused by explosives or mines that you set into a line or a cone instead of a radius. The length of the line is equal to 2 x the radius of the explosive blast, the length of the cone is equal to 3 x the radius of the blast, and either the line or the cone originates from the square where the explosives are placed.

talents_list.name: Share Force Secret
talents_list.description: 1/turn grant use of Force Secret to ally w/in 12 sq & trained in Use the Force

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you take this talent, choose one Force secret that you know. Once per turn as a swift action, you can grant the use of this Force secret to one ally within 12 squares of you who is trained in the Use the Force skill. The target gains the benefit of this secret until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Share Force Technique
talents_list.description: 1/turn grant use of Force Technique to ally w/in 12 sq & trained in Use the Force, not FP Recovery

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you take this talent, choose one Force technique that you know. Once per turn as a swift action, you can grant the use of this Force technique to one ally within 12 squares of you who is trained in the Use the Force skill. The target gains the benefit of this technique until the end of your next turn. You cannot choose the Force Point Recovery technique for this talent.

talents_list.name: Share Talent
talents_list.description: 1/day grant use of Lightsaber Combat or Forms, Duelist until end of enc if w/in 12 sq to allies = 1/2 cl

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Choose a talent that you already possess. The talent must be from the Lightsaber Combat talent tree, the Duelist talent tree, or the Lightsaber Forms talent tree. Once per day as a standard action, you can spend a Force Point to impart the benefits of the chosen talent to one or more allies, effectively granting them the talent (even if they don't meet the prerequisites). An ally must be within 12 squares of you and must be able to see and hear you to gain the talent; once gained, its benefits last until the end of the encounter. You can share the talent with a number of allies equal to one-half your class level, rounded down. Only allies who are trained in the Use the Force skill can gain the benefits of the shared talent. You can take this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must select a different talent to share with this ability. You can share each talent with your allies only once per day.

prerequisites_structured.text_description: at least one talent from the Lightsaber Combat
prerequisites_structured.name: at least one talent from the Lightsaber Combat

talents_list.prerequisites_text: at least one talent from the Lightsaber Combat, Duelist, or Lightsaber Forms talent tree.

talents_list.name: Shared Notoriety
talents_list.benefit_summary: Minions may reroll Persuasion checks to intimidate (must accept reroll).
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When your minions invoke your name, others take note. If you have minions (see the Attract Minion talent, below), they may reroll any Persuasion checks made to intimidate others (see the Persuasion skill, page 71), but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse.
talents_list.description: minions may reroll Persuasion checks to Intimidate
talents_list.full_text_description: When your minions invoke your name, others take note. If you have minions (see the Attract Minion talent, below), they may reroll any Persuasion checks made to intimidate others (see the Persuasion skill, page 71), but the result of the reroll must be accepted even if it is worse.

talents_list.name: Shellshock
talents_list.description: if you damage target with area attack, target is flat-footed v. you until next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you damage a target that is unaware of you with an area attack, that target is considered flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Shelter
talents_list.description: any cover bonus is +2 Ref Def if adjacent to minion

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are adjacent to a minion, you increase any cover bonus to your Reflex Defense by +2.

talents_list.name: Sheltering Stance
talents_list.description: may use Block or Deflect to protect adjacent without sending Force Point

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, you may use the Block or Deflect talents on attacks that target that ally without the need to spend a Force Point.

talents_list.name: Shield Expert
talents_list.description: once per encounter spend swif to regain 10 SR to max on an active personal shield

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You are an expert in using personal shields for maximum effectiveness. Once per encounter, you can spend a swift action to regain 10 points of SR (up to the shield's maximum) on an active personal shield.

talents_list.name: Shield Gauntlet Defense
talents_list.description: 1/turn +2 Ref Def v. 1 ranged atk if have activated shield gauntlet & not flat-footed

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per turn as a reaction, you can gain a +2 deflection bonus to your Reflex Defense against any one ranged attack. To use this talent, you must be wearing an active shield gauntlet, you must be aware of the attack, and you must not be flat-footed.

talents_list.name: Shield Gauntlet Deflect
talents_list.description: 1/rnd negate ranged attack with Use the Force check, DC = Atk roll, must have activated gauntlet, aware and not flat-footed, vs. autofire = 1/2 or no damage spend a Force Point for adjacent

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per round as a reaction, you can negate a ranged attack by making a successful Use the Force check. The DC of the skill check is equal to the result of the attack roll you wish to negate. To use this talent, you must be wearing an active shield gauntlet, you must be aware of the attack, and you must not be flat-footed. You can spend a Force Point to use this talent to negate a ranged attack against an adjacent character. You can use Shield Gauntlet Deflect to deflect some of the barrage of shots fired from a ranged weapon set on autofire. If your Use the Force check succeeds, you take half damage if the attack hits and no damage if the attack misses.

talents_list.name: Shield Gauntlet Redirect
talents_list.description: with successful Deflect make ranged atk w/in 6 sq & LOS, not autofire

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: This talent allows you to redirect a deflected blaster bolt along a specific trajectory so that it damages another creature or object in its path. When you successfully deflect a blaster bolt, you can make an immediate ranged attack against another target within 6 squares of you to which you have line of sight. If the attack succeeds, it deals normal weapon damage to the target. Only single blaster bolts can be redirected in this manner. You cannot use this talent to redirect barrages from autofire weapons and other types of projectiles. To use this talent, you must be wearing an active shield gauntlet, you must be aware of the attack, and you must not be flat-footed.
talents_list.prerequisites_text: Shield Gauntlet Defense, Shield Gauntlet Deflect, BAB +5

talents_list.name: Shien
talents_list.benefit_summary: When redirecting a deflected blaster bolt (Redirect Shot talent), gain +5 bonus on the ranged attack roll.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: Whenever you redirect a deflected blaster bolt (see the Redirect Shot talent, page 41), you gain a +5 bonus on your ranged attack roll.
talents_list.description: +5 on ranged attack on deflected shot
talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you redirect a deflected blaster bolt (see the Redirect Shot talent, page 41), you gain a +5 bonus on your ranged attack roll.

talents_list.name: Shift
talents_list.description: move 1 square without an Atk of Opp
talents_list.full_text_description: As a move action, you can move 1 square without provoking an attack of opportunity.

talents_list.name: Shift Defense I
talents_list.benefit_summary: Swift action: Take -2 penalty to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) to gain +1 competence bonus to another defense until start of next turn.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: As a swift action, you can take a -2 penalty to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) to gain a +1 competence bonus to another defense until the start of your next turn.
talents_list.description: -2 one Def, +1 to another Def
talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can take a -2 penalty to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) to gain a +1 competence bonus to another defense until the start of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Shift Defense II
talents_list.benefit_summary: Swift action: Take -5 penalty to one defense to gain +2 competence bonus to another defense until start of next turn.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: As a swift action, you can take a -5 penalty to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) to gain a +2 competence bonus to another defense until the start of your next turn.
talents_list.description: -5 one Def, +2 to another Def
talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can take a -5 penalty to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) to gain a +2 competence bonus to another defense until the start of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Shift Defense III
talents_list.benefit_summary: Swift action: Gain +5 competence bonus to one defense by taking -5 penalty to other two defenses until start of next turn.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: As a swift action, you can gain a +5 competence bonus to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) by taking a -5 penalty to your other two defenses. The changes to your defenses last until the start of your next turn.
talents_list.description: -5 two Defs, +5 to other Def
talents_list.full_text_description: As a swift action, you can gain a +5 competence bonus to one defense (Reflex, Fortitude, or Will) by taking a -5 penalty to your other two defenses.
talents_list.prerequisites_text: Shift Defense I, Shift Defense II

talents_list.name: Shift Sense
talents_list.description: gain low-light vision for 1 minute or the encounter whichever is longer

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can spend a Force Point to gain low-light vision for 1 minute or until the end of the encounter, whichever is longer.

talents_list.name: Shii-Cho
talents_list.benefit_summary: When using Block or Deflect talents, take only -2 penalty on Use the Force check for every previous Block/Deflect attempt since last turn (instead of -5). (Errata applied)
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When using the Block or Deflect talents, you only take a -5 penalty on your Use the Force check for every previous block or deflect attempt since your last turn (see page 41).
talents_list.description: take only -2 penalty on your Use the Force check for each block or deflect in last turn
talents_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.299: Changes penalty from -5 to -2.
talents_list.full_text_description: When using the Block or Deflect talents, you only take a -2 penalty on your Use the Force check for every previous block or deflect attempt since your last turn (see page 41).

talents_list.name: Shoot from the Hip
talents_list.description: can always use rifles to make attacks of opportunity

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can always use a rifle to make attacks of opportunity.

talents_list.name: Shoto Focus
talents_list.description: +2 atk with shoto or guard shoto if you wield a one-handed lightsaber

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you wield both a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto (or guard shoto), you gain a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls made with the shoto.

talents_list.name: Shoto Master
talents_list.description: one-handed lightsaber considered light with shoto, can activate Lightsaber Defense as free with shoto
talents_list.full_text_description: When you wield both a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto (or guard shoto), you can consider the one-handed lightsaber to be a light weapon. Additionally, if you have the Lightsaber Defense talent, you can activate the talent as a free action on your turn (instead of a swift action) whenever you wield both a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto (or guard shoto).

talents_list.name: Shoto Pin
talents_list.description: when you Block w/shoto the attacker can make no melee atk until its next turn or you're not adjacent

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you are wielding a shoto and successfully use the Block talent to negate a melee attack, the attacker can make no further melee attacks until the start of its next turn or until you are no longer adjacent to it.

talents_list.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
talents_list.description: if begin turn adjacent to ally, gain hp = HL

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you begin your turn adjacent to an ally, you gain a number of bonus hit points equal to your heroic level. Damage is subtracted from the bonus hit points first, and any bonus hit points remaining at the end of the encounter go away. Bonus hit points from various sources do not stack.

talents_list.name: Shunt Damage
talents_list.description: 1/enc when your ship takes damage, Pilot vs adjacent ally ship Ref Def to shift damage to ally

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, if your ship takes damage, make a Pilot check and compare the result to the Reflex Defense of one adjacent allied ship. If your check result is higher, the allied ship takes the damage instead.

talents_list.name: Siang Lance Mastery
talents_list.description: treat siang lance as rifle, +1 atk & counts as Weapon Focus (rifles)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You treat a siang lance as a rifle instead of as an exotic weapon. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with a siang lance. This talent counts as the Weapon Focus (siang lance) feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites. If you also have the Weapon Focus (rifles) feat, the attack bonus provided by this talent does not stack with the attack bonus provided by Weapon Focus (rifles).

talents_list.name: Sickening Blast
talents_list.description: if Use the Force of Force blast exceeds Fort Def, target moves -1 CT, you get Dark Side point
talents_list.full_text_description: When you use the Force blast power, if your Use the Force check exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, you can choose to move the target -1 step along the condition track. Doing so increases your Dark Side Score by 1.

talents_list.name: Sidestep
talents_list.description: reduce cost of diagonal move to 1 if in light or no armor
talents_list.full_text_description: You can use a swift action to reduce the cost of each move into a diagonal space to 1 until the end of your turn if you are wearing light armor or no armor. You cannot use this talent if you are wearing medium or heavy armor.

talents_list.name: Signature Item
talents_list.description: with certain item +2 opposed skill checks, multiple items cumulative +1

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You are famous for using certain items, and you have become skilled at wielding them. You select a single weapon, suit of armor, vehicle, starship, or other item. While wielding that weapon, wearing that armor, piloting that vehicle, or otherwise using that item, you gain a +2 morale bonus on opposed skill checks. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you choose a new object to be your signature item. The effects of multiple signature items are cumulative with one another, increasing this morale bonus by 1 each time.

talents_list.name: Silent Movement
talents_list.description: never suffer from unfavorable circumstances from environment w/Stealth, 1/rnd w/Stealth auto aid another 1 ally

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You know how to move silently in almost any environment. You never suffer from unfavorable circumstances from environmental effects associated with noise when you sneak using the Stealth skill. Once per round, when you make a Stealth check, you can automatically use the aid another action on one ally’s Stealth check. [[This aid another seems to cost no actions or a free action rather than the normal standard action]]

talents_list.name: Silent Takedown
talents_list.description: if unaware target damaged, opp cannot speak or make other noises until end of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You are skilled at quietly knocking out or eliminating guards and others when they are caught unaware. If you damage an opponent that is unaware of you, that opponent cannot speak or make other noises until the end of your next turn. This is a stunning effect.

talents_list.name: Silicon Mind
talents_list.description: gain bonus to Will Def = Cha mod (min 1) against Use the Force until end of your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Other Force-users have a difficult time knowing how to influence you. You can spend a Force Point as a reaction to gain a bonus to your Will Defense equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) against all Use the Force checks until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Simple Opportunity
talents_list.description: can make Atk of Opp when using ranged or thrown simple weapon (no area atk weapons)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can make attacks of opportunity when using a ranged or thrown simple weapon against a single target. Area attack weapons cannot be used with this talent.

talents_list.name: Simultaneous Strike
talents_list.description: make two unarmed attacks each against different targets

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a standard action, you can make two unarmed attacks, each against different targets.

talents_list.name: Single Weapon Flourish I
talents_list.description: with 1 light melee or lightsaber you can move your speed as a free action
talents_list.full_text_description: When you wield only a single light melee weapon or a single lightsaber and make a full attack, you can move up to your speed as a free action at any time during your turn.

talents_list.name: Single Weapon Flourish II
talents_list.description: with 1 light melee or lightsaber make full atk as stan, 1 per turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you wield only a single light melee weapon or a single lightsaber, once per turn on your turn, you can make a full attack as a standard action instead of a full-round action.
talents_list.prerequisites_text: Double Attack, Master of Elegance, Single Weapon Flourish I, Weapon Finesse

talents_list.name: Sith Alchemy
talents_list.description:
Create Sith Talisman = +d6 dam with Force powers or lightsaber, gain Dark Side point with first use
Create Sith Weapon - imbue weapon with Sith alchemical weapon template (K79)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Your knowledge of Sith sorcery allows you to imbue talismans and other objects with the power of the dark side. •Create Sith Talisman: You can spend one Force Point to imbue a portable object with the dark side, creating a Sith talisman that provides offensive strength to a Force power or lightsaber attack. Creating the talisman takes a full-round action. While you wear or carry the talisman on your person, add 1d6 to your damage with Force powers. You gain a Dark Side point when you first put on or carry a Sith talisman. You can have only one Sith talisman active at any given time, and if it is destroyed, you cannot create another one for 24 hours. •Create Sith Weapon: You can alchemically treat a properly prepared weapon to become a Sith weapon. You may spend a Force Point to imbue the weapon with the properties of the Sith alchemical weapon template (this process takes one hour to complete). See KOTOR Chapter 5 Equipment and Droids for information on Sith alchemical weapons.

talents_list.name: Sith Alchemy
talents_list.description: Create Sith Amulet, Sith Armor, Sith Talisman, or Sith Weapon, see J21-22

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Your knowledge of Sith alchemy allows you to imbue certain objects with the power of the dark side. You can perform any of the following alchemical transformations, though each time you do so, increase your Dark Side Score by 1.

talents_list.name: Sith Alchemy Specialist
talents_list.description: modify an item to gain Sith Alchemy traits, see J22

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can modify an object with Sith alchemy so that it gains a specific trait. Specific traits are listed on Table 1-1. You can only perform one modification at a time. Unless otherwise noted, you cannot grant more than one benefit to a single object, and you cannot apply the same benefit more than once. You must spend a Force Point and devote 1 hour of uninterrupted work to apply a trait to the relevant object, and when you do so, you increase your Dark Side Score by 1.

talents_list.name: Sith Reverence
talents_list.description: +1 atk while within 20 sq & LOS of an ally with Dark Side score equal or greater than yours

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You gain a +1 morale bonus on your attack rolls while you are within 20 squares and in line of sight of an ally with a Dark Side Score equal to or greater than your own.

talents_list.name: Six Questions
talents_list.description: Knowledge (galactic lore) DC15+CL for target's level, classes, abilities & Force & Destiny points

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You have mastered the basic Bothan philosophy of Six Questions to glean more information from contacts through fewer questions. As a swift action, you can make a Knowledge (galactic lore) check against a DC equal to 15 + the target's CL. If the check is successful, you learn a target character's level, classes, and ability scores, and the target's available Force Points and Destiny Points.

talents_list.name: Sizing Up
talents_list.description: 1/enc Perception vs Will of target within 6 sq & LOS for +2 bonus to skill & attacks for enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can make a Perception check against the Will Defense of a single target that is within 6 squares of you and within your line of sight. If you succeed, you gain a +2 insight bonus to all skill checks and attack rolls against the target until the end of the encounter.

talents_list.name: Skill Boon
talents_list.description: increase FP dice to next higher on 1 skill (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you select this talent, choose one skill. Whenever you spend a Force Point to add to that skill, increase the die type of your Force Point by one step (i.e. from d6 to d8, d8 to dl0, or d10 to d12), to a maximum of d12. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different skill to gain the benefits of this talent.

talents_list.name: Skill Confidence
talents_list.description: nat 19 or 20 gain benefit of Critical Skill Success and bonus hp = Cha mod

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you select this talent, choose one skill. Whenever you roll a natural 19 or a natural 20 on a skill check with that skill, you gain the benefits of the Critical Skill Success talent and also gain bonus hit points equal to your Charisma modifier. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different skill to gain the benefits of this talent.

talents_list.name: Skill Conversion
talents_list.description: with reprogram, sacrifice one trained skill for +1 skill focus, once per reprogram

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you reprogram yourself, you can sacrifice a single trained skill for a bonus Skill Focus feat. You must meet the prerequisites for the feat (you must be trained in the skill you choose to gain Skill Focus for), and you can do this only once per reprogramming.

talents_list.name: Skilled Advisor
talents_list.benefit_summary: Full-round action, grant ally +5 bonus on next skill check. If spend Force Point, bonus increases to +10. Target must hear/understand. Cannot advise self. Mind-affecting.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: You can spend a full-round action advising an ally, thereby granting her a +5 bonus on her next skill check. If you spend a Force Point, the bonus increases to +10. The target must be able (and willing) to hear and understand your advice. You cannot advise yourself. This is a mind-affecting effect.
talents_list.description: ally gets +5 on skill check, Force Point = +10
talents_list.full_text_description: You can spend a full-round action advising an ally, thereby granting her a +5 bonus on her next skill check. If you spend a Force Point, the bonus increases to +10. The target must be able (and willing) to hear and understand your advice. You cannot advise yourself. This is a mind-affecting effect.

talents_list.name: Skilled Demolitionist
talents_list.description: set detonator as swif & does not go off if fail roll by 10 or more

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can set a detonator as a swift action, and your explosives never go off as the detonator is being placed, even if you fail the check by 10 or more. You must still roll to determine if the charge otherwise goes off as planned (see "Mechanics," page 69 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).

talents_list.name: Skilled Implanter
talents_list.description: when installing an implant the attack bonus is halved

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you use the Biotech Surgery feat to install an implant, the implant’s attack bonus against the recipient’s Fortitude Defense is halved (see page 67 for more information on implants).

talents_list.name: Skillful Recovery
talents_list.description: When failing to get min result of check of 1 skill, gain FP only usable on that skill before end of enc

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you select this talent, choose one skill. Whenever you fail a skill check with that skill, you gain one temporary Force Point. That Force Point can only be spent to add to a skill check with the skill you chose for this talent. If the Force Point is not spent by the end of the encounter, it is lost. For the purposes of this talent, failing a skill check means failing to get the minimum possible result from the skill check. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different skill to gain the benefits of this talent.

talents_list.name: Skirmisher
talents_list.benefit_summary: If you move at least 2 squares before attack and end in different square, gain +1 attack bonus until start of next turn.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: If you move at least 2 squares before you attack and end your move in a different square from where you started, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
talents_list.description: if move 2 squares, +1 Atk until next turn
talents_list.errata_applied: Unleashed text from Errata p.290 for this talent not part of base CRB talent but noted as potential.
talents_list.full_text_description: If you move at least 2 squares before you attack and end your move in a different square from where you started, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. (SotG) You gain the benefits of this talent with vehicle weapons only if you are the vehicle's pilot. Unleashed: When you gain the benefit of the Skirmisher talent on a melee or ranged attack, you can spend a Destiny Point to get an automatic critical hit on your attack and gain a bonus to your base damage equal to the number of squares you moved.

talents_list.name: Slashing Charge
talents_list.description: 1/enc with charge take no penalty on UtF for Block during the charge, applies to Riposte

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, while making a charge, you take no cumulative penalty to Use the Force checks for each Block attempt you make during the charge. When performing slashing charge, you can apply the attack bonus granted by the charge to all Riposte attacks as well. You can declare the use of this ability after you begin the charge but before you make your first Riposte attack.

talents_list.name: Slip By
talents_list.description: when you dam opponent you can move through that opponent's square, Atk of Opp as normal
talents_list.full_text_description: When you would normally provoke an attack of opportunity by moving out of a threatened space, you can roll a Stealth check, replacing your Reflex Defense with the results of your Stealth check if it is higher.

talents_list.name: Slip By
talents_list.description: if you'd provoke an Atk of Opp by moving, can make Stealth check to replace Ref Def if higher

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you damage a target, until the beginning of your next turn, you can move through that target's space. Moving through the target's space might still provoke attacks of opportunity as normal, and you must end your movement in a legal space.

talents_list.name: Slippery Strike
talents_list.description: once per encounter designate an opp you just damaged cannot make attacks of opp until next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, you can designate an opponent you have just damaged as a reaction; that opponent cannot make attacks of opportunity against you until the end of your next turn. You may use this in conjunction with the Strike and Run talent, allowing you to benefit from both talents as a single reaction.

talents_list.name: Slowing Shot
talents_list.description: target's spd -2 until move to normal on CT or until end of enc & loses Dex to Def & flat-footed, spend FP for -4sq or half whichever is greater
talents_list.full_text_description: If you successfully use Debilitating Shot, until the target moves to the normal state on the condition track or until the end of the encounter, the target’s speed is reduced by 2 squares, and it loses its Dexterity bonus to its Reflex Defense and is considered flat-footed. These effects occur in addition to the effect of Debilitating Shot. If you spend a Force Point, the target’s speed is reduced by 4 squares or half of its normal speed, whichever is the greater reduction.

talents_list.name: Slowing Stun
talents_list.description: when you move target -1 CT their speed halved until removed
talents_list.full_text_description: When you move a target at least -1 step along the condition track with an attack, its speed is halved until all conditions are removed.

talents_list.name: Sly Combatant
talents_list.description: each 1/enc make ranged or melee atk for 1. if hits enemy -2 atk & dam until end of enc or 2. if deal dam enemy gains persistent condition removed with DC25 Treat Injury/surgery or 3. atk v. adjacent to you or ally +2 dam per adjacent ally
talents_list.full_text_description: You quickly move about the battlefield, taking advantage of the chaos of battle to gain advantage. You can use each of the following actions once per encounter as a standard action: • Distracting Injury: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any enemy within your range. If the attack successfully hits, that enemy takes a -2 penalty to his or her attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of the encounter. • Make Them Bleed: Make a single melee or ranged attack against any living creature within your range. If you successfully deal damage as a result of the attack, that enemy gains a persistent condition that can be removed only with a successful DC 25 Treat Injury check to perform surgery. • Strength in Numbers: Make a single melee or ranged attack against an enemy who is adjacent to one or more of your allies. If you successfully hit that enemy, you gain a +2 bonus to damage for each ally that is adjacent to the target.

talents_list.name: Small Favor
talents_list.description: 1/day DC25 Persuasion for informant info for +10 1 Gather Info or Knowledge w/in next 24 hours

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can call in a small favor from someone who owes you. Once per day, make a DC 25 Persuasion check. If the check is successful, an informant gives you information, granting you a +10 competence bonus to one Gather Information or Knowledge check made within the next 24 hours.

talents_list.name: Small Target
talents_list.description: if you pilot a colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ships with -20 Atk  = no crits unless you'd be hit normally (20 + weapon's atk bonus)

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you are the pilot of a Colossal or smaller vehicle, capital ship weapons that take a -20 penalty on attack rolls against your vehicle (such as turbolasers) do not automatically score a critical hit on your vehicle on a natural 20. The attack is only a critical hit of the total attack roll (20 + the weapon's attack bonus) would normally hit your vehicle. Otherwise, the attack deals normal damage.

talents_list.name: Snap Shot
talents_list.description: do not provoke attacks of opportunity when using aim with stock extended

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity while using the aim action with a rifle or carbine with its stock extended.

talents_list.name: Sneak Attack
talents_list.benefit_summary: Deal +1d6 damage on melee/ranged attack vs opponent denied DEX to Reflex Defense (ranged within 6 sq). Max +10d6. Can select multiple times. (Errata applied)
talents_list.benefit_text_long: Any time your opponent is flat-footed or otherwise denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with a successful melee or ranged attack. You must be within 6 squares of the target to make a sneak attack with a ranged weapon.
talents_list.description: if opp flat-footed or no Dex to Def, deal +d6 dam, must be w/in 6 squares, max 10d6
talents_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.290 Unleashed text not part of base talent, but notes maximum of +10d6.
talents_list.full_text_description: Any time your opponent is flat-footed or otherwise denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with a successful melee or ranged attack. You must be within 6 squares of the target to make a sneak attack with a ranged weapon. You may select this talent multiple times. Each time you select it, your sneak attack damage increases by + 1d6 (maximum +10d6). [[Weak talent option: the first time you take this talent, you deal 2d6 instead of 1d6 dmg, or increase to 1d8.]] Unleashed: When you make an attack that deals extra damage thanks to the Sneak Attack talent, you can spend a Destiny Point to gain a +5 bonus on your melee or ranged attack roll and deal an extra 5d6 points of damage with a successful hit. You must be within 6 squares of the target to make a sneak attack with a ranged weapon. This extra damage stacks with any damage bonus provided by the Sneak Attack talent.
talents_list.special_text: You may select this talent multiple times. Each time you select it, your sneak attack damage increases by +1d6 (maximum +10d6).

talents_list.name: Sniping Assassin
talents_list.description: ranged attack not at point blank range add half class level to damage

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you add half your class level to your damage roll.

talents_list.name: Sniping Marksman
talents_list.description: 1/encounter ranged attack not at point blank range ignore target's armor bonus to Ref Def

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when you make a ranged attack against a target that is not at point blank range, you can ignore your target's armor bonus to Reflex Defense.

talents_list.name: Sniping Master
talents_list.description: aim with 1 swif at a target not in point blank range

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: By taking only a single swift action, you can aim at a target that is not within point blank range. [[If you are using a bipod, you can aim as a free action if you have already aimed at or attacked a particular target. Then, each subsequent aim action is a free action against that target only]]

talents_list.name: Soft Reset
talents_list.description: after 2 rounds of being disabled move +1 CT
talents_list.full_text_description: You are adept at rerouting your internal electronics. If you are moved to the bottom of the condition track by any means other than taking damage exceeding your damage threshold, you automatically move +1 step along the condition track after being disabled for 2 rounds.

talents_list.name: Soft to Solid
talents_list.description: when damaged gain DR 10 until end of your next turn
talents_list.full_text_description: As a reaction when you are damaged by an attack, you can spend a Force Point to increase the rigidity of your skin, gaining DR 10 until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Soften the Target
talents_list.description: when you damage target with ranged atk, 1 ally in LOS ignores target's DR & SR

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you damage a target with a ranged attack, you may designate one ally within your line of sight as a swift action. The ally you designate ignores the target's damage reduction and SR (if any) until the start of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Sokan
talents_list.benefit_summary: May take 10 on Acrobatics checks to tumble even when distracted/threatened. Each threatened/occupied square tumbled through counts as 1 square of movement (not 2).
talents_list.benefit_text_long: You may take 10 on Acrobatics checks to tumble even when distracted or threatened. Additionally, each threatened or occupied square that you tumble through only counts as 1 square of movement.
talents_list.description: take 10 on Acrobatics check to tumble even when distracted, each occupied square counts as 1
talents_list.full_text_description: You may take 10 on Acrobatics checks to tumble even when distracted or threatened. Additionally, each threatened or occupied square that you tumble through only counts as 1 square of movement.

talents_list.name: Soothe
talents_list.description: use vital transfer to move target +1 CT not heal, you move -1 CT
talents_list.full_text_description: When using vital transfer to heal somebody, you can move the target +1 step on the condition track instead of healing damage. When doing so. you move -1 step on the condition track in exchange.

talents_list.name: Soothing Presence
talents_list.description: shift unfriendly beast to indifferent automatically

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you encounter a beast with an unfriendly attitude toward you, you automatically shift its attitude to indifferent (no skill check required).

talents_list.name: Soresu
talents_list.benefit_summary: May reroll a failed Use the Force check when using Block or Deflect talents, without spending a Force Point. (Errata applied)
talents_list.benefit_text_long: You may reroll a failed Use the Force check when using the Block or Deflect talents.
talents_list.description: reroll Use the Force for Block or Deflect
talents_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.299: Clarifies the reroll is made 'without spending a Force Point.'
talents_list.full_text_description: You may reroll a failed Use the Force check when using the Block or Deflect talents.

talents_list.name: Sow Confusion
talents_list.description: 1/encounter Deception v. Will Def in LOS target must spend swif w/ stan to attack until your next turn

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, as a standard action, you can make a Deception check and compare the result to the Will Defense of all enemies in your line of sight. If the check result equals or exceeds an enemy's Will Defense, that enemy must spend a swift action in addition to a standard action to make an attack until the start of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Spacehound
talents_list.benefit_summary: Take no penalty on attack rolls in low/zero-G. Ignore space sickness. Proficient with all starship weapons. (Errata applied)
talents_list.benefit_text_long: You take no penalty on attack rolls in low-gravity or zero-gravity environments, and you ignore the debilitating effects of space sickness (see Zero-Gravity Environments, page 257). In addition, you are considered proficient with any starship weapon.
talents_list.description: no Atk penalty in low or zero-gravity, ignore space sickness, proficient w/starship weapons
talents_list.errata_applied: CRB Errata p.290: Proficiency is with 'all' starship weapons.
talents_list.full_text_description: You take no penalty on attack rolls in low-gravity or zero-gravity environments, and you ignore the debilitating effects of space sickness (see Zero-Gravity Environments, CR page 257). In addition, you are considered proficient with any starship weapon [[all of which are heavy weapons]].

talents_list.name: Spatial Integrity
talents_list.description: Use the Force negates damage to vehicle you are aboard, occurs after DR & SR applied

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: While you are aboard a vehicle, you can spend a Force Point as a reaction to the vehicle taking damage; you make a Use the Force check and reduce the damage the vehicle takes by the check result. This reduction occurs after both DR and SR are applied to the damage.

talents_list.name: Speed Implant
talents_list.description:
1/encounter adjacent ally gains +2 spd
at end of encounter target moves -3 CT & needs rest or surgery
talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter as a standard action, you can give one adjacent living creature a speed implant. The target must be willing to receive this implant, which increases the target’s base speed by 2 until the end of the encounter.

talents_list.name: Speedclimber
talents_list.description: no penalty when using Accelerated Climbing of Climb

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You do not take the penalty when using the Accelerated Climbing application of the Climb skill.
talents_list.prerequisites_text: Long Stride, Surefooted, Trained in Climb

talents_list.name: Spontaneous Skill
talents_list.benefit_summary: Once per day, make an untrained skill check as though trained (except Use the Force unless Force Sensitive). Can select multiple times.
talents_list.benefit_text_long: Sometimes you surprise others with your skill. Once per day, you may make an untrained skill check as though you were trained in the skill.
talents_list.description: once a day, make skill check trained, multiple per day
talents_list.full_text_description: Sometimes you surprise others with your skill. Once per day, you may make an untrained skill check as though you were trained in the skill. Exception: You cannot use this talent to make an untrained Use the Force check as though you were trained in the skill unless you have the Force Sensitivity feat (page 85). You can select this talent multiple times; each time you do, you can use it one additional time per day.
talents_list.special_text: Exception: You cannot use this talent to make an untrained Use the Force check as though you were trained in the skill unless you have the Force Sensitivity feat (page 85). You can select this talent multiple times; each time you do, you can use it one additional time per day.

talents_list.name: Spotter
talents_list.description: Perception v. DC 10+CL of target in LOS to gain for you and allies +1 Atk v. target

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: As a move action, you can make a Perception check with a DC equal to 10 + the CL of a single target enemy in your line of sight. If you succeed on the check, you and all your allies that can hear and understand you gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls against that target until the end of your next turn.

talents_list.name: Spring the Trap
talents_list.description: if you & all allies roll higher Initiative than opponents, gain a surprise round even if aware

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: If you and all your allies roll higher Initiative checks to start combat than do all your opponents, you automatically gain a surprise round, even if the opponents are aware of you when combat begins.

talents_list.name: Sprint
talents_list.benefit_summary: When using run action, can move up to 5x speed (instead of 4x).
talents_list.benefit_text_long: When you use the run action, you can move up to five times your speed (instead of the normal four times your speed).
talents_list.description: run up to five time speed
talents_list.full_text_description: When you use the run action, you can move up to five times your speed (instead of the normal four times your speed).

talents_list.name: Spynet Agent
talents_list.description: Gather Info replaces Knowledge (galactic lore), considered trained

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You can use your Gather Information check modifier instead of your Knowledge (galactic lore) check modifier when making Knowledge (galactic lore) checks. You are considered trained in the Knowledge (galactic lore) skill for the purpose of using this talent. If you are entitled to a Knowledge (galactic lore) reroll, you can reroll your Gather Information check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations).

talents_list.name: Squad Actions
talents_list.description: if you atk: extend autofire by 1 sq, +2 dam, or + atk per follower if armed with ranged weapon

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: You and your squad have an established set of tactics, practiced to perfection. You can use any of the following actions on your turn. •Autofire Barrage: Make a single autofire attack as a standard action against legal target spaces. For each follower armed with a ranged weapon set to autofire that has line of sight to the targeted area, you can designate one additional adjacent square as being targeted by your autofire attack. •Open Fire: Make a single attack as a standard action against a target within reach. For each follower armed with a ranged weapon that has line of sight to that target, add +2 to your damage roll on a successful hit. •Painted Target: Make a single attack as a standard action against a target within reach. You gain a competence bonus on your attack roll equal to the number of followers armed with ranged weapons that have line of sight to that target.

talents_list.name: Squad Brutality
talents_list.description: with melee atk against target with your allies adjacent reroll damage & keep best
talents_list.full_text_description: When you succeed on a melee attack against a target that has one or more of your allies adjacent to it, you may reroll your damage roll, taking the better result.

talents_list.name: Squad Superiority
talents_list.description: with you & two allies adjacent to target, target is flat-footed

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Whenever you and at least two allies are adjacent to the same target, that target is considered flat-footed against you.

talents_list.name: Squadron Maneuvers
talents_list.description: once per encounter, grant benefits of a talent to every ship in your squadron until end of enc.

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Choose one talent that you already possess. The talent you select must be from the Expert Pilot or Gunner talent trees. Once per encounter as a standard action, you can impart the benefits of the chosen talent to all members of your squadron. Once gained, its benefits last until the end of the encounter.

talents_list.name: Squadron Tactics
talents_list.description: once per encounter, grant a maneuver you use to every ship in your squadron next round

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: Once per encounter, when you use a starship maneuver, you grant all ships in your squadron the ability to use the same maneuver once on their next turn. The pilot of each ship that chooses to use the maneuver must make any Pilot checks or attack rolls the maneuver requires—your success or failure with the maneuver has no bearing on the success of other units of your squadron. The ace pilot’s Squadron Tactics talent can be used only to confer non-attack pattern maneuvers on your squadron.

talents_list.name: Stalwart Subordinates
talents_list.description: an ally w/in 12 sq & LOS & Will Def targeted forces enemy to reroll & take lowest

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When any ally within 12 squares of you and in your line of sight is targeted by a skill check against its Will Defense, the source of that skill check (whether a hazard, a creature, a droid, or whatever) must roll the skill check twice and take the lowest result.

talents_list.name: Starship Raider
talents_list.benefit_summary: Gain +1 bonus on attack rolls while aboard a starship (applies to starship and personal weapons).
talents_list.benefit_text_long: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls while aboard a starship. This bonus applies to attacks made with starship weapons as well as personal weapons used aboard a starship.
talents_list.description: +1 Atk aboard starship including personal weapons
talents_list.full_text_description: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls while aboard a starship. This bonus applies to attacks made with starship weapons as well as personal weapons used aboard a starship.

talents_list.name: Stava Expertise
talents_list.description: when you grab an enemy they must make opposed grapple to break, if you initiate you can reroll, if you're in light or no armor

effects.summary: Mechanics are described textually in the description.

talents_list.full_text_description: When you successfully grab an enemy, he or she must make an opposed grapple check to break free of your grab. If you are initiating a grapple, you can reroll your grapple check. However, you must accept the second result, even if it is worse. You can use this talent only while wearing light armor or no armor.

talents_list.name: Stay in the Fight
talents_list.description: remove 1 mind-affecting or fear effect of ally w/in 12 sq & LOS & grant target hp = 10 + class level
